title: Einsatzleitung (m/w/d) ambulante Pflege (Pflegefachmann/-frau (Altenpflege))
description:
Einsatzleitung (m/w/d) ambulante Pflege in Berlin

Weil wir #pflegeleben!

Als Einsatzleitung (m/w/d) ist Organisation für dich kein Selbstzweck. Du organisierst, damit Pflege wirklich ankommt. Unsere Pflegekunden und Pflegekundinnen haben morgens die vertraute Person an der Tür, und das Team weiß, was zu tun ist, und kann sich auf dich verlassen. Das tolle Team der Diakonie-Station Steglitz freut sich auf dich!

Komm ins Team Diakonie!

Dein Aufgabengebiet:

Als Einsatzleitung (m/w/d) bist du das organisatorische Herzstück unserer Station. Du planst die Touren- und Pflegeeinsätze so, dass unsere Pflegekundschaft verlässlich versorgt wird – und das Team gut durch den Tag kommt. Konkret heißt das:

- Touren- und Einsatzplanung: du koordinierst, wer wann wo ist, und reagierst flexibel, wenn sich etwas ändert.
- Vertrags- und Verordnungsmanagement sowie Korrespondenz mit Kostenträgern – du kennst die Abläufe und behältst den Überblick.
- Qualitätssicherung und Pflegedokumentation mit unserer Software .snap von euregon® – du arbeitest strukturiert und digital.
- Ansprechperson für das Team, neue Pflegekunden und Pflegekundinnen, An- und Zugehörige, Ärztinnen und Ärzte sowie mitwirkende Berufsgruppen.
- Durch dein Fachwissen und deine Kommunikationsstärke sorgst du dafür, dass Abläufe reibungslos funktionieren – und wenn es mal hakt, findest du pragmatische Lösungen.

Einsatzleitung (m/w/d) - das bringst du mit:

Du bist examinierte Pflegefachkraft* und weißt, wie ambulante Pflege in der Praxis läuft. Idealerweise hast du eine Weiterbildung für leitende Funktionen mit mindestens 460 Stunden abgeschlossen – falls nicht, sprich uns trotzdem an, wir schauen gemeinsam, was passt.

- Freude daran, zu koordinieren, zu kommunizieren und Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
- Teamgeist – du arbeitest nicht allein auf einer Insel, sondern bist eingebettet in ein stabiles, kollegiales Umfeld.
- Sicherer Umgang mit Office-Software und Offenheit gegenüber digitalen Arbeitsmitteln.
- Deutschkenntnisse mindestens auf Niveau B2, um Pflegekundschaft, Aufträge und Dokumentation sicher zu handhaben.
- Lust, Ideen einzubringen und unsere Station aktiv mitzugestalten.
- Eine bestimmte Konfession ist nicht erforderlich.

*Pflegefachperson, Pflegefachfrau oder Pflegefachmann, Krankenpfleger oder Krankenpflegerin/Krankenschwester, Altenpfleger oder Altenpflegerin

Zögerst du deine Bewerbung abzusenden?

Karrierechancen, Weiterbildungen und Qualifikationen, mögliche Arbeitszeiten oder auch Einsatzorte - in einem Gespräch lässt sich vieles klären. Sprich uns an!

Gerne kannst du auch einen Schnuppertag bei uns machen oder einfach hospitieren.

Das ist uns sehr wichtig!

Welche ethnische oder soziale Herkunft du hast, welche geschlechtliche Identität du lebst, welche Religion du praktizierst, welche sexuelle Orientierung du hast, wie alt du bist oder ob du eine Schwerbehinderung oder Gleichstellung hast, ist für uns egal, denn ...

... wo Du auch herkommst, bei uns kommst Du an!

Uns ist aber wichtig, dass du unsere Werte teilst - unser Leitbild findest du hier. (https://www.diakonie-pflege.de/leitbild)

Was bietet dir unsere Diakonie-Station Steglitz in Berlin:

- Wir zahlen nach Tarif AVR DWBO (https://www.diakonie-portal.de/ueber-uns/arbeitsrecht/arbeitsrechtliche-kommission-ak/arbeitsvertragsrichtlinien-des-diakonischen-werkes-berlin-brandenburg-schlesische-oberlausitz-avr-dwbo) (EG 8): 4.162 € bis 4.601 €/Monat – je nach Erfahrung. Mit längerer Betriebszugehörigkeit bis zu 5.039 €/Monat.
- Jahressonderzahlung bis zur Höhe eines 13. Monatsgehalts (abhängig vom Betriebsergebnis).
- Kinderzuschlag von bis zu 88 € pro Kind für Kindergeldberechtigte.
- Arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge – weil gute Arbeit auch morgen zählt.
- 31 Tage Urlaub im Jahr.
- Vollzeit bedeutet bei uns 38,5 Stunden pro Woche – Teilzeit ist nach Absprache möglich.
- Dienstrad-Leasing: günstig und umweltfreundlich mobil durch Berlin.
- Rücksichtsvolle Dienst- und Urlaubsplanung.
- Fort- und Weiterbildungen, auch über unseren digitalen Pflegecampus – individuell, ortsunabhängig, in deinem Tempo.
- mehr Informationen: diakonie-pflege.de/pflegefachkraft (https://www.diakonie-pflege.de/pflegefachkraft)

So geht es mit deiner Bewerbung als Einsatzleitung (m/w/d) weiter:

1. Du bewirbst dich hier online als Einsatzleitung (m/w/d) in der Diakonie-Station Steglitz in Berlin, indem du auf den "Jetzt online bewerben"-Button klickst. Nutze bei Fragen vorab den E-Mail- oder WhatsApp-Kontakt der genannten Ansprechperson.
2. Wir überprüfen deine Informationen und Dokumente und melden uns bei Unklarheiten. Gerne informieren wir auch allgemein über unsere Einrichtung oder auch zu unserem Tarifsystem.
3. Wenn alle benötigten Informationen bei uns sind, meldet sich die jeweilige Einrichtung bei dir, um dich persönlich kennen zu lernen und macht mit dir einen Kennlerntermin. Dann werden alle Einzelheiten besprochen.

Du möchtest zu uns wechseln?

Falls du dich in einem ungekündigten Arbeitsverhältnis befindest, sichern wir dir natürlich höchste Vertraulichkeit deiner Bewerbung zu.

Deine Einarbeitung:

In den ersten Wochen geht es darum, dich mit unseren Systemen vertraut zu machen und dir unser tolles Team vorzustellen. Wir sind dabei immer an deiner Seite!

Klingt das gut? Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Einsatzleitung (m/w/d) und klicke auf "Jetzt online bewerben".

Bei EVIM arbeitest Du bei einem der größten diakonischen Arbeitgeber im Rhein-Main-Gebiet und hast durch verschiedenste Fachbereiche in den bedeutendsten Arbeitsfeldern der Sozialwirtschaft eine Vielzahl von Entwicklungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten. Gestalte mit uns und bring Dich mit!

Dann suchen wir genau Dich als Marketing Manager:in Verbandskommunikation in Voll- oder Teilzeit (min. 30 Wochenstunden)! Du entwickelst unsere Marketing- und Kommunikationsaktivitäten für den gesamten ASB Bremen inklusive seiner neun Tochtergesellschaften strategisch weiter, koordinierst sie zentral und setzt sie gemeinsam mit unseren Fachbereichen und externen Partner:innen um.

Der Arbeiter-Samariter-Bund Landesverband Bremen e. V. ist mit rund 20.000 Mitgliedern und mehr als 1.500 haupt- und ehrenamtlichen Mitarbeitenden eine der größten Hilfs- und Wohlfahrtsorganisationen im Land Bremen.

Deine Aufgaben:

Du bist die zentrale Schnittstelle für Marketing und Kommunikation verantwortest insbesondere:

- Entwicklung und Umsetzung unserer Marketing- und Kommunikationsstrategie
- Jahres-, Themen-, Redaktions- und Kampagnenplanung
- Koordination der verbandsweiten Kommunikationsmaßnahmen und Abstimmung mit den Fachbereichen
- Planung und Steuerung von Social Media sowie kanalübergreifenden Kampagnen
- redaktionelle Aufbereitung von Themen, Storytelling und Erstellung eigener Texte
- Presse- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit sowie Weiterentwicklung unserer öffentlichen Positionierung
- Planung und kommunikative Begleitung von Fundraising- und Spendenkampagnen
- Weiterentwicklung des Employer Brandings in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem HR
- redaktionelle und strategische Weiterentwicklung unserer Website
- kommunikative Begleitung von Veranstaltungen und Projekten
- Steuerung externer Agenturen und Dienstleister – von Briefing und Angebot über Projektkoordination und Budget bis zur Qualitätskontrolle
- Analyse relevanter Kennzahlen und kontinuierliche Optimierung unserer Kommunikationsmaßnahmen

Dabei gilt: Du musst nicht alles selbst produzieren. Für professionelle Foto- und Videoproduktionen, umfangreiche Gestaltung oder größere Kampagnen arbeiten wir mit externen Partner zusammen. Du hältst die Fäden in der Hand und sorgst dafür, dass aus vielen Themen eine professionelle und wirkungsvolle Kommunikation entsteht.

Das bringst Du mit:

- Ausbildung, Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien, PR oder einem ähnlichen Bereich
- mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung im Marketing und/oder in der Organisations- bzw. Unternehmenskommunikation
- strategisches Denken und gleichzeitig Freude daran, Themen auch selbst operativ voranzubringen
- sehr gutes Sprachgefühl und Sicherheit beim Schreiben und Redigieren von Texten
- Erfahrung mit Social Media, digitaler Kommunikation und Content-Planung
- gutes Gespür für Marken, Gestaltung und zielgruppengerechte Kommunikation
- ausgeprägte Organisations- und Projektmanagementfähigkeiten
- Sicherheit in der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen internen Ansprechpartner und externen Dienstleistern
- selbstständige, strukturierte und verbindliche Arbeitsweise
- Erfahrung in Fundraising, Employer Branding, Pressearbeit, Content-Management oder Agentursteuerung ist ein Plus.

Das erwartet Dich:

Keine klassische „Grafikstelle“, sondern eine zentrale Marketing- und Kommunikationsfunktion mit strategischer Verantwortung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.

Du arbeitest eng mit Fachbereichen, HR, Geschäftsführung und externen Partner zusammen und gestaltest die Kommunikation des ASB Bremen aktiv mit.

Dein Ziel: mehr Sichtbarkeit, mehr Reichweite und eine starke, konsistente Marke – für unsere Angebote und Dienstleistungen, für Mitglieder und Unterstützer und für den ASB Bremen als Arbeitgeber.

Als Arbeitgeber bieten wir Dir außerdem:

- eine unbefristete Festanstellung
- flexibles, familienfreundliches Arbeitszeitmodell und Arbeitszeiten (Gleitzeit)
- Vergütung nach TV-L
- Jahressonderzahlung
- Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten
- 30 Tage Erholungsurlaub
- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
- Firmenfitnessprogramm über EGYM-WELLPASS
- Fortbildungsmöglichkeiten
- Mitarbeiterevents
- Massagen am Arbeitsplatz﻿

Klingt nach Dir? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung und darauf, gemeinsam mit Dir die Kommunikation des ASB Bremen weiterzuentwickeln.

title: IT Specialist (f/m/d) 1st Level Server Support France / 1617 (First-Level-Supporter/in)
description:
At IONOS, the leading European provider of cloud infrastructure, cloud services and hosting services, you will work together with a wide range of teams. We are characterized by open structures, a friendly working culture and flat hierarchies with a strong team spirit. We firmly believe that work and fun are compatible, and offer you the right environment for this. Our constant growth means that we are always looking for new colleagues. Become part of IONOS and grow with us.

Your Responsibilities

To ensure an optimal experience and quality of service for our clients, we are looking to strengthen our dedicated French customer support team.

- First Point of Contact: Accompany clients in using our products and services, from understanding their initial request through to full resolution.
- Needs Analysis: Evaluate client inquiries to quickly identify their requirements and deliver clear, efficient, and tailored solutions.

Your profile

- Fluency in English and/or German would be an advantage.

title: Sozialpädagoische/r Assisten/in / Kinderpfleger/in (m/w/d) für Tagesgruppe in Landesbergen (Sozialpädagogische/r Assistent/in / Kinderpfleger/in)
employer: Verein für die Arbeit Mit-Menschen gGmbH
description:
Pädagogische Zusatzkraft (m/w/d) für unsere Tagesgruppe in Landesbergen gesucht
30 Stunden/Woche | ab 15.10.2026

Die Verein für die Arbeit Mit-Menschen gGmbH sucht zum 15.10.2026 eine engagierte pädagogische Zusatzkraft (m/w/d) für unsere Tagesgruppe in Landesbergen mit einem Stellenumfang von 30 Wochenstunden.

In unserer Tagesgruppe begleiten wir bis zu neun Jungen und Mädchen im Grundschulalter an fünf Nachmittagen pro Woche. Gemeinsam schaffen wir einen verlässlichen und strukturierten Rahmen, in dem die Kinder lernen, sich entwickeln und Gemeinschaft erleben können.

Im Mittelpunkt unserer Arbeit stehen die Gestaltung eines strukturierten Alltags-, Lern- und Freizeitumfeldes, das soziale Lernen in der Gruppe sowie eine vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit Eltern und Familien.

Ihre Aufgaben

Sie begleiten und unterstützen die Kinder im Tagesgruppenalltag und tragen dazu bei, ihnen Sicherheit, Orientierung und verlässliche Strukturen zu geben. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

- Begleitung und Unterstützung der Kinder im Tagesgruppenalltag
- Förderung von Selbstregulation, Selbstständigkeit und sozialer Kompetenz
- Unterstützung bei der Integration in die Gruppe und bei gemeinsamen Aktivitäten
- Mitgestaltung von Lern-, Freizeit- und Gruppenangeboten
- enge Zusammenarbeit mit den pädagogischen Fachkräften im Team
- Beobachtung und Dokumentation der individuellen Entwicklung der Kinder

Das bringen Sie mit

- eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Sozialpädagogische/r Assistent/in oder Kinderpfleger/in
- Freude an der Arbeit mit Kindern und Interesse daran, sie in ihrer Entwicklung zu begleiten und zu stärken
- idealerweise Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Kindern, insbesondere in der Förderung von Selbstregulation und sozialen Fähigkeiten
- Einfühlungsvermögen, Geduld sowie eine wertschätzende, respektvolle und zugleich klare Kommunikation
- Offenheit gegenüber unterschiedlichen Familienformen, Lebensentwürfen und Lebenssituationen
- eine ressourcenorientierte Haltung und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team
- die Bereitschaft, sich mit „Kopf, Herz und Hand“ in die pädagogische Arbeit einzubringen
- Bereitschaft zur fachlichen Weiterentwicklung sowie zur Teilnahme an Teambesprechungen und Supervisionen

Das bieten wir Ihnen

- eine Teilzeitstelle mit 30 Wochenstunden mit Schwerpunkt im Nachmittagsbereich
- eine abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit mit Kindern im Grundschulalter
- die Zusammenarbeit in einem pädagogischen Team
- regelmäßige Supervisionen
- Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- Raum, eigene Fähigkeiten und Ideen in die pädagogische Arbeit einzubringen

Interesse geweckt?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen! Senden Sie uns Ihre Bewerbungsunterlagen gerne per E-Mail.

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.
. Escalating requests that cannot be resolved to other team members, and team leaders located both in the UK and Germany.
. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.
. Accurately logging all Dealer contacts and following up on cases using Opel/Vauxhall database systems.
. Attending team and other meetings for review of issues, assignments, regular discussion.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. The city offers contemporary architecture, the picturesque old town, breath-taking natural surroundings and historic monuments. You can reach Budapest in a matter of minutes via road or public transport.

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.
. Escalating requests that cannot be resolved to other team members, and team leaders located both in the UK and Germany.
. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.
. Accurately logging all Dealer contacts and following up on cases using Opel/Vauxhall database systems.
. Attending team and other meetings for review of issues, assignments, regular discussion.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. The city offers contemporary architecture, the picturesque old town, breath-taking natural surroundings and historic monuments. You can reach Budapest in a matter of minutes via road or public transport.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Lead Game Designer
description:
CCP Games is seeking a Lead Game Designer to help our EVE Online design team grow, align, and deliver impactful gameplay and system as we build EVE into its third decade.

This is primarily a leadership role. While design judgment is essential, your greatest impact will come from mentorship, communication, and enabling designers to do their best work within complex, long-running live systems.

What You'll Do:
Lead, mentor, and support senior designers, with a focus on growth, feedback, and long-term career development
Improve team effectiveness by strengthening communication, collaboration, and clarity across disciplines
Partner with the Game Design Director to evolve and uphold EVE Online’s design process
Guide feature teams through exploration and development, encouraging a solution-oriented mindset while preserving momentum
Foster a culture of empowerment, experimentation, and learning within a live service environment
Identify and address team health issues early, helping teams navigate alignment challenges
Act as a trusted design leader for stakeholders, aligning goals and constraints into shared understanding

What We're Looking For:
6+ years of game design experience, including 2+ years in a people-focused leadership role
Proven ability to mentor and grow experienced designers
Extensive experience with gameplay systems and live game design, with the ability to give high-quality feedback
Clear, empathetic communicator with excellent stakeholder management skills
Experience shipping features in live service, MMO, sandbox, or similarly complex products
A leadership mindset focused on enabling others and team outcomes, not individual ownership
Bonus Experience: Familiarity with EVE Online, sandbox games, or player-driven economies

What We Can Offer You:
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation
Double work station setup and flexible work environment
An active fun division that hosts regular events
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks
Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan
Annual sports grant
A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package
Home internet
A conditional monthly transportation grant
Work environment that focuses on employee well-being
On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price
Relocation Package

Please submit your application in English.

Please apply by filling in an online application here: https://form.vinnumalastofnun.is/eures and put "260424-06" in the field for employer.

title: Automotive Mechanic
description:
Dekkjalíf is looking for an experienced and reliable Automotive Mechanic to join our team on a full-time basis.

The successful candidate must have solid knowledge of vehicle diagnostics, maintenance, and repairs. The role requires the ability to use computerized diagnostic equipment to identify faults, diagnose mechanical and electrical issues, and carry out the necessary repairs efficiently and professionally.

Key Responsibilities:
Perform vehicle diagnostics using computerized diagnostic tools
Identify and troubleshoot mechanical and electrical faults
Carry out repairs, servicing, and preventive maintenance
Inspect vehicles and ensure work is completed to a high standard
Maintain a safe, clean, and organized work environment
Follow company procedures and safety regulations

Requirements:
Experience as an Automotive Mechanic
Good knowledge of vehicle diagnostics and repair procedures
Ability to use computer diagnostic systems and tools
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Good work ethic and reliability
Basic English skills required
Relevant education, certification, or extensive work experience is an advantage

Wages according to collective agreements with relevant unions in Iceland.
Overtime is paid separately in accordance with applicable rules and regulations.

Working Hours:
This is a full-time position. Working hours are generally Monday through Friday, approximately eight hours per day.
The exact schedule will be agreed upon with the employee and arranged in accordance with applicable regulations.

title: Maintenance technician
description:
We are looking for a Maintenance Mechanic / Maintenance Technician or a mechanically skilled and hands-on person to join our maintenance team in a meat processing plant.

The role involves preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs and general technical support for production machinery and equipment. The employee will work closely with production staff to ensure reliable operation of equipment and minimize production downtime.

Main responsibilities:
Preventive maintenance and servicing of production machinery
Troubleshooting and repairing mechanical faults
Assisting with installation, adjustment and improvement of equipment
Responding to breakdowns and minimizing production downtime
General maintenance work throughout the production facility
Maintenance and repair of slaughter line equipment when required

Qualifications and experience:
Mechanical background or strong practical/mechanical skills
Experience in industrial maintenance, food production or similar environments is an advantage
Experience with food processing and packaging equipment from manufacturers such as Weber, MULTIVAC, K+G Wetter and VEMAG is a strong advantage
Experience with maintenance of slaughter line equipment is an advantage
Ability to troubleshoot mechanical and technical problems independently
Electrical, pneumatic or hydraulic experience is an advantage
Good spoken and written English is required
Reliable, organized and able to work both independently and as part of a team

Formal education as a mechanic or industrial technician is an advantage, but practical experience and strong mechanical ability will also be considered.

We offer:
Salary negotiable based on experience, qualifications and education , according to collective agreements
Meals provided during working hours
Working hours : 07:00-15:30
Accommodation can be provided
A varied technical role in an active food production environment
Opportunity to work with a wide range of modern food processing and packaging machinery

For applications & inquiries send to hemmi@svinvirkar.is

title: Facilities Manager
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Facilities Manager to oversee the delivery of hard and soft facilities services on site for a major account. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for managing day-to-day operations, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, and maintaining high standards of service delivery across multiple stakeholders. You will lead on-site teams, manage contractors, oversee maintenance programmes, and act as the key operational contact for the client. The successful candidate will be a customer-focused facilities professional with strong leadership skills, commercial awareness, and a proven ability to manage operational performance in a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities: Operational Management: Manage the day-to-day delivery of hard and soft facilities services across the contract. Lead, motivate, and develop the on-site service delivery team. Oversee planned preventative maintenance (PPM) schedules and lifecycle replacement programmes. Manage reactive maintenance requests and ensure contractual service levels are achieved. Scope, manage, and verify minor works projects. Coordinate contractors and ensure works are completed safely, efficiently, and to specification. Manage permit-to-work and safe systems of work processes. Client & Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary operational point of contact for the client and key stakeholders. Build and maintain strong working relationships through effective communication and service delivery. Attend client meetings and provide operational updates and performance reporting. Resolve issues promptly and professionally while maintaining a customer-focused approach. Health, Safety & Compliance: Ensure compliance with all relevant health and safety legislation and company policies. Lead safety initiatives including toolbox talks, safety walks, and near-miss reporting. Monitor contractor compliance and site safety performance. Promote a strong culture of safety and continuous improvement across all service lines. Financial & Contract Management: Monitor lifecycle expenditure and ensure spending remains within agreed budgets. Manage materials ordering and cost control processes. Support small works estimation and project delivery. Understand and interpret contractual requirements to ensure compliance and value delivery. Administration & Reporting: Maintain accurate contract documentation, records, and compliance files. Produce operational, maintenance, and performance reports as required. Coordinate site inductions and onboarding activities. Manage payroll and timekeeping processes for site-based teams. Maintain lifecycle plans, budgets, and performance data. About You: Essential Experience & Skills: Previous Facilities Management experience in a management or supervisory capacity. Experience managing both hard and soft FM services. Strong people management and leadership skills. Experience working in a client-facing environment.

description:

Youth Work Ireland is seeking a passionate and motivated Our Generation Youth Worker to join the Our Generation Project in County Donegal. This full-time hybrid role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by supporting the mental health, wellbeing, and personal development of young people through innovative youth work programmes. As an Our Generation Youth Worker, you will recruit and engage young people, build strong relationships with schools, youth clubs, and community organisations, and deliver structured programmes including Mind Matters, CHOICE, Stand UPP, and Rise Up. These programmes focus on emotional resilience, leadership, healthy relationships, wellbeing, and peace-building across communities. In this role, you will deliver evidence based youth programmes that promote mental health, emotional resilience, leadership, and wellbeing for young people. You will work across schools, youth clubs, and community organizations throughout County Donegal, building strong partnerships and creating engaging opportunities that empower young people and support positive outcomes. You will also collaborate with colleagues and partner organizativos to deliver high-quality programmes that strengthen communities and encourage cross-community and cross-border engagement. Key Requirements * Level 7 qualification (or higher) in Youth & Community Work, Social Work, Social Care, or a related Social Science discipline. * Experience delivering structured programmes or workshops with young people. * Excellent communication, organizational, and teamwork skills. * Ability to engage young people in a variety of educational and community settings. * Full, clean driving license and access to a car (essential). * Willingness to travel regularly throughout County Donegal. This is a 35-hour per week hybrid position, a fixed-term contract from October 2026 to September 2027, with a starting salary of €41,500.49. If you are committed to empowering young people and creating positive change in your community, we would love to hear from you.

Requirements Applicants must be registered with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Ireland (NMBI) and eligible to practise nursing in Ireland. Previous experience working in an operating theatre or surgical environment is required. Experience in plastic, reconstructive or cosmetic surgery would be an advantage. Applicants should demonstrate: Strong theatre and perioperative nursing skills. Good knowledge of infection prevention and control and aseptic technique. Excellent patient-care and communication skills. Good organisational and time-management skills. Accurate clinical documentation and attention to detail.

title: Finance Head (f/m/d) - Discrete Projects Industrial Logistics (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
description:
We're seeking a Finance Head (f/m/d) for Industrial Logistics within Digital Industries Automation Discrete Projects (DI AUT DP). In this role, you'll lead global financial management for our Industrial Logistics (IL) project business across Europe and Americas – as part of the global Finance function under our new ONE Tech Company structure.
This is your chance to shape financial operations throughout the complete project lifecycle – from bid calculations to project closure – while ensuring IFRS 15 compliance, financial performance analysis, and effective risk management. You’ll drive profitable growth, sustainable margin improvement, stable cash generation, and financial resilience through disciplined risk control across multiple countries. You'll work in a transformation environment with a clear focus on business growth, where your financial expertise directly contributes to our goals of speed, scale, and efficiency.
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.
You’ll make an impact by - Financial Leadership & Strategy: You lead global financial management and controlling for the Industrial Logistics project business, reporting to the Head of Finance of DI AUT DP. You drive growth and productivity initiatives to strengthen its competitive position. You govern the adoption of finance and controlling policies and guidelines based on the overall FIN strategy while ensuring compliance with all relevant financial regulations (external and internal).- Budget Planning, Forecasting & Financial Reporting: You coordinate budget planning and forecasting for the entire IL project business, ensuring IFRS-compliant accounting and timely preparation of financial closings as well as accurate books and records (monthly, quarterly, annual).- Performance Monitoring: You monitor and comment on financial performance (current development and outlook) incl. KPI analyses and performance reporting. You analyze, approve, review and forecast project revenues and costs, and ensure accurate profitability throughout the project lifecycle, as well as initiate early warnings to stakeholders when needed.- Project Finance & Risk Management: You identify and manage financial risks associated with the execution of projects, including currency, credit, and operational risks, ensuring proper risk assessment and provisioning in calculations and financial statements.- Operational Improvement & Innovation: You identify operational improvement potentials in controlling and financial processes, propose solutions and remedial measures, and drive productivity improvements through automation and innovation initiatives.- Collaboration & Transformation: You work with IL management, operational leadership, and central finance functions while supporting organizational transformation by challenging the current processes and collaborating across all stakeholder groups (e.g., FIN, P&O, EHS, GBS, SCM).- Team Leadership & Development: Finally, you manage and develop Finance and Controlling teams supporting the global IL project business. Traveling to its locations and project sites is necessary.

Your success is grounded in- Education: University degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or related field - Experience and Skills:- Minimum 8-10 years in Finance, Controlling, and FP&A, preferably in international project business- Minimum 5 years leadership experience leading finance teams across multiple locations and building collaborative relationships - Proven expertise in IFRS 15 revenue recognition for long-term project contracts and commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations. Familiarity with project business models in automotive or comparable industrial environments is a strong differentiator.- Demonstrated hands-on experience in commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations, covering pricing structures, risk allocation, liability caps, and penalty/malus clauses. Ability to engage with customer purchasing teams and to represent Finance as a value-creating business partner in complex commercial discussions.- Strong knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, and controlling- Deep understanding of risk management, internal controls, compliance and audit requirements- Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP preferred) and advanced MS Office skills- Experience with organizational transformation and implementation of new business operations is beneficial

- Ways of Working:- Strategic vision meets financial excellence – combining big-picture thinking with process optimization and attention to detail- Collaborative influencer who builds trust across cultures and translates complex financial insights into clear, actionable messages- Proactive, adaptable, and able to thrive in evolving business environments - High integrity with commitment to Siemens Business Conduct Guidelines and compliance requirements
- Languages: Business proficiency in English; German language skills are a plus. Additional languages are highly welcome and beneficial for international collaboration.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us. As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/about/social-commitments/belonging/) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.
About us.
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. title: Junior Structural Analyst
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Want to start your career in structural analysis and develop your FEM expertise through real engineering challenges? Wärtsilä is looking for a Junior Structural Analyst to join its Structural Analysis team!

**What will you be doing?**

As a Junior Structural Analyst, you will work with structural calculations and FEM analyses that support Wärtsiläs product and technology development. Your work will focus especially on cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems. You will perform and evaluate FEM analyses, prepare technical reports, and collaborate with designers and other specialists to turn analysis results into engineering decisions.

You will join an experienced Structural Analysis team where knowledge is actively shared. Your analyses and reports will be reviewed by experienced colleagues, giving you regular feedback and support. You are encouraged to ask questions, discuss different approaches, and learn from specialists working with demanding structural analysis challenges.

You will start with clearly defined calculation assignments and take on increasingly complex analyses as your skills develop. Over time, you can deepen your expertise in different component areas and contribute to simulation method development and new ways of working. **What makes you a great fit?**

You may be taking your first steps in structural analysis or already have some relevant experience and want to deepen your FEM expertise. Most importantly, you have a solid foundation in mechanics and FEM and the motivation to develop into a structural analysis specialist.

You enjoy solving technical problems and working with others, but you are also comfortable taking ownership of your own assignments. You communicate your findings clearly, actively look for solutions, and know when to ask colleagues for input.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- A good understanding of mechanics and the fundamentals of FEM

- Practical experience with FEM through studies, projects, internships, or work

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive approach to learning, problem-solving, and teamwork


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with Abaqus, Ansys, OptiStruct, Nastran, SimLab, HyperMesh, or similar simulation software

- Previous internship, summer job, or project experience related to structural analysis or mechanical engineering

- Interest in simulation method development, noise simulation, machine learning, digitalization, or other new analysis methods and tools

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Why join Wärtsilä?**

- Contribute to the development of Wärtsiläs marine technologies and solve engineering challenges shaped by an evolving industry.

- Work in an international R&D environment where structural analysis connects you with specialists across different engineering disciplines.

- Deepen your FEM expertise through real structural analysis challenges and gradually take on more demanding assignments.

- Learn alongside experienced specialists who review your work, share their expertise, and support your development.


**Practicalities:**

This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Wärtsilä. The position can be based either in Vaasa, Finland, or Trieste, Italy, and follows Wärtsiläs hybrid working model. The starting date will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

**Interested?**

Please submit your CV in PDF format in English or Finnish by September 23rd at the latest via aTalents application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/381526/create/. A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can familiarize yourself with Wärtsilä here: https://www.wartsila.com/. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Roosa Lönnqvist (+358 50 421 0255, roosa.lonnqvist\[at\]atalent.fi).

**Company description**

_Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Through sustainable technology and data-driven innovation, Wärtsilä enables its customers to improve environmental and economic performance while accelerating the transition towards a more sustainable future. Operating in more than 70 countries and employing thousands of professionals worldwide, Wärtsilä is committed to shaping the decarbonization of the marine and energy industries through innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence._

title: Structural Analysis Expert
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Looking for new challenges within structural analysis that go beyond routine simulations? Join Wärtsilä to solve complex engineering problems and shape how they are analyzed.

**What will you be doing?**

As an Expert in Structural Analysis, you will solve demanding structural strength and durability challenges using FEM and numerical analysis. You will perform, evaluate, and report simulations related to dynamics, fatigue, stress, and structural strength, supporting product and technology development across cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems.

Your assignments will range from focused structural calculations to complex investigations where you identify the root causes of technical challenges and determine how to move forward. You will work closely with designers, component experts, and other technical specialists, using simulation and measurement data to support engineering decisions and solve real product development challenges.

Beyond individual analysis assignments, you will contribute to developing simulation methods, processes, and new ways of working. You will share your findings and expertise within the Structural Analysis team, helping others apply new methods and learnings in their work. Depending on your expertise and interests, you may also contribute to areas such as noise simulation, machine learning, and digitalization.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You already have several years of professional experience in FEM and structural analysis, combined with a strong understanding of mechanics and numerical analysis. You are comfortable taking ownership of demanding simulation assignments, evaluating results critically, and communicating your findings and recommendations to designers and other technical specialists.

You enjoy getting to the root of complex technical problems and finding practical ways forward. You work independently when needed but value collaboration, actively seek input from others, and are equally willing to share your own expertise and learnings with the team.

**We expect you to have:**

- Professional experience in structural analysis and practical FEM simulations, preferably involving engine components or other mechanically demanding products

- An MSc or PhD degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- Experience with Abaqus, HyperMesh, SimLab, OptiStruct, or similar simulation software

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical teams


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience or interest in machine learning, digitalization, or data analytics

- Experience or interest in numerical noise analysis or noise simulation development

- Experience with CFD or multiphysics simulations

- Finnish or Swedish language skills

Una realtà che fa dei valori di Cura, Passione, Collaborazione, Responsabilità, Apprendimento Continuo e Sostenibilità i suoi pillar. In Gi Group avrai prospettive di crescita anche a livello internazionale e con piani di formazione personalizzati proposti da b*right, la nostra Corporate University. In più potrai usufruire dello smartworking, di un sistema premiante e di Gi Well, il nostro piano di welfare aziendale. Per la divisione Professional di Gi Group - composta da più di 200 consulenti con focus sulla Talent acquisition e consulenza di servizi customizzati- siamo alla ricerca, PER LA NOSTRA DIVISIONE SPECIALIZZATA di una figura di: TALENT ACQUISITION CONSULTANT - DIVISIONE OFFICE Di cosa ti occuperai: Ti occuperai della ricerca e selezione dei candidati specializzati sul territorio di riferimento, collaborando con il team dedicato alla specializzazione Office nel raggiungimento degli obiettivi assegnati e supporterai le aziende clienti fornendo una consulenza professionale grazie alla conoscenza del mercato di riferimento e all'utilizzo di tools innovativi che avrai a disposizione. Sarai responsabile in particolare di: - definire le esigenze ed individuare la migliore soluzione di servizio - ricercare, acquisire e gestire le candidature - qualificare e aggiornare il data base e le relazioni con i candidati 'core' - gestire i colloqui di valutazione - orientare il candidato e il cliente - proporre attivamente i migliori profili intercettati - il ruolo non prevede attività sales di acquisizione new client Le skills richieste sono: - Laurea preferibilmente in materie umanistico-economiche - Spiccato interesse per il mondo della ricerca e selezione - Solida esperienza in ruoli consulenziali in ambito HR, nella gestione di progetti strutturati, in particolare in settori specializzati. Valuteremo favorevolmente anche la competenza nell'utilizzo di strumenti di valutazione come testistica ed assessment center. E'importante che tu abbia una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, data la dimensione anche internazionale dell'azienda, e un ottimo utilizzo del pacchetto office. Cosa ti proponiamo: ti proponiamo di intraprendere un percorso di crescita che costruiremo insieme: svilupperai le competenze necessarie a svolgere al meglio l'attività con il supporto dei colleghi e dei responsabili di funzione. Prevediamo il trattamento contrattuale del CCNL Commercio e Terziario, che integriamo con un sistema premiante, la nostra policy di welfare aziendale e la possibilità di operare anche in smart working. description: Senti la necessità di aumentare le tue Competenze Linguistiche? Ti piacerebbe svolgere un percorso di formazione gratuito per imparare l' INGLESE partendo da zero? Questa potrebbe essere l'opportunità giusta per te! Gi Group SpA, Agenzia per il Lavoro Filiale di Thiene, organizza un corso di formazione GRATUITO di: Lingua Inglese Livello Base Di cosa si tratta? Contenuti del corso: - Inglese base: presentazioni e saluti, numeri, giorni, mesi, orari; - Grammatica: presente semplice, articoli, pronomi, preposizioni; - Vocabolario: famiglia e amici, cibo e ristorante, lavoro e tempo libero, viaggi e trasporti; - Conversazioni semplici: parlare di sé, fare domande, chiedere informazioni; - Scrittura: frasi brevi, email semplici. title: Finance Head (f/m/d) - Discrete Projects Industrial Logistics (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
description:
We're seeking a Finance Head (f/m/d) for Industrial Logistics within Digital Industries Automation Discrete Projects (DI AUT DP). In this role, you'll lead global financial management for our Industrial Logistics (IL) project business across Europe and Americas – as part of the global Finance function under our new ONE Tech Company structure.
This is your chance to shape financial operations throughout the complete project lifecycle – from bid calculations to project closure – while ensuring IFRS 15 compliance, financial performance analysis, and effective risk management. You’ll drive profitable growth, sustainable margin improvement, stable cash generation, and financial resilience through disciplined risk control across multiple countries. You'll work in a transformation environment with a clear focus on business growth, where your financial expertise directly contributes to our goals of speed, scale, and efficiency.
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.
You’ll make an impact by - Financial Leadership & Strategy: You lead global financial management and controlling for the Industrial Logistics project business, reporting to the Head of Finance of DI AUT DP. You drive growth and productivity initiatives to strengthen its competitive position. You govern the adoption of finance and controlling policies and guidelines based on the overall FIN strategy while ensuring compliance with all relevant financial regulations (external and internal).- Budget Planning, Forecasting & Financial Reporting: You coordinate budget planning and forecasting for the entire IL project business, ensuring IFRS-compliant accounting and timely preparation of financial closings as well as accurate books and records (monthly, quarterly, annual).- Performance Monitoring: You monitor and comment on financial performance (current development and outlook) incl. KPI analyses and performance reporting. You analyze, approve, review and forecast project revenues and costs, and ensure accurate profitability throughout the project lifecycle, as well as initiate early warnings to stakeholders when needed.- Project Finance & Risk Management: You identify and manage financial risks associated with the execution of projects, including currency, credit, and operational risks, ensuring proper risk assessment and provisioning in calculations and financial statements.- Operational Improvement & Innovation: You identify operational improvement potentials in controlling and financial processes, propose solutions and remedial measures, and drive productivity improvements through automation and innovation initiatives.- Collaboration & Transformation: You work with IL management, operational leadership, and central finance functions while supporting organizational transformation by challenging the current processes and collaborating across all stakeholder groups (e.g., FIN, P&O, EHS, GBS, SCM).- Team Leadership & Development: Finally, you manage and develop Finance and Controlling teams supporting the global IL project business. Traveling to its locations and project sites is necessary.

title: Junior Structural Analyst
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Want to start your career in structural analysis and develop your FEM expertise through real engineering challenges? Wärtsilä is looking for a Junior Structural Analyst to join its Structural Analysis team!

**What will you be doing?**

As a Junior Structural Analyst, you will work with structural calculations and FEM analyses that support Wärtsiläs product and technology development. Your work will focus especially on cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems. You will perform and evaluate FEM analyses, prepare technical reports, and collaborate with designers and other specialists to turn analysis results into engineering decisions.

You will join an experienced Structural Analysis team where knowledge is actively shared. Your analyses and reports will be reviewed by experienced colleagues, giving you regular feedback and support. You are encouraged to ask questions, discuss different approaches, and learn from specialists working with demanding structural analysis challenges.

You will start with clearly defined calculation assignments and take on increasingly complex analyses as your skills develop. Over time, you can deepen your expertise in different component areas and contribute to simulation method development and new ways of working. **What makes you a great fit?**

You may be taking your first steps in structural analysis or already have some relevant experience and want to deepen your FEM expertise. Most importantly, you have a solid foundation in mechanics and FEM and the motivation to develop into a structural analysis specialist.

You enjoy solving technical problems and working with others, but you are also comfortable taking ownership of your own assignments. You communicate your findings clearly, actively look for solutions, and know when to ask colleagues for input.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- A good understanding of mechanics and the fundamentals of FEM

- Practical experience with FEM through studies, projects, internships, or work

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive approach to learning, problem-solving, and teamwork


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with Abaqus, Ansys, OptiStruct, Nastran, SimLab, HyperMesh, or similar simulation software

- Previous internship, summer job, or project experience related to structural analysis or mechanical engineering

- Interest in simulation method development, noise simulation, machine learning, digitalization, or other new analysis methods and tools

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Why join Wärtsilä?**

- Contribute to the development of Wärtsiläs marine technologies and solve engineering challenges shaped by an evolving industry.

- Work in an international R&D environment where structural analysis connects you with specialists across different engineering disciplines.

- Deepen your FEM expertise through real structural analysis challenges and gradually take on more demanding assignments.

- Learn alongside experienced specialists who review your work, share their expertise, and support your development.


**Practicalities:**

This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Wärtsilä. The position can be based either in Vaasa, Finland, or Trieste, Italy, and follows Wärtsiläs hybrid working model. The starting date will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

**Interested?**

Please submit your CV in PDF format in English or Finnish by September 23rd at the latest via aTalents application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/381526/create/. A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can familiarize yourself with Wärtsilä here: https://www.wartsila.com/. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Roosa Lönnqvist (+358 50 421 0255, roosa.lonnqvist\[at\]atalent.fi).

title: Structural Analysis Expert

Looking for new challenges within structural analysis that go beyond routine simulations? Join Wärtsilä to solve complex engineering problems and shape how they are analyzed.

As an Expert in Structural Analysis, you will solve demanding structural strength and durability challenges using FEM and numerical analysis. You will perform, evaluate, and report simulations related to dynamics, fatigue, stress, and structural strength, supporting product and technology development across cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems.

Your assignments will range from focused structural calculations to complex investigations where you identify the root causes of technical challenges and determine how to move forward. You will work closely with designers, component experts, and other technical specialists, using simulation and measurement data to support engineering decisions and solve real product development challenges.

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

Esam lielākais veļas mazgāšanas pakalpojumu sniedzējs Vidzemē. Mūsu klientu servisa vadītājs rūpējas, lai klients ir uzklausīts, saprasts un profesionāli apkalpots. Ja komunikācija un atbildība ir Tavas stiprās puses, mēs gaidām tieši Tevi, lai uzticētu rūpes par mūsu klientu labsajūtu!

Tavi galvenie pienākumi būs:

  • Apstrādāt klientu informāciju grāmatvedības programmā;
  • Sadarboties ar citu nodaļu vadītājiem, nodrošinot nevainojamu servisu.

No Tevis sagaidām:

  • Interesi iepazīt un izprast veļas mazgāšanas procesu;
  • Teicamas komunikācijas, pārliecināšanas un sadarbības prasmes;
  • Spēju rast risinājumus nestandarta situācijās;
  • Precizitāti, atbildību un profesionālu attieksmi;
  • B kategorijas autovadītāja apliecību un gatavību doties pie klientiem.

Piedāvājums no mums, ja pievienosies mūsu komandai:

  • Stabilu darbu augošā, uzticamā uzņēmumā;

  • Darba vietu Cēsīs un atalgojumu 1300 eiro pirms nodokļu nomaksas (iespēju nopelnīt piemaksas);
  • Darba auto klientu apmeklēšanai;
  • Patīkamas darbinieka atlaides uzņēmuma pakalpojumiem.

SIA “Baltic Construction Alliance” aicina darbā: VĒDINĀŠANAS SISTĒMU MONTĒTĀJUS

Darba apraksts un pienākumi: 

Vēdināšanas sistēmu montētājs veic gaisa vadu, ventilācijas un kondicionēšanas iekārtu uzstādīšanu, pieslēgšanu un tehnisko apkopi būvniecības vai apsaimniekošanas objektos.

Galvenie darba pienākumi

  • Sistēmu montāža: Gaisa vadu, difuzoru, ventilatoru, rekuperatoru un citu ventilācijas iekārtu uzstādīšana.

  • Sagatavošanas darbi: Stiprinājumu, balstkonstrukciju un cauruļvadu sagatavošana un montāža objektā.
  • Pārbaude un apkope: Iekārtu darbības testēšana, nodošana ekspluatācijā un periodiskā servisa apkalpošana.

Prasības:

  • Pozitīva attieksme pret darbu.
  • Augsta atbildības sajūta.
  • Izpratne par inženierkomunikāciju un ventilācijas sistēmu uzbūvi.
  • 3 gadu darba pieredze profesijā vai izglītības dokuments.

 
Darba izpildes vieta: daudzdzīvokļu dzīvojamās ēkas būvobjekts Cēsu ielā 7, Siguldā,  Siguldas novads, LV-2150, kā arī darbs citos  būvobjektos Latvijas Republikas teritorijā.

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: Kiemsargis
description:
1.    Palaikyti švarą ir tvarką mokyklos teritorijoje.
2.    Kasdien nušluoti takelius, šaligatvius, iškaupti žolę takeliuose ir žaidimų aikštelėse, surinkti šiukšles (1–2 val. prieš ateinant vaikams).
3.    Vasaros, rudens ir pavasario laikotarpiu prižiūrėti bei laistyti gėlynus, pjauti žolę.
4.    Prižiūrėti ir tinkamai eksploatuoti naudojamą techniką: žoliapjovę, žoliapjovės traktorių, trimerius (valyti, tikrinti techninę būklę, atlikti smulkų remontą, laiku informuoti apie gedimus).
5.    Užtikrinti tinkamą technikos saugojimą, laikymą ir priežiūrą ne darbo metu.
6.    Vykdyti kuro sunaudojimo apskaitą, racionaliai naudoti kurą ir kitas eksploatacines medžiagas.
7.    Žiemą nukasti sniegą nuo takelių, šaligatvių, žaidimų aikštelių, įėjimų į pastatą, barstyti takelius smėliu.
8.    Kasdien apžiūrėti inventorių; esant gedimams – remontuoti savo jėgomis arba informuoti pavaduotoją ūkio reikalams.
9.    Perdažyti lauko įrenginius, atlikti smulkų jų remontą.
Kiemsargio atsakomybė: už mokyklos teritorijos priežiūrą ir tvarką; už sanitarinių higieninių reikalavimų vykdymą; už saugos darbe ir priešgaisrinės saugos reikalavimų laikymąsi; Už patikėtos technikos, įrankių ir inventoriaus saugumą, tinkamą naudojimą bei priežiūrą; už kuro ir eksploatacinių medžiagų racionalų naudojimą; už aukščiau išvardintų pareigų vykdymą.
Kiemsargis privalo: vykdyti mokyklos direktoriaus, pavaduotojo ūkiui arba įgaliotų asmenų su darbu susijusius nurodymus. Mokėti saugiai dirbti ir netrukdyti saugiai dirbti kitiems. Laiku tikrintis sveikatą. Laikytis įstaigos vidaus tvarkos taisyklių, darbe nevartoti alkoholinių gėrimų bei narkotinių medžiagų. Laikytis įrenginių naudojimo instrukcijų reikalavimų, asmens higienos reikalavimų.
