title: Miljøterapeut
description:
Navs overordnede mål er å gi mennesker muligheter til arbeid og aktivitet, og sikre rettigheter til velferdsytelser. Nav Oslo har en partnerskapsavtale med Bydel Gamle Oslo for å gjennomføre sitt samfunnsoppdrag om å tilby bydelens innbyggere arbeids- og velferdstjenester.

Nav Gamle Oslo er et utviklingsorientert Nav-kontor i bydelen Gamle Oslo med ca. 220 dyktige medarbeidere, fordelt på ulike avdelinger og team. Hos oss finner du fantastiske kollegaer med kompetanse på områder som arbeidsinkludering, integrering, sosialfaglig oppfølging, flyktningehelse/migrasjonshelse og rekruttering. Samlokaliseringen med bydelens øvrige tjenestetilbud legger til rette for god samhandling til innbyggernes beste. 

Team nyankomne flyktninger er et kompetansemessig tverrfaglig, sammensatt team på ca. 15 ansatte som har ansvar for å bosette nyankomne flyktninger og å forvalte introduksjonsprogrammet for nyankomne flykninger og innvandrere med rett og/eller plikt. Hovedandelen av flyktningene vi bosetter er arabisk- eller ukrainsk-/russisktalende. I vårt flyktningarbeid har vi et omfattende fokus på å gi behovsprøvd, individtilpasset støtte til nyankomne flyktninger med nedsatt funksjonsevne og/eller atferdsvansker, og vi søker øremerkede midler (Ekstratilskudd) fra Integrerings- og mangfoldsdirektoratet for å finansiere dette. Våre miljøterapeuter gir én-til-én-oppfølging til flyktninger som kvalifiserer for dette, og gir dem hjelp til selvhjelp slik at de kan oppnå et best mulig funksjons- og mestringsnivå og øke sine muligheter til å bli selvhjulpne gjennom arbeid. 

Vi ønsker oss deg som motiveres av å drive mennesker mot å nå sine mål. Du må like å jobbe med mennesker i alle aldre, forskjellige livssituasjoner og med ulike kulturelle bakgrunner. Du må kunne skape gode relasjoner og tillit, utvise tålmodighet og ha evne til å iverksette planer som bidrar til at andre lykkes. Du må ha kompetanse innen flyktningehelse, flerkulturell kommunikasjon og forståelse. Du må håndtere å jobbe innenfor et fagfelt med store omskiftninger, høyt arbeidstempo, og stadige uforutsette utfordringer, samt evne å sette grenser når dette er nødvendig. 

Hos oss får du mulighet til å gjøre en forskjell og øke din flyktningefaglige og flerkulturelle kompetanse. Du får samarbeidsvillige kollegaer med mye humor og en innholdsrik og varierende arbeidsdag. Vi kan love deg at ingen dag blir lik.

Kjenner du deg igjen i beskrivelsen? Har du lyst til å bli en del av oss? Tenker du at du kan gjøre en god jobb for og med bydelens nyankomne flyktninger med særskilt behov for tett oppfølging? Da kan du være den rette. 


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Jobbe én til én med flyktninger med særskilt behov for tett oppfølging og gi hjelp til selvhjelp i dagliglivet
  • Samarbeide tett med flyktningenes hovedkontaktpersoner ved Nav Gamle Oslo og øvrige aktuelle tjenester i bydelen og eksternt
  • Gi tett, psykososial oppfølging til flyktninger i alle aldre, livssituasjoner og med ulike kulturelle bakgrunner og bidra til å øke deres systemforståelse
  • Trygge flyktningene i å ta imot ulik type helsehjelp og annen støtte fra helse- og omsorgssektoren
  • Bestille avtaler ved behov og bli med flyktningene på konsultasjoner med ulike helsetjenester og andre hjelpeinstanser 
  • Gi støtte og oppfølging i etterkant av konsultasjoner og behandlinger for å sikre at flyktningene har oppfattet informasjon, får hentet ut medisiner og gjennomfører anbefalt behandlingsløp 
  • Være sammen med flyktninger på arenaer der de har behov for ekstra støtte og utfordre dem til å bli selvstendige
  • Bistå med å lese og forklare innhold i brev og vedtak og hjelpe flyktningene med å få kontroll over egen privatøkonomi 
  • Gi noe praktisk bistand i hjemmet
  • Bli med til diverse rådgivningstjenester og bistå med innhenting av dokumentasjon for å søke på diverse hjelpemidler og tjenester flyktningen kan ha rett på 
  • Bistå flyktninger med å mestre livet i nytt land, navigere seg rundt i nærmiljøet, gjøre aktiviteter utenfor hjemmet og bygge sosiale nettverk
  • Bistå foreldre i møte med barnehage, skole og fritidsaktiviteter
  • Trene på norsk, øve på digitale ferdigheter og motivere flyktningene for å komme ut i arbeid
  • Journalføring
Kvalifikasjoner

Må-krav:

  • Fullført / fått godkjent videregående utdanning i Norge
  • Minimum to års erfaring fra arbeid som miljøarbeider i Nav for målgruppen nyankomne/nybosatte flyktninger i alle aldre, forskjellige livssituasjoner og ulike kulturelle bakgrunner som innebærer:
    • én-til-én oppfølging av flyktninger med funksjonsnedsettelser, psykiske lidelser og/eller sansetap
    • avklare hjelpebehov og gi individtilpasset oppfølging i tråd med behov
    • tett samarbeid med bosettingskonsulenter og/eller programrådgivere i introduksjonsprogrammet
  • Kunne vise til kompetanse innenfor flyktningehelse, inkludert postmigrasjonsvansker
  • God systemforståelse og kjennskap til det norske samfunnet
  • God skriftlig og muntlig framstillingsevne i norsk og arabisk
  • God digital kompetanse
  • Kunne jobbe selvstendig, strukturert og ha god gjennomføringsevne

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:
Du bør ha:

  • God kjennskap til prosessen flyktninger går gjennom fra ankomst til Norge og til de bosettes i bydel/kommune
  • God kjennskap til virksomheter og tjenester i bydel Gamle Oslo
  • God kjennskap til relevante tiltak og samarbeidspartnere utover bydel Gamle Oslo 
  • Kompetanse innen rusavhengighet
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du evner å sette deg inn i komplekse problemstillinger, er framoverlent og løsningsorientert
  • Du liker å jobbe med mennesker med sammensatte helseutfordringer og møter dem med respekt og anerkjennelse
  • Du er endringsvillig og kan raskt påta deg nye oppgaver
  • Du har interesse for, og evne til, å veilede og motivere mennesker i sårbare livssituasjoner 
  • Du er tålmodig og raus med et stort fokus på ressurser og brukermedvirkning
  • Du er effektiv og målbevisst, og liker å jobbe i en hektisk hverdag der dagene er uforutsigbare
  • Du er en god lagspiller og samarbeider godt med andre
  • Du er en god relasjonsbygger og har utpregede empatiske evner 
  • Du er uredd og evner å bygge nettverk med interne og eksterne samarbeidspartnere
  • Du evner å sette grenser når det er nødvendig
Vi tilbyr
  • Ansettelse som miljøterapeut i stk 146. Lønnsplassering i lønnstrinn 14 - 24 (kr. 520.350 - kr. 566.600 i årslønn i 100 % stilling) i Oslo kommunes regulativ, avhengig av ansiennitet
  • Vikariat ut september 2027 - tiltredelse etter avtale. Det kan være mulighet for ytterligere forlengelse.
  • Hybrid arbeidshverdag med mulighet for å jobbe fra flere steder
  • Stort og moderne Nav-kontor som er opptatt av kvalitet i tjenestene til bydelens innbyggere
  • Aktivitetsbasert arbeidsplass etter ABW-konseptet som bl.a. innebærer økt fleksibilitet, mer samarbeid, deling av kompetanse, og at du jobber i ulike soner tilpasset din arbeidshverdag og dine oppgaver
  • Stor og spennende bydel med vilje til å satse på innovasjon og utvikling
  • Samfunnsnyttige og motiverende arbeidsoppgaver i tråd med Navs virksomhetsstrategi og Oslostandard for arbeid med integrering og inkludering av flyktninger
  • Arbeidssted i bydelshuset der du har tilgang til bydelens øvrige tjenester
  • Fleksibel arbeidstid

  • Moderne lokaler med blant annet aktivitetsrom, hvilerom og mindfulnessrom

title: Lege på timebasis ved Helsestasjon for kjønn og seksualitet (HKS)
description:
Helsestasjon for kjønn og seksualitet (HKS) finansierer deler av tjenestetilbudet gjennom prosjektmidler. Dette gir oss mulighet til å øke kapasiteten i tjenesten og videreutvikle tilbudet vårt. I den forbindelse ønsker vi å knytte til oss leger med ulik kompetanse.

Vi har behov for leger på timebaserte avtaler, der omfanget vil kunne variere fra om lag 5 til 20 timer per uke, avhengig av tjenestens behov. Omfang og arbeidstid avtales nærmere og tilpasses, der det er mulig, eventuelle andre arbeidsforhold.

Som lege tilknyttet HKS vil du ha ansvar for oppfølging av kjønnsbekreftende hormonbehandling i tråd med gjeldende faglige retningslinjer. Det kan også være aktuelt å bidra med øvrige oppgaver innenfor tjenestens ansvarsområde, avhengig av kompetanse og behov.

Oppdragets varighet er foreløpig seks måneder, med mulighet for forlengelse dersom behov og finansiering videreføres.

Les om HKS her: https://www.oslo.kommune.no/helse-og-omsorg/helsetjenester/helsestasjon-og-vaksine/helsestasjon-for-kjonn-og-seksualitet-hks/ og utdypende informasjon her: www.hksoslo.no


Arbeidsoppgaver

Legeoppfølgingen innebærer:

  • Oppstart, oppfølging og videreføring av kjønnsbekreftende hormonbehandling i tråd med gjeldende faglige retningslinjer.
  • Vurdering og oppfølging av blodprøvesvar, somatiske undersøkelser og forskrivning av legemidler.
  • Deltakelse i regelmessige møter med tverrfaglig team.
  • Tett samarbeid med koordinator ved HKS.
  • Samarbeid med fastleger, spesialisthelsetjenesten samt regionale og nasjonale kompetansemiljøer.
  • Bidra til forsvarlige behandlingsforløp gjennom kliniske vurderinger, pasientinformasjon og tverrfaglig samarbeid.
  • Journalføring i CGM.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Norsk autorisasjon som lege
  • Erfaring med kjønnsbekreftende hormonbehandling er en fordel, men ikke en forutsetning.
  • Flytende norsk og engelsk muntlig og skriftlig
  • Politiattest uten anmerkninger
Personlige egenskaper
  • Strukturert, fleksibel og selvstendig.
  • Positiv, løsningsorientert og med gode samarbeidsevner.
  • Interesse for og kunnskap om kjønns- og seksualitetsmangfold.
  • Evne til å møte mennesker med respekt og åpenhet
  • Trygg i møte med komplekse faglige problemstillinger og ulike perspektiver.
  • Evne til å arbeide kunnskapsbasert og følge etablerte faglige retningslinjer.
  • Gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter, både i møte med klienter og i tverrfaglig samarbeid.
  • Evne til å stå trygt i et fagfelt som er under utvikling og gjenstand for offentlig debatt, samtidig som pasientsikkerhet og faglige retningslinjer ivaretas.
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.
Vi tilbyr
  • Du blir en del av en tverrfaglig og innovativ tjeneste som er unik i sitt slag!
  • Veiledning og samarbeid med ledende fagpersoner innen kjønnsmangfold, kjønnsbekreftende hormonbehandling, medisin og sexologi.
  • Fleksibel arbeidstid og mulighet for hjemmekontor.
  • Timelønn etter Oslo kommunes lønnsregulativ

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bydel Grünerløkka er en sentrumsbydel med et rikt kulturliv og sosialt mangfold. 

Bydelen er den største blant Oslos bydeler etter befolkningstall, med 64.000 innbyggere. Vi har store og solide fagmiljøer og tilbyr ulike tjenester rundt de viktigste rammene av innbyggernes liv. Bydel Grünerløkka legger vekt på brukermedvirkning og samhandling med innbyggere og andre offentlige og private aktører.

Vi ønsker ansatte som er ambisiøse på egne og samfunnets vegne. Våre ledere er opptatt av å legge til rette for gode utviklingsmuligheter.

Som ansatt i Bydel Grünerløkka vil du oppleve en inkluderende kultur med stor takhøyde og mye engasjement for hverandre og de vi jobber for.

Våre ledere og ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss, uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, kjønnsidentitet, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn.

title: Gruppeleder/erfaringskonsulent ved Helsestasjon for kjønn og seksualitet (HKS)
description:
Helsestasjon for kjønn og seksualitet (HKS) søker erfaringskonsulent og/eller terapeuter som kan organisere og gjennomføre deler av HKS sitt gruppetilbud. Vi gjennomfører gruppesamlinger ca annenhver uke på ettermiddag/kveldstid, med et omfang på ca 3-4 timer per gang. Man lønnes på timebasis basert på faktisk arbeidede timer. Stillingen er avhengig av prosjektfinansiering.

Vi ser etter trygge og engasjerte terapeuter og/eller erfaringskonsulenter som ønsker å bidra til å skape et trygt og bekreftende miljø. Vi har særlig behov for leder for grupper til transfeminine for øyeblikket. Vi legger vekt på å skape gode sosiale møteplasser, der personer med kjønnsinkongruens får utveksle erfaringer, og får en møteplass med stor takhøyde og rom for å være seg selv. Gruppeleders oppgave er å ivareta, støtte og styre gruppene og skape et trygt rom der deltakerne kan få positive erfaringer. Det er rom for å sette eget preg på gruppene. Vi ønsker at du som søker har en særlig interesse for og erfaring med å jobbe i miljøer med kjønns- og seksualitetsmangfold. Erfaring med gruppeledelse er en fordel. Du blir del  av et team med andre gruppeledere.

HKS består av et tverrfaglig team med spesialkompetanse innen sexologisk rådgivning. Fagteamet er satt sammen av helsesykepleiere, familieterapeut, vernepleier, psykologer, lege og endokrinolog. Sammen møter vi barn og unge opp til 30 år med ulike behov knyttet til kjønnsidentitet, seksualitet og minoritetsstress. Vi tilbyr samtaler, korttidsterapi, gruppetilbud, samt støtte til foreldre og nettverk. Som lavterskeltilbud er vi opptatt av å møte mennesker der de er, med faglig trygghet, åpenhet og fleksibilitet.

Les mer om oss på www.hksoslo.no 

  
Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Planlegge og lede gruppetilbud
  • Tilby unge opp til 30 år et trygt sted hvor de kan utforske tanker og erfaringer, knytte vennskap og få rom til å påvirke gruppene
  • Være en faglig og sosial ressurs i gruppeteamet
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Har relevant erfaring fra arbeid med ungdom eller unge voksne
  • Har kompetanse og erfaring innen sexologi og/eller kjønns- og seksualitetsmangfold
  • Har erfaring med å lede grupper og/eller prosjekter
  • Har kompetanse på minoritetsstress
Personlige egenskaper
  • Trives med å jobbe både selvstendig og i team
  • Er strukturert, fleksibel og har egne ideer
  • Har gode muntlige formidlingsevner
  • Er åpen, varm og empatisk
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.
 Vi tilbyr
  • En spennende mulighet til å jobbe i et unikt, byomfattende lavterskeltilbud for barn, ungdom og unge voksne
  • Et sterkt tverrfaglig fagmiljø med høy kompetanse innen kjønns-, seksualitets- og psykisk helse
  • Engasjerte kolleger som er opptatt av faglig utvikling, samarbeid og gode menneskemøter
  • Timelønn i henhold til Oslo kommunes lønnsregulativ

title: Mobile Lead
description:
Led et mobilteam som utfordrer tech-gigantene!


Jotta Group er en norsk teknologi-scaleup bak Jottacloud, Min Sky og white-label-skyløsninger for europeiske partnere som Telenor og Elkjøp. Siden 2008 har vi vokst til nesten to millioner direkte brukere og er i dag ett av få reelle europeiske alternativer i et marked dominert av globale teknologigiganter. Vi lagrer data i Norge under strenge norske og europeiske personvernregler, på vår egen infrastruktur i Stavanger, drevet av 100 % fornybar energi.

Med dagens geopolitiske realiteter er tryggheten vi lover mer relevant enn noensinne og mobilopplevelsen er avgjørende for at vi holder posisjonen og tar nye markedsandeler. Vi søker nå en Mobile Lead til å eie og videreutvikle den.

Hva du vil gjøre

Som Mobile Lead leder du ett samlet mobilteam med dedikerte iOS- og Android-utviklere, og rapporterer direkte til CTO. Du vil blant annet:

  • Eie teknisk retning og arkitektur for mobilplattformene, i tett samarbeid med seniorene på begge team

  • Ha ansvar for leveransekapasiteten – hva som bygges, og at det faktisk leveres

  • Drive videreutvikling av kjernefunksjoner som bilder, deling og filhåndtering

  • Sikre kvalitet i release-prosessen på begge plattformer

  • Bygge et team med sterk kultur og tydelig eierskap

  • Representere mobilperspektivet i strategiske diskusjoner og jobbe tett med produkt og design

  • Bidra til å forme hvordan vi jobber som produktselskap – vi er på god vei, men du får reell mulighet til å sette avtrykk

  • Bruke AI aktivt i eget arbeid og bidra til at teamet utnytter mulighetene, både i produktene og i arbeidsprosessene



Er dette deg?Ledererfaring

  • Du har reell ledererfaring med personalansvar og vet hva det innebærer å bygge kultur, følge opp folk og skape effektive team

  • Du er vant til å eie produkter fra problem til leveranse og motiveres av at millioner av mennesker faktisk bruker det vi bygger

  • Du tar eierskap og har selvtillit, men lite ego og lar andre skinne

Teknisk bakgrunn

  • Du har bakgrunn som mobilutvikler og kjenner plattformene godt nok til å forstå avveiningene teamet står i, stille de riktige spørsmålene og ta gode beslutninger

  • Appene våre er native – Swift på iOS og Kotlin på Android – og du er komfortabel nok i begge verdener til å lede på tvers

  • Du trenger ikke være den dypeste eksperten på hver plattform; vi har sterke seniorer på begge team som eier mye av den tekniske retningen, og du vet når du skal lene deg på dem

  • Du er trygg på moderne utviklingspraksis som CI/CD, testautomatisering og observability

Måten du jobber på

  • Du er AI-native/positiv og bruker det aktivt i hverdagen – og er genuint nysgjerrig på hvordan teamet kan få mer ut av det, både i det vi bygger og i hvordan vi jobber

  • Norsk er arbeidsspråket vårt, men du kommuniserer godt på engelsk

Ekstra pluss

  • Erfaring med mobilprodukter i stor skala

  • Kjennskap til sky, lagring eller infrastrukturdomenet

  • Bakgrunn med bilder, backup eller forbrukerrettede produkter



Hvorfor Jotta?

  • Fullt eierskap til mobilområdet i et selskap med nesten to millioner brukere og en lagringsplattform i rask vekst

  • Kort vei fra idé til lansert programvare, med direkte linje til CTO og resten av lederteamet

  • Et stabilt og lønnsomt selskap som har bygget stein for stein mot ett tydelig mål: å bli det europeiske alternativet

  • Hybrid arbeidshverdag fra sentrale kontorer i Oslo eller Trondheim

  • 7 + 3 % pensjon og 7 ekstra feriedager i tillegg til lovpålagt ferie



Vil du lede mobilopplevelsen til det europeiske alternativet?
Ta kontakt med Marte for en uforpliktende prat

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Jottacloud is a Norwegian cloud storage service for both private use and businesses. The service lets you securely copy, synchronize, save and share files from all of your devices. These files will be safely stored on environmentally friendly servers in Norway or in countries with equivalent or even more rigorous privacy laws. Firms based in the US might be forced to hand over their stored information to the authorities. No one will get access to the data stored with us. Jotta is the name of the company behind the service. Founded in 2008, today we are located in central Oslo and consist of twelve employees. The name “Jotta” is based on the “Yottabyte” which is one trillion Terabytes. The “cloud” is the term used to denote storing and sharing files on the internet.

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
What you’ll do

    • Own the end-to-end relationship for a portfolio of clients, ensuring retention and strong stakeholder trust.

    • Manage renewals and support moderate growth opportunities within defined commercial frameworks.

    • Guide Project Managers to ensure smooth delivery and consistent quality across engagements.

    • Monitor account health, revenue performance, and provide forecasting inputs to senior leadership.

    • Identify and resolve risks early, acting as the main point of escalation for your accounts.

    • Translate customer goals into clear, structured creative programs.

    • Use performance data and insights to support QBRs and renewal conversations.

    • Maintain a strong understanding of Superside’s services to identify value-driving opportunities.

    • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on delivery and account strategy.


What you'll need to succeed

    • 5+ years of experience in account management or client services within creative, digital, or professional services environments.

    • Experience managing and retaining client accounts with ownership of renewals.

    • Ability to lead commercial conversations within defined pricing and deal structures.

    • Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience working with senior clients.

    • Ability to balance strategic thinking with day-to-day execution.

    • Experience working with cross-functional teams such as Project Managers and Producers.

    • Comfort using data to inform account decisions and forecasting.

    • Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to connect delivery to business outcomes. 


Why Join us?
Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are.
Remote-first. Customer-led.Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones.Global team, local impact.Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands.High performance, low ego.Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration.Impact meets opportunity.We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here.Grow fast. Lead well.You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry.
About Superside
Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance. Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones.
Learn more at superside.com
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
We’re an equal-opportunity company. All applicants will be considered regardless of ethnicity, appearance, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Superside revolutionizes the global design industry by building new tech and data science-driven processes that enable distributed teams to work together much more efficiently and robust. We deliver high-velocity on-demand design to enterprises, with a data-driven and meritocratic mindset unlike any other platform or service. Superside is pioneering the future of remote work with a tech-enabled platform that creates super efficiencies and advantages workers by way of fostering community and greater income predictability with flexible work and stable wages. Our mission is to shape the global labor market; by having a fair and transparent labor platform that is great for both remote workers and enterprise customers. We currently have more than 100 creatives spanning six continents, 58 countries, and 19 timezones, and we work mainly with major US-based brands, including Tiffany & Co, Amazon, Cisco, L’Oreal and others. We have hub offices in Oslo, Toronto and Cape Town but are essentially based nowhere. We are remote-first with team members spread across the world. Superside was founded in late 2015 and became the first Norwegian company to join the Y Combinator accelerator in Palo Alto, California. We have since received funding from reputable Silicon Valley investors Freestyle Venture, High Alpha, Slack Fund, Sam Altman, Alliance Venture, and others. We're always-on and chase the sun to deliver the moon!

title: Today Mobility vokser – vi søker flere deltidssjåfører
description:
Vil du være med når vi videreutvikler Today Mobility på det norske markedet? Vi opplever sterk vekst og økende etterspørsel, og søker nå flere sjåfører som vil være med på reisen videre.
Å starte hos oss nå gir deg muligheten til å komme tidlig inn i en organisasjon i utvikling, og for deg som viser engasjement, finnes det gode muligheter for videre utvikling.
Om rollen
Som sjåfør hos oss jobber du hovedsakelig i og rundt Oslo. Du kjører biler mellom forhandlere, kunder og samarbeidspartnere, og sørger for at riktig bil er på riktig sted til riktig tid. Du blir en viktig del av en logistikkflyt som får bilbransjen til å fungere effektivt.

Stillingen er i utgangspunktet en 50 % deltidsstilling, men for den rette kandidaten vil det være gode muligheter og fleksibilitet til å øke stillingsprosenten opp mot 75 %. Arbeidstiden vil variere, men du må ha mulighet til å jobbe kveldstid frem til kl. 20.00. Stillingen passer derfor perfekt for eksempelvis studenter, eller deg som ønsker en fleksibel hverdag ved siden av andre prosjekter.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har gyldig førerkort klasse B (manuell) og en trygg kjørestil

  • Kan jobbe ettermiddager og kvelder (frem til kl. 20.00)

  • Tar ansvar og jobber selvstendig

  • Trives i et miljø med tempo og varierte dager

  • Er løsningsorientert og opptatt av god kundeservice

  • Kommuniserer godt og er komfortabel med digitale verktøy

Hvorfor Today Mobility:

  • Fast deltidsstilling (50 % med mulighet for opptil 75 %)

  • Samarbeid med ledende aktører i bilbransjen

  • Struktur, rutiner og støtte i hverdagen

  • Opplæring og oppfølging for at du skal lykkes

  • Reelle muligheter for utvikling videre

Flere av våre sjåfører har gått videre til roller hos forhandlere, leasingaktører eller internt hos oss. For de som tar ansvar og viser initiativ, åpner det seg muligheter.

Praktisk informasjon

  • Stilling: Deltid (50 % – 75 %)

  • Arbeidstid: Varierende, inkluderer kveldsarbeid frem til kl. 20.00

  • Lønn: Etter avtale / timelønn basert på stillingsprosent

  • Oppstart: Snarest / etter avtale

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Today Mobility provides consumer-centric first and last mile logistics to the automotive industry. Our drivers pick up and deliver cars to and from workshops and dealerships all over Sweden whether it be for a Test Drive, New/Used car delivery or for a routine Workshop visit. So far we've delivered over 150,000 cars, and are working with Sweden's largest car manufacturers and dealers as they transition to online sales and service channels. Our vision is simple - to make car ownership simpler, more convenient and sustainable.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Production Suite
description:
About Six Robotics

At Six Robotics, we build intelligent software that gives Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) the ability to collaborate, adapt on the fly, and execute missions that were previously impossible. From our base in Oslo, our 70+ experts in defence, software, and AI develop our flagship autonomy and swarm platform used by both government and industry. In close partnership with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI), we move fast from concept to live deployment, often in the field alongside end users.

We work with advanced hardware and software, a modern tech stack, and missions that demand both technical mastery and operational discipline. Everyone is close to the action, from deep technical problem-solving to field operations. We move fast and value clarity, integrity, and teamwork in everything we do.

At Six Robotics, every person executes with precision, adapts to changing conditions, and strengthens the team. Getting in is hard, and you’ll be challenged every day. But if you have the skill, the discipline, and the drive to push your limits and always be sharpening your blade, you’ll find no better place to deliver real-world impact while collaborating and learning from the best in the field.

About The Role

We are setting up a new team to build our Production Suite: the software product that gets our autonomy platform onto new drone hardware. This is not about assembling the physical drone. It is about everything that has to happen in software once the hardware is built, so a finished drone leaves production running on our stack.

As we move toward supporting production volumes in the thousands, installing our software on a new platform needs to become a high quality workflow someone runs at the production site, not something that pulls on engineering capacity per unit. Production Suite is how we get there.

It ships alongside each new release of our autonomy stack and wraps installation, configuration, acceptance testing, and sign-off into a guided flow.

The work is less about deep architecture and more about getting a lot of moving parts to work together cleanly: software packaging, deployment to edge devices, test automation, Linux plumbing, and an operator experience reliable enough that a non-engineer at a production site can run it on their own.

We are looking for several engineers to join this team early. As one of the first in, you will help shape what we build and how we build it. You will have a broad responsibility from low-level flashing and test orchestration up to the interface the production operator actually interacts with.

What You Will Do

  • Build the Production Suite: a software package that ships to a production site and takes a drone from factory-fresh hardware to a unit running our autonomy stack and passing acceptance

  • Design and implement the tooling that flashes our software onto new drone platforms, configures it, runs factory acceptance tests, and reports results back to Operations

  • Work across the stack as needed: Linux command line, Python scripting, Docker and Kubernetes, SSH and remote execution, web APIs, data formats, basic hooks and integrations

  • Reuse and adapt parts of our existing end-to-end test suite so factory acceptance tests share a foundation with how we test in engineering

  • Make the whole thing usable for production operators: clear enough that the workflow is mostly pressing next, red or green, with no hidden steps

  • Work closely with Operations, Test Automation, Hardware Enablement, and the teams building the autonomy stack itself to keep integration reliable end to end

Why This Role Matters

Production Suite is one of the pieces of work where getting it wrong directly caps how much of our core product reaches the field. If we cannot scale production, we cannot scale the company. This team sits on the critical path for delivering volume, and the people we hire into this role will have an outsized effect on whether we hit it.

What we are looking for

We are open to varieties of seniority in this team. Generally, we are looking for a broad, practical senior engineer. Someone who has built this kind of system before, or something close to it, and knows what good looks like when hardware, software, and a factory floor have to work together.

You are not scared of the mix. You move between Python, a Dockerfile, a Kubernetes manifest, an SSH session, and a JSON-to-YAML conversion without losing the thread.

You are pragmatic. You care more about shipping something that works than about the purest architecture.

We believe the right candidate brings

  • Several years of experience as a software engineer, ideally at companies that ship physical products (hardware, robotics, consumer electronics, networking, industrial devices)

  • Comfort on the Linux command line

  • Ability to move around a modern tooling landscape (containers, orchestration, CI/CD, remote execution, scripting) without needing deep expertise in any one of them. If you have not used Docker or Kubernetes heavily but can pick them up where needed, that works for us

  • Exposure to deploying software onto devices or edge hardware, not only to servers or the cloud

  • A tooling mindset: you notice manual work, you automate what you do twice, you think in pipelines and feedback loops

  • A strong drive to solve problems and find a way through, even when the path is not obvious and the spec is not clean. This matters more to us than any specific tool on your CV

  • Ability to own problems from end to end and work across team boundaries

  • Clear communication in English, written and spoken

It is an advantage if you have:

  • Worked on production, provisioning, or manufacturing tooling at a hardware company before

  • Experience with Python in an infrastructure or tooling context (this will be a large part of the day-to-day, but we do not require it up front)

  • Background in edge deployment, factory acceptance testing, or device lifecycle management

  • Exposure to operator-facing GUI or workflow tools

  • Exposure to safety-critical, defence, or regulated environments

  • We care more about range and judgement than about a specific stack. If you come from Go, Rust, or something else entirely but have built this kind of system well, we want to talk to you.

Why You Should Join

At Six Robotics, we're not just building software - we're redefining how unmanned systems operate in the real world. If you're driven by meaningful problems, technical depth, and the chance to shape something from the ground up, you'll find your place here.

  • Work on problems that matter

    Our technology helps unlock smarter, safer, and more adaptable UAV operations in defense and industry, solving real challenges with direct, tangible impact.

  • Lead the shift in a hardware-dominated space

    We're bringing modern AI, autonomy, and scalable software into a field that's long relied on rigid, pre-programmed systems, to change how UAVs are designed, deployed, and managed.

  • Build from zero, shape the future

    Join early and help define the core systems, tools, and culture of a company that’s still being built - where your ideas, code, and decisions will have a lasting influence.

Our Recruitment Process

Reference check followed by an offer if everything goes well.
We consider applications continuously, so don't hold off with applying if this looks interesting.

Our Commitment to Inclusion
At Six Robotics, we are committed to creating a workplace built on respect, integrity, and collaboration. title: Senior Software Engineer, Build Systems
description:
At Six Robotics, we build intelligent software that gives Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) the ability to collaborate, adapt on the fly, and execute missions that were previously impossible. From our base in Oslo, our 90+ experts in defence, software, and AI develop our flagship autonomy and swarm platform used by both government and industry. In close partnership with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI), we move fast from concept to live deployment, often in the field alongside end users.


We work with advanced hardware and software, a modern tech stack, and missions that demand both technical mastery and operational discipline. Everyone is close to the action, from deep technical problem-solving to field operations. We move fast and value clarity, integrity, and teamwork in everything we do.


At Six Robotics, every person executes with precision, adapts to changing conditions, and strengthens the team. Getting in is hard, and you’ll be challenged every day. But if you have the skill, the discipline, and the drive to push your limits, you’ll find no better place to deliver real-world impact while collaborating and learning from the best in the field.


About The Role

Six Robotics has run a monorepo since day one as a deliberate strategy to position us for robust and rapid scaling. We've built strong tooling around it and we're ahead of most companies our age on developer infrastructure. As we scale toward hundreds of engineers, we need a full-time specialist to take it to the next level.

You will join Team Factory, which builds the internal infrastructure and tooling that engineering depends on. As a Senior Build Engineer, you will be the key contributor to the architecture and direction of our build system across our heterogeneous codebase spanning C++, Rust, TypeScript, Python, OS images, GPGPU, and AI build chains. Your focus: fine-grained internal dependency tracking, aggressive caching, smart orchestration, and shorter build times. You will also design the opinionated build interfaces that let every other team integrate their code without becoming build experts themselves.

This is a hands-on role with broad architectural authority. It's also a foundational hire for the Factory team, complementing and extending our competence on developer experience.

What You Will Do

  • Run the technical review to pick a new build stack (Bazel, Buck2, Pants, or similar), and integrate it with existing monorepo tooling.

  • Design high-level, opinionated build interfaces that give feature teams a consistent and expressive way to integrate their code, without requiring them to become build experts.

  • Improve caching, orchestration, and remote execution in our existing self-hosted CI and HiL testing infrastructure.

  • Set the engineering defaults that every team inherits, with an eye toward correctness, reproducibility, and developer experience.

  • Spot the next high-leverage improvements and bring concrete proposals; What to do, what it achieves, why now, what it takes.

  • Be the in-house expert on build systems, and bring the rest of engineering along.


What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a senior, hands-on Build Engineer who has scaled a monorepo before and can address the bottlenecks before they hit us.

Unfamiliar tech stacks don't slow you down. You treat the rest of engineering as your end users, and value nothing higher.

You drive complex technical work forward independently, from design through to production-quality, maintainable solutions, knowing when to involve stakeholders and when to pull in domain experts.

You bring

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 4 years focused on build systems, developer infrastructure, or developer productivity at scale.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one scalable heterogeneous build system, such as Bazel, Buck2 or Pants.

  • Experience scaling a monorepo to hundreds of developers, and a clear understanding of where things break.

  • Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and modern CI/CD.

  • Strong software engineering defaults and a developer-experience mindset, naturally drawn to ideas like pit of success and least astonishment.

  • The ability to quickly produce idiomatic solutions using unfamiliar tools.


    Nice to have

  • Understanding of C++ build systems.

  • Deep understanding of GitHub Actions customization.

  • Experience with HiL test orchestration at scale.

  • Background in automotive, autonomy, robotics, defence-tech, or other industries with similarly heterogeneous codebases.


Why You Should Join

At Six Robotics, we're not just building software - we're redefining how unmanned systems operate in the real world. If you're driven by meaningful problems, technical depth, and the chance to shape something from the ground up, you'll find your place here.

  • Work on problems that matter

    Our technology helps unlock smarter, safer, and more adaptable UAV operations in defense and industry, solving real challenges with direct, tangible impact.

  • Lead the shift in a hardware-dominated space

    We're bringing modern AI, autonomy, and scalable software into a field that's long relied on rigid, pre-programmed systems, to change how UAVs are designed, deployed, and managed.

  • Build from zero, shape the future

    Join early and help define the core systems, tools, and culture of a company that’s still being built - where your ideas, code, and decisions will have a lasting influence.

  • Work with purpose, supported by great benefits

    You'll be part of a mission-driven team that values clarity, integrity, and collaboration, offering competitive pay, equity potential, strong insurance and pension plans, and ongoing learning opportunities.

Our Recruitment Process

  1. Screening interview with one of our recruiters to get to know you better (30 min)

  2. Meet & Greet with someone from the team to learn more about us (60 min)

  3. Technical home assignment, ability and personality tests, and a technical interview focused on the specifics of the role (90 min)

  4. Final interview with the engineering lead and Head of People (45 min)

Security Clearance Requirement

All employees at Six Robotics are required to undergo a security clearance due to our close collaboration with the Norwegian Armed Forces. While prior clearance is not necessary, the clearance process will be initiated as part of onboarding.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
About Falkor

We build industrial intelligence software for heavy-asset sectors. As a KONGSBERG company backed by over 200 years of heritage, Falkor helps the energy, chemicals, utilities and other industrial sectors operate with absolute clarity, confidence, and control.

Our AI-enabled platform connects people, systems, and workflows—expanding human capability by turning complex data into real-time, actionable decisions. We help leading organizations improve safety, efficiency and performance while redefining how heavy assets are designed and operated.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join the Infrastructure team within our Platform product area. You will play a key role in designing, building, and operating a modern, cloud-native, AI-ready platform that supports data-intensive and AI-enabled services in production.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role with high autonomy and ownership. You will work closely with product, data, and software engineering teams to ensure the platform is reliable, scalable, secure, and easy to operate over time. The role is intended for engineers who are motivated by long-term platform evolution and have a strong background in software development to build internal platforms, tools, and services that improve developer productivity and operational efficiency.

You will help design and build the systems, services, and developer platforms that form the foundation of our technology ecosystem and enable future AI-driven innovation.

Key ResponsibilitiesPlatform Infrastructure

• Design, build, and operate cloud-native infrastructure across Microsoft Azure and other cloud platforms

• Provision and manage infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Pulumi, Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates)

• Operate and optimise Kubernetes platforms (AKS) in production

• Own platform reliability, performance, security, and cost efficiency

• Share responsibility for platform stability and operational health, contributing to prevention, analysis, and continuous improvement

• Maintain clear, practical technical documentation and operational runbooks

• Apply security-by-design principles at platform level, including IAM, RBAC, network policies, and workload isolation

Software Engineering

• Design, develop, and maintain production-quality internal platforms, tools, and services that improve developer productivity and operational efficiency

• Write clean, maintainable code in at least one modern programming language such as Python, Go, Java, C#, or TypeScript

• Work closely with data and application teams to translate workload needs into robust platform solutions

• Contribute to building scalable, well-tested systems that other teams can rely on

Kubernetes and Container Platforms

• Manage container orchestration using Kubernetes, including deployment, scaling, and network configuration

• Package and deploy workloads using Helm

• Troubleshoot platform-level issues related to containers and orchestration

• Support data-intensive platform components and stateful services at infrastructure level

Monitoring, Observability and Operations

• Implement and maintain monitoring and observability using Azure Monitor, Mimir, Grafana, Tempo, or similar tools

• Build and evolve logging and telemetry pipelines to improve operational insight

• Reduce operational noise and improve system understanding through telemetry-driven analysis

CI/CD and Automation

• Integrate platform capabilities with CI/CD and GitOps workflows

• Use tools such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Argo CD, or Flux

• Promote automation-first approaches across platform operations

Required Experience and Skills

• Strong experience operating cloud-native platforms in production

• Solid hands-on expertise with Kubernetes and Azure

• Strong software development experience with at least one modern programming language (Python, Go, Java, C#, TypeScript, etc.)

• Experience designing, developing, and maintaining production software systems

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code tooling

• Good understanding of platform operations, automation, and observability

• Ability to write maintainable automation scripts (PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar)

• Strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative mindset

• Fluency in English, written and spoken

Desirable Experience

• Experience supporting AI or ML workloads in production

• Exposure to GitOps, service mesh (e.g. Istio), or hybrid infrastructure

Work model: Hybrid (minimum 3 days per week in the office at Fornebu)

Why join Falkor?

You'll be joining a global technology company helping to redefine how complex industries operate.

At Falkor, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work on meaningful challenges with real-world impact

  • Collaborate with talented colleagues across technology and industry domains

  • Learn from experts in software, engineering, operations, and digital transformation

  • Grow your career in a business that is expanding globally

  • Help shape technology that expands human capability in complex industries

We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, included, and able to do their best work.

Ready to apply?

If you're excited about solving complex challenges and making an impact through technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your resume.

Agency notice

Falkor occasionally partners with selected recruitment agencies for specific hiring requirements. We do not accept unsolicited candidate submissions and will not be responsible for associated fees unless terms have been agreed in advance through our Procurement team.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Kongsberg Digital, our mission is to transform the world’s most complex and asset-intensive industries through world-leading, AI-powered digital twin technology. As a pioneer in industrial digitalization, we provide a comprehensive suite of software solutions that empower organizations to manage the full lifecycle of their assets—more efficiently, safely, and sustainably than ever before. The industry is on the cusp of a digital revolution—and we’re leading the charge. From early adoption of AI to building trusted partnerships with some of the world’s largest industrial players, we are redefining how work gets done. With domain expertise baked into every line of code and a high-calibre team united by a clear mission, we’re not just keeping pace with change—we’re setting the standard. As we expand rapidly across the Middle East and Africa, deepen our end-to-end offerings, and push the boundaries of AI, now is the perfect time to join a company that’s growing fast, thinking bold, and delivering real impact.

title: Sjåfør søkes deltid (Bergen)
description:
Vil du være med når vi videreutvikler Today Mobility på det norske markedet? Vi opplever sterk vekst og økende etterspørsel, og søker nå flere sjåfører som vil være med på reisen videre.

Å starte hos oss nå gir deg muligheten til å komme tidlig inn i en organisasjon i utvikling, og for deg som viser engasjement, finnes det gode muligheter for videre utvikling.
Om rollen

Som sjåfør hos oss jobber du hovedsakelig i og rundt Bergen. Du kjører biler mellom forhandlere, kunder og samarbeidspartnere, og sørger for at riktig bil er på riktig sted til riktig tid. Du blir en viktig del av en logistikkflyt som får bilbransjen til å fungere effektivt.

Stillingen er i utgangspunktet en 50 % deltidsstilling, men for den rette kandidaten vil det være gode muligheter og fleksibilitet til å øke stillingsprosenten opp mot 75 %. Arbeidstiden vil variere, men du må ha mulighet til å jobbe kveldstid frem til kl. 20.00. Stillingen passer derfor perfekt for eksempelvis studenter, eller deg som ønsker en fleksibel hverdag ved siden av andre prosjekter.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Har gyldig førerkort klasse B (manuell) og en trygg kjørestil

  • Kan jobbe ettermiddager og kvelder (frem til kl. 20.00)

  • Tar ansvar og jobber selvstendig

  • Trives i et miljø med tempo og varierte dager

  • Er løsningsorientert og opptatt av god kundeservice

  • Kommuniserer godt og er komfortabel med digitale verktøy

Hvorfor Today Mobility:

  • Fast deltidsstilling (50 % med mulighet for opptil 75 %)

  • Samarbeid med ledende aktører i bilbransjen

  • Struktur, rutiner og støtte i hverdagen

  • Opplæring og oppfølging for at du skal lykkes

  • Reelle muligheter for utvikling videre

Flere av våre sjåfører har gått videre til roller hos forhandlere, leasingaktører eller internt hos oss. For de som tar ansvar og viser initiativ, åpner det seg muligheter.

Praktisk informasjon

  • Stilling: Deltid (50 % – 75 %)

  • Arbeidstid: Varierende, inkluderer kveldsarbeid frem til kl. 20.00

  • Lønn: Etter avtale / timelønn basert på stillingsprosent

  • Oppstart: Snarest / etter avtale

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Today Mobility provides consumer-centric first and last mile logistics to the automotive industry. Our drivers pick up and deliver cars to and from workshops and dealerships all over Sweden whether it be for a Test Drive, New/Used car delivery or for a routine Workshop visit. So far we've delivered over 150,000 cars, and are working with Sweden's largest car manufacturers and dealers as they transition to online sales and service channels. Our vision is simple - to make car ownership simpler, more convenient and sustainable.

title: Lead Creative Strategist (Performance Marketing)
description:
Superside is hiring a Creative Strategist, Performance Marketing to lead the strategic thinking behind our clients' highest-volume, highest-velocity creative programs. You'll sit at the intersection of data and creative, turning performance signals from paid social, OOH, and programmatic campaigns into sharp, testable creative direction — while acting as a trusted strategic partner to the clients whose business results depend on it.

You'll run strategy across a portfolio of accounts at once, each producing a high volume of creative every month, and you'll be the person both the client and the creative team turn to when they need to know not just what to make next, but why.


What You'll Do
    • Lead creative strategy across a portfolio of client accounts simultaneously, each producing a high volume of ad creative every month, while maintaining a high bar for quality.\
    • Act as the primary strategic point of contact for clients — presenting creative recommendations, test results, and performance insights directly to marketing and brand stakeholders.
    • Analyze creative and campaign performance data (CTR, hook and hold rate, CPA, ROAS, and other channel-specific metrics) and translate findings into clear, insight-driven creative briefs.
    • Build and run testing frameworks that keep creative strategy iterating quickly based on live performance signals rather than instinct alone.
    • Develop and apply platform-specific strategy across paid social (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, Google, Etc.), out-of-home/DOOH, and programmatic/DSP environments, adapting recommendations to each channel's best practices, specs, and buying dynamics.
    • Partner closely with Creative Leads, Designers, Copywriters, and Motion Artists to turn insights into concepts that are built to perform, not just look good.
    • Build trusted, long-term relationships with clients, becoming a strategic partner they rely on rather than an order-taker.
    • Champion AI tools and workflows across the strategy process — from research and insight-gathering to concept testing and reporting.
    • Contribute to the growth of Superside's Performance Marketing strategy practice — sharing frameworks, benchmarks, and platform expertise across the wider Strategy team.

What You'll Need to Succeed
    • 5+ years of experience in creative strategy, performance marketing, or a related discipline at an agency, platform, or in-house marketing team.
    • A proven track record leading creative strategy for a high monthly volume of content — comfortable working in fast, iterative sprint cycles rather than one-off campaigns.
    • Experience managing creative strategy across multiple client accounts or brands at the same time, balancing competing priorities and deadlines.
    • Strong analytical skills — comfortable pulling and interpreting performance data from ads managers, analytics tools, and creative-analytics platforms to inform strategy.
    • A confident, polished communicator, able to present strategy and performance insights directly to clients and senior stakeholders.
    • Skilled at writing clear, insight-driven creative briefs that give creative teams a strong strategic foundation to work from.
    • A data-informed thinker who blends analytical rigor with creative instinct — equally at home in a spreadsheet and a brainstorm.
    • Organized and self-directed, able to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced, distributed environment.
    • Genuine enthusiasm for AI tools and their growing role in performance creative strategy.

Why Join us?
Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are.
Remote-first. Customer-led.Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones.Global team, local impact.Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands.High performance, low ego.Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration.Impact meets opportunity.We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here.Grow fast. Lead well.You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry.
About Superside
Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance. Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones.
Learn more at superside.com
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
We’re an equal-opportunity company. All applicants will be considered regardless of ethnicity, appearance, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Superside revolutionizes the global design industry by building new tech and data science-driven processes that enable distributed teams to work together much more efficiently and robust. We deliver high-velocity on-demand design to enterprises, with a data-driven and meritocratic mindset unlike any other platform or service. Superside is pioneering the future of remote work with a tech-enabled platform that creates super efficiencies and advantages workers by way of fostering community and greater income predictability with flexible work and stable wages. Our mission is to shape the global labor market; by having a fair and transparent labor platform that is great for both remote workers and enterprise customers. We currently have more than 100 creatives spanning six continents, 58 countries, and 19 timezones, and we work mainly with major US-based brands, including Tiffany & Co, Amazon, Cisco, L’Oreal and others. We have hub offices in Oslo, Toronto and Cape Town but are essentially based nowhere. We are remote-first with team members spread across the world. Superside was founded in late 2015 and became the first Norwegian company to join the Y Combinator accelerator in Palo Alto, California. We have since received funding from reputable Silicon Valley investors Freestyle Venture, High Alpha, Slack Fund, Sam Altman, Alliance Venture, and others. We're always-on and chase the sun to deliver the moon!

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
📍 Remote, based in Poland

About Us

At No Isolation, we’re a profitable, 65-person Scandinavian EdTech scale-up operating across Europe. We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child.

Our AV1 robot is deployed in 19 countries, with 5,000+ units supporting schools to improve attendance, belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.

We’re established enough to have a proven solution and strong financial foundations, yet still small enough for every new colleague to have a visible impact on our next stage of growth.

The Opportunity

Your purpose in this role is simple: help us grow by proactively identifying and approaching talented people who aren't actively looking, but would be a great fit if approached the right way. Our ability to hire the best people, fast, directly determines how quickly we can scale.

This role is mainly focused on proactive sourcing and candidate screening, with the possibility to also handle a few roles full-cycle (360), from brief through to offer and close. The hires will mainly be across Commercial and Operational teams, with possibility of some Tech and Product roles as well. We're looking for someone who can map our markets, build lasting candidate relationships, and give hiring managers a steady stream of great people to talk to — not a slow trickle of applicants.

What You'll Do

Proactive sourcing

  • Map our markets and proactively reach out to passive candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, job boards, and your network

  • Build talent pools for recurring or future hard-to-fill roles, and screen candidates for fit before progressing them

  • Keep our pipeline data in shape, track TA KPIs, and flag risks early

Full-cycle recruitment

  • Own a smaller share of roles end-to-end — from brief, through interviews, to offer and close

Alongside this, you'll partner with hiring managers to understand what they need and advise on candidate market insight, keep candidates engaged throughout the process, and craft and post job ads on relevant job boards.

What You Bring

  • 2–3 years in talent acquisition, recruitment, or proactive sourcing, with a genuine track record of engaging passive candidates

  • Experience across more than one European market

  • Fluent with LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, and ATS tools, and curious about using AI to work smarter

  • Confident stakeholder management

  • Excellent written and spoken English is required; working proficiency in German is an advantage

  • You are organised, persistent, and self-driven, able to juggle multiple roles and markets without dropping speed or quality, and comfortable with the healthy "chaos" of a scaling company

If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

Our Culture — Why You'll Love It Here

We're a Scandinavian company with a high-performance, caring culture. We set the bar high, and we back each other to get there.

  • Purpose with scale: You won't just be sourcing for any company — your work directly fuels a mission that keeps thousands of children connected, learning, and included

  • Big impact, real ownership: This is a scale-up, not a corporate machine. We start from a place of trust, so you'll have real ownership of your work from day one, with support from a highly experienced team

  • A genuine growth story: We're one of the few full-stack EdTech companies growing at our rate of profitability, and we've still only scratched the surface of the market. There is plenty of opportunity to grow alongside us, not just fill a seat

  • Highly collaborative and supportive: Regular in-person team meetings, an annual company trip, and people across departments happy to help you grow

  • Structured onboarding to get you up to speed quickly

How to Apply

Please click APPLY and upload your CV in English, and record a short video in English outlining your motivation and letting your personality shine through.

Location & Salary

📍 Remote, based in Poland.

We're unable to sponsor visas or work permits. Candidates must already have the legal right to work in Poland (e.g., EU/EEA citizenship, permanent residency, or an existing valid work permit).


🎥 Watch how AV1 transforms inclusion in education: AV1 Experiences

🌍 Explore our mission and impact stories: noisolation.com

We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child. School absence is the biggest challenge facing education. Our AV1 robots connect absent students, ensure learning and belonging, and support reintegration back to the classroom. Today, there are over 3,500 active AV1 robots used across 18 European countries. Positioned in the EdTech sector, AV1 is a unique solution to the growing issue of persistent absence, supporting both the academic and social needs of students. No Isolation works across Europe, with 45 employees across Europe and in offices in Oslo, Munich and London. Join us in our growth journey!

title: Von der Schule ins Customer Success Team: Schulische Abwesenheit überwinden und Teilhabe ermöglichen
description:
Verfügen Sie über Erfahrung im Bildungswesen (z. B. in der Schulleitung, im Rektorat oder als stellvertretende Schulleitung) und möchten Sie Ihren Einfluss auf Hunderte von Schulen, Kommunen und Schulträger ausweiten? Liegt es Ihnen am Herzen, Pädagogen dabei zu unterstützen, Schulabwesenheit mithilfe von Technologie zu begegnen? No Isolation sucht einen Customer Success Manager mit Ihrer Erfahrung für unser Team.

Wir wachsen in Deutschland, und da jedes Schulhalbjahr immer mehr Schulen, Kommunen und Schulbehörden auf AV1 umsteigen, brauchen wir jemanden, der das deutsche Bildungssystem von innen kennt und eine erfolgreiche Einführung und Nutzung unserer Technologie sicherstellen kann.

Viele unserer Teammitglieder verfügen bereits über Erfahrungen im schulischen Umfeld und bei lokalen Bildungsbehörden. Unsere Director of Customer Success, Simone, ist eine ausgebildete Lehrerin mit fast 30 Jahren Erfahrung. Sie war unter anderem als Lehrerin in leitender Funktion, Sonderpädagogin und Schulleiterin tätig, bevor sie ein Bildungsteam bei einer lokalen Behörde leitete. Sie müssen also gar nicht erst erklären, aus welch großartiger Welt Sie kommen.

Über uns

No Isolation ist ein profitables skandinavisches EdTech-Scale-up mit 65 Mitarbeitern, das europaweit tätig ist. Wir unterstützen Pädagogen dabei, jedem Kind Lernen und Zugehörigkeit zu ermöglichen.

Unser AV1-Roboter wird in 19 Ländern eingesetzt. Über 5.000 Geräte unterstützen Schulen dabei, die Anwesenheit, das Zugehörigkeitsgefühl und die Kontinuität des Lernens für Kinder zu verbessern, die nicht persönlich anwesend sein können. Er wird immer wieder als lebensverändernd beschrieben und überbrückt die Kluft zwischen dem Schüler und seinen Mitschülern, wodurch sowohl die Kontinuität des Lernens als auch das unverzichtbare Gefühl der sozialen Zugehörigkeit wiederhergestellt werden.

Wir sind etabliert genug, um über eine bewährte Lösung und eine solide finanzielle Grundlage zu verfügen, und dennoch klein genug, damit jeder neue Kollege einen spürbaren Einfluss auf unsere nächste Entwicklungsphase nehmen kann.

Warum diese Stelle wichtig ist:

✅ Helfen Sie Pädagogen dabei, eine der größten Herausforderungen zu bewältigen, vor denen das Bildungswesen heute steht.

✅ Bewirken Sie nachhaltige Veränderungen für Kinder, die nicht zur Schule gehen können.

✅ Werden Sie Teil eines Unternehmens, in dem Ihre Arbeit geschätzt wird, Ihre Meinung zählt und Ihr Wohlbefinden an erster Stelle steht.

Die Stelle — Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)

Dies ist mehr als nur ein Job. Es ist eine Chance, gemeinsam mit Pädagogen, Schulen, Kommunen und Schulämtern in Deutschland das Problem des Schulversäumnisses anzugehen – eine der größten Herausforderungen, vor denen das Bildungswesen heute steht. Indem Sie ihnen bei der Einführung von AV1 helfen, ermöglichen Sie abwesenden Schülern, den Anschluss an den Unterricht zu behalten und sich weiterhin als Teil der Gemeinschaft zu fühlen, und unterstützen gleichzeitig ihre erfolgreiche Rückkehr in den Unterricht.

Weltweit haben wir Pädagogen bereits dabei unterstützt, über 15.000 Schülern den Wiedereinstieg in die Schule zu ermöglichen. In dieser Funktion werden Sie diese Wirkung auf eine ausgewählte Region in Deutschland ausweiten. Konkret bedeutet das:

  • Sie bauen vertrauensvolle Partnerschaften mit Schulen, Kommunen und Bildungsbehörden auf und werden zu einem geschätzten Berater bei der Bekämpfung von Schulversäumnissen und dabei, Kunden zu langfristigem Erfolg mit AV1 zu verhelfen.

  • Sie begleiten unsere Kunden bei der Einführung und Implementierung von AV1, definieren Erfolgskennzahlen und stellen sicher, dass sie den vollen Nutzen aus AV1 ziehen.

  • Sie werden zum führenden Experten für AV1 und beraten zu Best Practices, Change Management sowie dazu, wie die Akzeptanz und Wirkung maximiert werden können.

  • Sie arbeiten eng mit unseren Account Managern zusammen, um Führungskräfte und Entscheidungsträger im Bildungsbereich einzubinden, Möglichkeiten zur Ausweitung der Nutzung von AV1 in Schulen, Schulverbänden, Kommunalbehörden und Regionen zu identifizieren und strategische Kundengespräche zu unterstützen.

  • Sie bringen bei jeder Interaktion Glaubwürdigkeit, Einblicke und Einfühlungsvermögen mit und helfen Pädagogen dabei, nachhaltige Wirkung zu erzielen, während Sie gleichzeitig die Reichweite von AV1 in ganz Deutschland stärken.

Auf der Grundlage Ihrer Erfahrung im Bildungswesen werden Sie dafür sorgen, dass AV1 nicht nur eine Technologie ist, sondern ein sinnvolles Instrument zur Inklusion innerhalb des deutschen Bildungssystems. Ihre Erkenntnisse aus der Praxis – was funktioniert, womit Schulen zu kämpfen haben, in welche Richtung sich das deutsche Bildungssystem entwickelt – werden uns dabei helfen, unsere Unterstützung für Schulen kontinuierlich zu verbessern und uns an die sich wandelnde Bildungslandschaft anzupassen.

Das bringen Sie mit — Erfahrung und Kompetenzen

Wenn Sie über mindestens 10 Jahre Erfahrung im Bildungsbereich verfügen, idealerweise teilweise in einer Führungsposition, und neugierig darauf sind, wie Sie mit Ihrem Fachwissen über den traditionellen Unterricht hinaus etwas bewirken können, könnte dies die richtige Gelegenheit für Sie sein.

Sie bringen Glaubwürdigkeit, Einfühlungsvermögen und Struktur in jedes Gespräch ein und scheuen sich nicht davor, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Wahrscheinlich erkennen Sie sich in den folgenden Punkten wieder:

  • Bildungshintergrund: Erfahrung im Unterricht, in der Schulleitung, in beratenden Funktionen, im Bereich Inklusion oder in der Schulentwicklung – idealerweise als erfahrene Fachkraft (z. B. in Funktionen in der Schulleitung, im Rektorat oder als stellvertretende Schulleitung).

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse des deutschen Bildungssystems, insbesondere der länderspezifischen Strukturen, Schulträger und Kommunen.

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Schulen, Kommunen oder Bildungsbehörden auf Leitungsebene.

  • Fähigkeit, sich sowohl in pädagogischen als auch in administrativen Kontexten zurechtzufinden.

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachenniveau oder nahezu muttersprachlich (C1/C2) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Eine proaktive, lösungsorientierte Denkweise und echte Leidenschaft für inklusive Bildung.

Was wir bieten

  • Wirkung über einzelne Schulen und Klassenzimmer hinaus: Sie sind weiterhin im Bildungsbereich tätig und gestalten nach wie vor, wie Kinder Lernen und Zugehörigkeit erleben – nur aus einer anderen Perspektive und in einem größeren Maßstab als jede einzelne Schule.

  • Wenig Bürokratie: Weniger Papierkram, mehr Zeit, um tatsächlich etwas im Bildungssektor zu bewirken.

  • Eine sinnstiftende skandinavische Kultur: Wir fühlen uns unserer Mission zutiefst verpflichtet. Wir setzen hohe Maßstäbe und unterstützen uns gegenseitig mit aufrichtiger Fürsorge. Sie werden Teil eines Teams, das Ihnen den Freiraum gibt, Ihre beste Arbeit zu leisten.

  • Ein Team aus Bildungsexperten: Sie berichten an unsere Director of Customer Success, Simone, eine erfahrene Schulleiterin, und sind Teil eines sehr erfahrenen Customer-Success-Teams mit fundiertem pädagogischem Hintergrund. Sie arbeiten eng mit Kollegen in unseren Büros in Oslo, München und London zusammen.

  • Ressourcen für Ihren Erfolg: Wir sorgen dafür, dass Sie erfolgreich arbeiten könnenunseren Vertriebs-, Marketing- und Produktteams zusammen, sodass Sie über die Materialien und die Unterstützung verfügen, die Sie benötigen, um Schulen zum Erfolg zu verhelfen.

  • Unbegrenzte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem wachsenden Unternehmen: Als Scale-up entwickeln wir uns ständig weiter. Das gibt Ihnen die Möglichkeit, neue Herausforderungen anzunehmen, Ihre Rolle auszubauen und im Zuge unserer Expansion wirklich etwas zu bewirken.

  • Flexibilität, die Ihre Erfahrungen wertschätzt: Remote-Arbeit zur Unterstützung eines nachhaltigen Lebensstils mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten rund um die Kernzeiten (10:00–15:00 Uhr).

  • Ein Bonussystem.

  • Kostenübernahme für das Deutschlandticket.

  • Kostenübernahme für Mobilfunk und Internet.

  • Auto-Leasing über Entgeltumwandlung (JobAuto).

  • Regelmäßige Betriebsfeiern und eine gemeinsame Jahresreise.

Jede Partnerschaft, die Sie aufbauen, und jede Umsetzung, die Sie leiten, hilft Schulen dabei, die Auswirkungen von Schulversäumnissen zu verringern. Durch AV1 ermöglichen Sie es mehr Kindern, den Anschluss an das Lernen zu behalten und sich zugehörig zu fühlen, und unterstützen gleichzeitig ihre erfolgreiche Rückkehr in den Unterricht.

Standort & Praktische Informationen

Standort: Standort: Deutschland: mit Verantwortung für eine noch zu definierende Region.

Die Tätigkeit wird überwiegend im Homeoffice ausgeübt, beinhaltet jedoch regelmäßige Reisen zu Kunden und Partnern in der gesamten Region.

So bewerben Sie sich

Wenn Sie sich weiterhin in einer neuen Funktion für den Bildungssektor engagieren möchten – in einer Rolle, in der Sie mit Ihrem Fachwissen Schulen dabei unterstützen, echte Inklusion zu verwirklichen –, dann ist dies Ihre Chance, eine Führungsrolle zu übernehmen, und wir würden uns sehr freuen, von Ihnen zu hören.

Bitte klicken Sie auf „Bewerben“ und laden Sie Ihren Lebenslauf in englischer Sprache hoch.

Gerne können Sie Ihrer Bewerbung ein kurzes Video in englischer Sprache beifügen (optional) – eine großartige Möglichkeit, Ihre Persönlichkeit über den Lebenslauf hinaus zu zeigen.

🎥 Hier sehen Sie, wie AV1 Inklusion im Bildungswesen verändert hier und hier.

title: Head of Sales (Nordics)
description:
About Us

At No Isolation, we’re a profitable, 65-person Norwegian EdTech scale-up operating across Europe. We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child.

Our AV1 robot is deployed in 19 countries, with 5,000+ units supporting schools to improve attendance, belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.

We’re established enough to have a proven solution and strong financial foundations, yet still small enough for every new colleague to have a visible impact on our next stage of growth.

The Opportunity - Head of Sales, Nordics

The Nordics are where it started, and it still contains some of our strongest markets. We’ve achieved good market penetration across the region so far, but there's still a huge opportunity to expand.

We're looking for a sales leader based in Oslo to take over a small existing team and drive performance further. Currently, Account Managers on your team cover Norway, Sweden and Denmark - close to the schools and municipalities they serve. Your role is to bring them together as one team, sharpen how they sell, and turn strong regional demand into predictable, growing revenue.

You will report directly to our London-based CCO, Sanjeev, who previously led Vodafone business units across Africa and Europe. Being based in our Oslo HQ, you will also work closely with the wider executive team, including our CEO, Morten, a former McKinsey Partner.

What You'll Do — Scope & Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the team: Coach your Account Managers through deal reviews, pipeline check-ins and real-time support on live opportunities. You'll build the kind of environment where people are pushed to get better and know it's in service of their own growth, not just the number.

  • Own the regional strategy: Use market and pipeline data to decide where to focus - which segments, which territories, which accounts are worth the push. Norway, Sweden and Denmark aren't the same market; treat them that way.

  • Keep the numbers honest: Pipeline hygiene, accurate forecasting, clean data in HubSpot. Leadership makes decisions based on what you and your team report - it needs to hold up.

  • Help your team win the big deals: Multi-stakeholder sales into municipalities and education authorities take time and the right approach. You'll help AMs map the decision path and move from single-unit sales to framework agreements.

  • Connect the dots internally: Work closely with Marketing, Product and Customer Success so the whole go-to-market motion stays aligned - not just your slice of it.

  • Represent us externally: Show up at industry events and policy conversations across the region as a credible voice for what we do.

What You Bring — Experience & Capabilities

  • A track record leading B2B sales teams - ideally selling complex solutions into education or public sector, where deals take multiple stakeholders and patience.

  • You lead by coaching, not just managing. You know how to read what motivates different people and push each of them toward their own best, not a one-size-fits-all approach.

  • A structured approach to selling. You've used frameworks like MEDDPICC, SPIN or Challenger to pressure-test deals and keep timelines under control, and you expect your team to do the same.

  • Comfort with data and CRM (HubSpot experience is a plus) - you can turn numbers into coaching conversations and forecasts people can actually trust.

  • Professional fluency in Norwegian and English; Swedish or Danish is a plus but not essential.

What We Offer

  • Huge market opportunity: The Nordics are our home market and where it all started - with some of the best awareness and coverage. Yet there is still massive opportunity for account expansion and market penetration.

  • Proven product-market fit: Our solution is unique, backed by strong evidence of impact, and is highly cost effective against alternative solutions. This all shows in our very low churn - the solution works and customers love it.

  • A team and a playbook that already work: You're not starting from zero - you're taking something proven and making it better. You'll have the room to adjust the approach where it makes sense.

  • Significant financial upside. We offer an attractive uncapped commission model beyond OTE. Because the market need is high, and our solution is proven, the earning potential here is significant.

  • High-calibre commercial colleagues: You will join a commercial leadership team of experienced sales leaders from global tech companies like Vodafone and Salesforce, alongside peers steeped in EdTech experience.

  • A working environment people rate highly: our engagement metrics run above benchmark. Structured onboarding with a buddy program, an annual company trip, and a genuinely collaborative culture across departments.

  • Enhanced parental and sick leave.

  • Flexible working around core hours (10:00-15:00) and remote working option.

  • Central office space in Oslo.

  • 27 vacation days.

  • Travel insurance for employees and immediate family members.

  • Mobile phone and Internet subscription.

Location

This role is based in our Oslo HQ office, with regular travel across Norway, Sweden and Denmark to support your team in the field.

We believe in-person leadership matters, so we work a flexible hybrid model built around real collaboration.

How to Apply

Please click Apply and upload your CV in English.

If you’d like, you can also include a short video (in English) as part of your application – this is optional, but it gives us a chance to see a bit more of who you are beyond your CV. Let your personality and passion shine!

If you're looking for a leadership role where the demand is already proven and the job is to build on that - not create it from scratch - we'd love to hear from you.

🎥 You can watch how AV1 transforms inclusion in education here: vimeo.com/1098745115

🌍 You can explore our mission and impact stories at noisolation.com

We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this position.
