title: Senior Fullstack Developer
description:
GitHub made it easy for the world to build software together. SomebodyMakeIt does the same for physical products.

An IP owner or a brand publishes a project: what may be made, where, and at what royalty. We match the right producers, the work is awarded and made near the customer, and everyone on the product line is paid from the same sale. The licence, the brand rules, the approved files, the partners, the work itself and the money all live in one system.

It is crazy that software has world class infrastructure for building together while physical products are still stuck in email, spreadsheets, fragmented sourcing and expensive guesswork. That is the thing we are here to fix.

SomebodyMakeIt reduces risk, waste and friction, and opens up a new, sustainable way to test, fund and produce physical goods at scale. We’re a small but ambitious team looking for a Senior Fullstack Developer to join us as our first hire and a core contributor.


About the role

We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Developer who builds with AI and builds AI into products. You would be our first dedicated engineer, working directly with our CTO and owning whole verticals from problem to production: the licensing and royalty rails that move real money, and the AI layer that is the core of what we do.

You will

  • Take full ownership of a vertical, from a problem statement through deployment and scaling.

  • Develop, test and maintain fullstack features across frontend and backend.

  • Build the licensing and royalty rails: licence identifiers on charges, approval gates, royalty statements, and settlement across three parties.

  • Design and build AI into the product: structuring messy project input into matchable data, party blind producer matching on real capability, and search over structured data.

  • Build accessible, responsive and reusable interface components in React and Next.js that brands and producers use daily.

  • Architect secure, scalable backend services and APIs on Supabase and Postgres: schema design, migrations, row level security, and Stripe Connect for payouts.

  • Optimise performance and enforce security across the stack.

  • Work with product and design to sharpen the experience, and carry each feature from idea to launch.

  • Contribute to code reviews, tests and the internal documentation the next person will read.

  • Use agentic tooling as your default way of working, and improve the setup we already have.

  • Work in a small team with short feedback loops, where what you ship reaches customers in days.

What we are looking for

  • Proven senior fullstack experience in TypeScript with React and Next.js, and a track record of taking features from vague problem to production on your own.

  • Strong backend craft: Node, SQL and Postgres, well structured REST APIs, database schema design and migrations, row level security.

  • Comfortable with Tailwind CSS, component driven interfaces and server side rendering.

  • Comfortable in our stack: Next.js on Vercel, Supabase and Postgres, Stripe Connect, TypeScript throughout.

  • Experience building with generative AI in production

  • You already work AI native. Agentic coding tools are daily muscle memory rather than something you tried once.

  • Solid grasp of security and compliance.

  • An ownership mindset: comfortable with both the responsibility and the accountability.

  • At home in a fast moving, early stage environment.

  • A clear communicator who works well async and enjoys owning a problem, making the reversible calls yourself and moving.

  • Fluent English.

Nice to have

  • Agentic AI workflows, tool use and LLM driven search over structured data.

  • Payments work: split payouts, VAT, multi party settlement. It is where you would start.

  • Testing and CI discipline. We run Vitest and Playwright and expect a green build before review.

  • Two sided platform experience, where both sides have to show up for anything to work.

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science or a related field. A strong track record of shipping counts for more.

Why join us

  • Work directly with the CTO on the core of the product, with real influence on where it goes.

  • Backed by Random Ventures, with Kustaa Valtonen and Peter Vesterbacka as investors and strategic advisors.

  • Competitive salary aligned with your experience, plus an employee stock option program.

  • Pension scheme and full Norwegian parental leave rights.

  • Flexible hours and a flexible hybrid model, Oslo-based, with the option to work remotely within Europe.

How to apply

Write to us if this sounds like you: if you have the startup grit, love to build, and are not afraid to challenge how things are done.

Send us something you built and a paragraph on how you actually work with AI day-to-day. A CV is welcome, and it is the least interesting thing you can send us.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

GitHub made it easy for the world to build software together. SomebodyMakeIt does the same for physical products. SomebodyMakeIt is infrastructure for distributed production and licensing. We are rebuilding how physical products get made, and sold. Right now, getting something made means email threads, spreadsheets, a sourcing agent who knows a guy, and a ten thousand unit bet placed a year before anybody knows whether it sells. Software got world class infrastructure for building together two decades ago. Nothing you can hold ever did. So we're building it. A brand, a studio or an inventor publishes what they want made: what, where, and at what royalty. Our AI structures it into a real project in minutes and returns a ranked shortlist of producers matched on capability, capacity and delivery record rather than on who they happen to know. The licence, the brand rules, the approved files, the partners, the work and the money all live in one system, and everybody on the product line is paid from the same sale. What works travels: the same design and the same rules open the next product line, the next market and the next producer, close to the people who buy it. What it is like here. Two founders out of Norway. Tonje came from film and entertainment and has spent ten years building tech companies. Weronika trained as an architect, works as a full stack engineer and was at Spacemaker before Autodesk bought it. We are AI native by default, we ship in days rather than quarters, and everything we build is set up once and made to repeat.

title: Fullstack-utvikler / AI-utvikler – arbeidstrening eller praksis i B2B/industri-startup
description:
Company: RoboConnect

Location: Molde, Norway

Work type: Full-time or part-time

Role type: Internship / student / junior developer / work training

Salary: Unpaid in the initial phase

Long-term possibility: Paid role may become possible if RoboConnect secures revenue, funding or a suitable commercial basis

Short description

RoboConnect is building an AI-supported B2B platform that helps industrial companies clarify automation needs before they invest in robotics, automation or system integration.

We are looking for a locally based fullstack developer who wants hands-on startup experience and can contribute to the development of RoboConnect’s platform, AI Advisor and internal tools. This is not a co-founder role and not an ordinary paid position at this stage, but it may become a paid role later if the collaboration works well and the company develops commercially.

About RoboConnect

Many industrial companies know they need to automate, but struggle to define what should be automated, what information is missing, whether the process is ready for investment, and which suppliers they should involve.

RoboConnect helps companies move from an unclear automation need to a structured and decision-relevant basis for internal decisions and supplier dialogue. The platform combines industrial automation insight, structured project data, AI-supported needs clarification, project preparation and matching with relevant automation partners.

The first focus area is welding automation and high-mix, low-volume manufacturing. We are currently preparing customer pilots and further development of the MVP.

Why we need a developer in-house

RoboConnect is moving from concept and market validation into product development, pilots and technical iteration. We need stronger internal technical capacity, especially around the AI Advisor, frontend, backend, API integrations, data structure and user flows.

The current platform and AI work involves several moving parts, including customer registration, project forms, dashboards, structured project data, AI-assisted needs clarification, report generation and matching logic.

We are therefore looking for a developer who can work closely with the founder and contribute practically to building, improving and testing the product.

A local candidate in Molde or nearby is strongly preferred, because close collaboration, product discussions and faster iteration will be important. Some remote work may be possible, but we would like in-person collaboration several days per week.

What you will work on

You will contribute to practical product development for RoboConnect, including:

  • frontend development and user interface improvements

  • backend development and API integrations

  • AI Advisor / chatbot functionality for needs clarification

  • structured data capture from customer conversations or forms

  • database structure and data handling

  • dashboards for customers, suppliers and admin users

  • GitHub workflow, documentation and testing

  • improving user flows from registration to project clarification

  • preparing technical demos for pilots and customer feedback

The first tasks will be scoped clearly. The goal is not to build everything at once, but to make focused improvements that can be tested with real users.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for someone with some practical development experience who wants to build real software in an early-stage startup.

You should have experience with, or strong interest in:

  • fullstack development

  • frontend and backend development

  • JavaScript / TypeScript

  • React / Next.js

  • APIs

  • databases

  • GitHub

  • AI tools, LLMs or chatbot development

  • structured problem solving

  • building usable products, not only experimenting with technology

Experience with Tailwind, Supabase, Convex, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Vercel, OpenAI, Anthropic or similar tools is an advantage, but not required if you learn quickly.

You do not need to be senior, but you should have built something before and be able to work independently on defined tasks.

You must be comfortable with

  • working in a very early-stage startup

  • incomplete systems and changing priorities

  • documenting your work clearly

  • committing code regularly to RoboConnect’s GitHub repository

  • working with agreed scope and delivery expectations

  • discussing technical choices openly

  • asking questions when something is unclear

  • receiving feedback and improving the solution iteratively

You must not commit API keys, passwords or secrets to GitHub. Production data and production credentials will not be shared during an initial trial period.

Language and location

Norwegian language skills are strongly preferred, because RoboConnect works with Norwegian industrial companies and customer needs must be understood clearly.

Candidates who speak English may also be considered if they are willing to learn Norwegian and can collaborate effectively in Norway.

The ideal candidate is located in Molde or within commuting distance. Candidates who can be physically present in Molde several days per week will be prioritized.

Practical setup

This is initially intended as an unpaid work-training, internship or experience-based role, depending on the candidate’s situation.

It may be especially relevant for someone who:

  • wants more practical experience in fullstack development

  • wants to build real startup/product experience

  • has completed studies, courses or self-learning but needs real project experience

  • is registered with NAV and may be eligible for work training or similar arrangements

  • wants to build a portfolio with meaningful product work

  • is interested in AI, automation, industrial technology or B2B platforms

RoboConnect will not present this as an ordinary paid employment relationship unless a separate paid agreement is made.

If the collaboration works well and RoboConnect secures revenue, funding or another commercial basis, a paid role may become possible later.

What you can gain

You will get hands-on experience with:

  • building a real B2B SaaS/AI platform

  • AI-supported product development

  • industrial automation use cases

  • customer needs clarification

  • startup product development

  • fullstack development in practice

  • GitHub, documentation, testing and deployment workflow

  • working close to the founder and team in an early-stage company

This is a good opportunity for someone who wants more than a theoretical project and wants to join in build something that may be used by real industrial companies.

About the founder

RoboConnect was founded by Elisabet Witsø. The company is based in Molde and connected to the industrial and automation ecosystem in Norway.

RoboConnect is still in an early phase, but has completed market validation, interviewed industrial companies and automation partners, completed MVP, and is preparing the next step toward pilots and commercial testing.

How to apply

Please apply through The Hub and answer the short application questions. Please also include your CV and GitHub profile.

The questions are intended to give us a better understanding of your motivation, availability, language skills, practical situation and how you work as a developer.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

1. Short description RoboConnect is developing an independent, AI-supported platform that helps industrial companies turn tacit and fragmented process knowledge into a clear, decision-relevant automation case — before supplier dialogue begins. 2. The problem Many industrial companies know they need to automate, but struggle to define what should be automated, what is causing the problem and whether the process is ready for investment. The people closest to production often understand the process well, but this knowledge may be spread across operators, engineers and management, poorly documented or mixed with assumptions and missing data. The customer may therefore approach the market with an unclear problem description and incomplete information. System integrators then have to reconstruct the customer’s process understanding and collect missing data before a meaningful solution dialogue can begin. This creates uncertainty, longer clarification phases, weak or difficult-to-compare proposals and projects that stall early. The core problem is not a lack of technology or suppliers. It is that the knowledge needed to make a good early automation decision is often tacit, fragmented and difficult to transfer. 3. The solution RoboConnect starts by understanding the customer’s process, challenges and actual needs. The RoboConnect AI Advisor conducts a guided professional conversation that helps the company describe how production works today, what it wants to improve, which constraints matter and what information is still missing. The AI Advisor brings together information from different parts of the organisation, separates facts from assumptions and uncertainty, identifies knowledge gaps and risks, and turns unclear issues into practical next actions. The result is a shared and structured automation basis that can be developed into a supplier-ready project brief. Relevant projects can then be connected with suitable system integrators, technology suppliers and R&D environments. This gives the customer greater decision confidence and solution providers a better starting point. RoboConnect is not building a generic chatbot. The platform combines a domain-specific workflow, structured project data and knowledge from industrial cases, expert interviews and feedback from customers and automation partners. Over time, this strengthens clarification, project maturation and matching. The first focused area is welding automation and high-mix, low-volume manufacturing. The longer-term ambition is to expand across other automation categories and build a Nordic platform for early-stage automation clarification and matching. 4. Business model and commercial opportunity RoboConnect creates value on both sides of the market. Industrial companies receive a clearer and safer starting point, while automation partners gain access to better-qualified customer opportunities. The current model is based mainly on supplier-side revenue through fees for qualified matches and successful projects. Future revenue streams may include paid AI-assisted readiness reports, supplier subscriptions, premium access and category-specific products. The model is now being validated through pilots and early customer projects. Norway is the validation market, with Sweden as the first intended scale-up market. 5. Why I started RoboConnect The motivation came from repeated conversations with industrial companies, automation experts and system integrators. I saw that many projects became uncertain long before technology was selected. Companies needed a more independent and structured way to understand their own situation before entering a supplier-led process. With a background in research, data analysis and complex problem structuring, combined with further training in programming, databases and AI, I founded RoboConnect to bridge the gap between industrial process knowledge and automation delivery.

title: AI Integration Engineer
description:
About Us

At No Isolation, we’re a profitable, 65-person Scandinavian EdTech scale-up operating across Europe. We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child.

Our AV1 robot is deployed in 19 countries, with 5,000+ units supporting schools to improve attendance, belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.

We’re established enough to have a proven solution and strong financial foundations, yet still small enough for every new colleague to have a visible impact on our next stage of growth.

The Opportunity — AI Integration Engineer

This is a new role at No Isolation, and you'd be the first person in it.

You'll sit inside Engineering but work mostly embedded inside selected internal business units, in contrast to the rest of Engineering. You’ll work with Sales, Customer Success, Finance and Operations. You’ll connect the tools they depend on and implement AI tools and automation flows to positively impact our revenue first and foremost, but also generally enhance internal effectiveness.

In practice: you set the bar for how much internal AI and Automation can change the company from the inside in 2026 and beyond, and you co-own the stack you put in place. You will have a lot of direct contact with the teams you're building for, and a lot of say in how the technical side gets structured to enable you, while having the support of experienced software engineers when needed.

What You'll Do — Scope & Responsibilities

  • Systems integration: Drive automation of key business areas and connect our business tools across Data, IAM, CRM, ERP (Odoo) and Finance through APIs, webhooks and events, so data stays in sync across systems.

  • Internal automation capability: Build and maintain workflows in Windmill and/or n8n; migrate us off legacy SaaS and iPaaS tools as you go. Aim to articulate as many problems as possible as deterministic automations that keep data and AI cost low.

  • Internal AI capability: Contribute to shared infrastructure for using AI internally alongside our cloud/platform engineers: assistants, retrieval over internal knowledge, summarisation, classification, routing, etc. Turn ad hoc AI experiments into tools people can actually rely on, with eval sets in place to catch regressions.

  • Data & internal foundations: Centralise data into sources the business can trust, reconcile figures across systems so numbers match wherever they appear, and provide internal tools and lightly-built apps.

  • Guardrails & cost control: Define the standards for how integrations and AI get built here. Keep the set of automation platforms small and deliberate (e.g. Windmill, n8n and some custom). Track AI spend and return on investment so we can monitor alignment between the two.

  • Partnership: Work directly with the teams you're building for: understand the actual problem, ship a working increment near-instantly, then iterate and negotiate toward durability. You're measured on time saved, additional revenue generated, budget synergies realised, not on the tools you ship. Share knowledge and lift others through e.g. workshops and townhalls.

What You Bring — Experience & Capabilities

  • Talent for working directly with non-technical stakeholders and turning a fuzzy request into a concrete system. This is a first-of-its-kind role here, so you're setting direction rather than following an existing playbook.

  • Experience connecting systems through APIs, webhooks and events: ERPs (Odoo v18 and beyond is a plus), CRMs, or Finance systems. At ease with various application protocols (REST), auth flows (OAuth/SSO) and the rough edges of third-party SaaS APIs.

  • Hands-on with a code-first orchestration platform: Windmill, Temporal, Airflow, n8n or similar.

  • A builder who finishes: Proficient in at least one general-purpose language (Python, TypeScript, Go), and comfortable taking something from rough prototype (built by you or non-technical people) to engineering standard.

  • Comfortable using and configuring self-hosted tooling (containers, secrets, backups, upgrades) to some extent, as opposed to fully leaning on managed SaaS

  • Practical experience with LLMs and agents: context engineering, RAG, evals, tool/function calling. You should have a good sense of where AI helps and where it adds fragility.

  • Data sense: savvy with SQL and common data stores; able to model, reconcile and centralize data; some exposure to classical machine learning can be an advantage.

  • Security-conscious by default: least-privilege access, careful handling of secrets, aware of GDPR, SOC and ISO requirements.

  • STEM degree (BSc/MSc) or equivalent practical experience in integration, AI & automation, or internal tooling.

  • Experience at product or scale-up companies is an advantage.

Why You'll Love It Here

  • First-of-its-kind role: you will tackle opportunities unexplored so far at the company

  • Purpose with scale: The systems you build free up time that goes straight back into helping educators support thousands of children connected, learning, and included every single day.

  • Work with exceptional leaders: You'll report to our Director of Engineering, Jerome, with plenty of room to shape a high-trust, learning-driven engineering culture.

  • Growth through ownership: A lean environment with the freedom to propose what you think is best for our very company.

  • Stability with a lean size: We are profitable and growing rapidly, while keeping at a size where the ideal candidate will have high impact.

  • Flexible working around core hours (10:00–15:00), with a hybrid work schedule.

  • 27 vacation days.

  • Travel and accident insurance for you and your immediate family.

  • Enhanced parental and sick leave.

  • Mobile phone and internet subscription reimbursement.

  • Regular company socials and an annual trip away together.

Our Tech Stack

Think internal tools, fleets of connected robots, and the systems that keep Sales, Finance and Customer Success running. You'll work with:

  • Orchestration & automation: Windmill, n8n

  • Languages: Go, Python, TypeScript

  • Systems: Odoo, HubSpot, and the wider CRM/finance/IAM stack

  • AI: LLMs and agents, RAG/retrieval, MCP, evaluation tooling

  • Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, containers

  • Data: SQL, MySQL, ClickHouse

  • Development: GitLab, Claude Code and handful of other solutions being evaluated

Location

This role is based in Oslo with hybrid flexibility at our headquarters (up to 2 days remote work per week).

We welcome all qualified applicants. Due to current visa/work-permit processes, we can progress candidates already in Norway or relocating with no need for additional work permit (such as the EU/EEA citizens). (This note is about work authorization only; no sensitive personal data is required).

How to Apply

If you like building things that make everyone else's work easier, are passionate about AI, and want that to matter for something bigger, we'd love to hear from you.

Please click Apply and upload your CV in English.

If you'd like, you can also include a short video as part of your application — this is optional, but it gives us a chance to see a bit more of who you are beyond your CV.

🎥 You may watch how AV1 transforms inclusion in education here: vimeo.com/1098745115

🌍 You may explore our mission and impact stories at noisolation.com

We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child. School absence is the biggest challenge facing education. Our AV1 robots connect absent students, ensure learning and belonging, and support reintegration back to the classroom. Today, there are over 3,500 active AV1 robots used across 18 European countries. Positioned in the EdTech sector, AV1 is a unique solution to the growing issue of persistent absence, supporting both the academic and social needs of students. No Isolation works across Europe, with 45 employees across Europe and in offices in Oslo, Munich and London. Join us in our growth journey!

title: Creative & AI Producer – 20–40% Student Position
description:
Creative & AI Producer – 20–40% Student Position

We have a slightly unusual setup.

We run several businesses and projects across hospitality, consumer products, media and design. Some are established businesses with employees, customers and real revenue. Others are early-stage ideas we are trying to turn into something real.

Møllefossen is a café, event venue and hospitality concept in Oslo. We are building a premium Norwegian mineral water brand, work with wine import, develop consumer products and are launching a podcast about what it is actually like to own and run a business in Norway.

More ideas tend to appear faster than we can execute them.

That is where you come in.

We are looking for a talented student who can help us turn ideas into things people can actually see, watch, visit, buy and experience.

This is not a traditional marketing position. There will be very few PowerPoints about what we could do. We would much rather make it, put it live, see if it works and improve it.

What you might actually do

One week you could be:

  • Building a landing page for a new concept

  • Filming a podcast and turning 90 minutes into great Reels and Shorts

  • Developing packaging or visual concepts for a new product

  • Creating content for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn or YouTube

  • Improving one of our websites

  • Shooting photo and video

  • Making graphics and campaign material

  • Using AI to prototype a new brand or idea in an afternoon

  • Automating something we currently waste far too much time doing

The next week could be completely different.

AI should be part of how you work

We think AI is fundamentally changing what a small, talented team can accomplish. We already use it extensively, and we want you to push this much further.

ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Runway, Framer, Lovable, Cursor – or something that launches next month. We don’t particularly care which tools you prefer.

We care about what you can make with them.

We are not looking for endless mediocre AI content. Taste still matters. Probably more than ever.

The goal is to combine good ideas, visual judgement and technology to move much faster from:

“We should do this” → “It’s live.”

Who we’re looking for

You might study design, marketing, communication, media, technology – or something completely different. Your degree matters less to us than how you think and what you can create.

You probably:

  • Have a very good visual eye

  • Are unusually comfortable with technology

  • Experiment with AI

  • Know some combination of Figma, Adobe, Canva, CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci, Webflow, Framer or similar

  • Can shoot decent photo and video

  • Learn new tools quickly

  • Take initiative

  • Actually enjoy figuring things out

You don’t need to know everything. We’d rather hire someone who knows 50% and learns incredibly fast than someone who ticks every box but lacks curiosity.

What the job is like

You will work directly with the people building the businesses. Short decision paths, very little bureaucracy and plenty of room to influence the result.

Have a better idea? Tell us. Find a tool that does in 30 minutes what we spend a day doing? Use it. Something isn’t working? Change it.

The role is 20–40%, with flexibility around studies and exams. Some work can be remote, while filming, photography and certain projects require you to be with us in Oslo/Bærum.

It’s an unusual student job where you can build a portfolio of real work across several businesses instead of spending a year making minor adjustments to one company’s social media calendar.

How to apply

Don’t spend an evening writing a polished cover letter.

Send us:

  • A short introduction

  • Three things you’ve made that you’re genuinely proud of

Website, video, design, Instagram account, school project, side project, app, brand, photography – whatever shows us what you can do.

A CV is welcome, but isn’t the most important part.

Show us what you can make.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Jeg ville ikke prøvd å beskrive dere som én startup med én problemstilling. Det interessante er nettopp at kandidaten kommer inn i et lite økosystem av ekte virksomheter og nye konsepter. På The Hub er det en styrke, særlig for den typen tech/AI-nysgjerrige student vi vil ha. Jeg ville skrevet det slik: About us We have a slightly unusual setup. We run several businesses and projects across hospitality, consumer products, media and design. Some are established businesses with employees, customers and real revenue. Others are early-stage ideas we are currently trying to turn into something real. Møllefossen is a café, event venue and hospitality concept in Oslo. We are building a premium Norwegian mineral water brand. We work with wine import, are developing new consumer products, and are currently launching a podcast. More ideas tend to appear faster than we can execute them. That is essentially the problem we are trying to solve. We are good at coming up with concepts, building businesses, finding opportunities and getting things moving. But today, a surprisingly large part of turning an idea into reality is digital: a website needs to be built, a brand needs an identity, something needs to be filmed, a product needs packaging, a podcast needs to become 15 good clips, or an idea needs to be tested before spending weeks and a lot of money on it. AI is changing how much a very small team can actually do. We want to take advantage of that properly – not by generating endless mediocre content, but by combining good taste, creativity and new technology to move much faster from “we should do this” to “it’s live.” That is why we are looking for someone who gets genuinely excited by having Framer open in one window, ChatGPT or Claude in another, a half-finished Reel on the screen and a completely new project landing on their desk the following week. If you need a clearly defined corporate job description and six months of planning before launching something, this probably isn’t the right place. If that sounds like fun, it might be.

title: Utviklere til Labrador CMS
description:
Hvem er vi?

Labrador CMS er en norsk publiseringsplattform for nettaviser bygget av journalister og utviklere. Plattformen brukes av ti tusen journalister i hundrevis av nettaviser i 20 land i Europa, Asia og USA. 

Nå søker vi tre nye  utviklere (backend/frontend/fullstack) som vil være med på å videreutvikle produktet, kundeoppsett og brukeropplevelser for redaksjoner og lesere. Dette er roller for deg som trives i skjæringspunktet mellom produkt, teknologi og praktiske kundebehov. Vi er opptatt av å være til å stole på og samtidig være tidlig ute med ny teknologi. Vi trenger folk som både kan kode manuelt samt orkestrere kodeagenter og agentsystemer. Hos oss kan du i stor grad påvirke verktøykassen selv. Du kan bruke Claude Code eller Codex, Mac, Windows eller Linux. Du bør like å tenke stort og langt og være ambisiøs. Vi liker folk som både klarer å finne ut hvor vi bør bli bedre og i tillegg foreslår løsningen og løser problemet.


Roller og ansvarsområder

Avhengig av kompetanse og interesse er det flere områder du kan jobbe i hos oss:

Import/onboarding-team

Når nye kunder går over til Labrador CMS, skal nettstedene deres settes opp på en måte som er stabil, effektiv og enkel å videreutvikle. Rollen innebærer å konfigurere og tilpasse løsninger, bygge eller koble på integrasjoner mot blant annet betalingsmurer, kommentarsystemer og printsystemer, og samtidig bidra til at hovedproduktet blir bedre for alle kunder. Vi importerer også alle eksisterende artikler, så gjennomføring av dette samt videreutvikling av verktøyene vi bruker kan også være del av jobben.

Produkt-team

Denne rollen handler både om presentasjonen ut mot leserne og arbeidsflyten inne i redaksjonen. Du er med på å bygge raske, gjennomarbeidede og visuelt sterke forsider og artikkelsider for kundene våre.

Samtidig skal du bidra til å forenkle brukergrensesnittet og arbeidsflyten i editoren i Labrador CMS. Dette er en hands-on utviklerrolle, der du både vurderer løsningene og bygger dem selv. Rollen kan også innebære dialog med kunder, slik at tekniske valg forankres i faktiske behov.


Om Labrador CMS

Labrador CMS leverer en skybasert publiseringsplattform for mediebransjen. Plattformen er egenutviklet fra bunnen av for å gi redaksjoner rask, sikker og brukervennlig publisering. Mange kunder bruker Labrador som en komplett løsning, mens større mediehus bygger videre på plattformen sammen med egne utviklere.

Vi leverer også frontend-hosting for kundene våre og håndterer høy trafikk på tvers av mange nettsteder. Oppetid, responstid og stabile leveranser er derfor en naturlig del av hverdagen hos oss.

Arbeidsform og team

Labrador har rundt 40 ansatte, hovedsakelig i Norge. Over halvparten jobber med utvikling, fordelt på frontend, backend og infrastruktur. Hovedkontoret ligger i Oslo, men vi har også ansatte andre steder i landet. Det er mulig å jobbe remote, samtidig som vi verdsetter tett samarbeid og korte veier fra idé til løsning.


Vi tilbyr

  • Mulighet til å påvirke et produkt som brukes av redaksjoner og lesere i mange land

  • Et sterkt utviklingsmiljø med høy faglig takhøyde og korte beslutningsveier

  • Fleksibel arbeidshverdag, med moderne lokaler hos MESH sentralt i Oslo

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og fritt valg av arbeidsutstyr.


Hvem er du?

  • Du kommuniserer godt på norsk og engelsk

  • Du jobber strukturert og leverer riktig kvalitet til riktig tid

  • Du er produktnær, hands-on og opptatt av både visuell kvalitet og gode arbeidsflyter

  • Du har relevant utdanning eller erfaring som gir deg et godt teknisk fundament

  • Erfaring med integrasjoner, frontend, backend eller systemer med høye krav til oppetid og tilgjengelighet er en fordel


Teknologier vi bruker:

(du trenger ikke kunne alt dette)

  • Codex og Claude Code

  • Git

  • HTML/CSS

  • JavaScript

  • Go

  • PHP

  • PostgreSQL

  • OpenSearch

  • AWS

Nysgjerrig? Send inn søknad på linken med CV vedlagt. Søknadsfrist: snarest.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Built in Norway by journalists and developers who understand what deadline-driven publishing actually demands, Labrador CMS has grown into one of the fastest-growing publishing platforms in the world. Today, 10,000 journalists produce content for 400 online newspapers across 21 countries on Labrador — and the platform serves the 4 billion monthly page views their audiences generate. Over the past year, some of Europe's largest media groups have made Labrador their platform of choice. We're also seeing strong momentum in the US and Asia. Our customers range from major national newspapers and large regional publishing groups to magazines and niche digital outlets. Labrador is known for being highly flexible, genuinely easy to use, and for shipping market-leading AI features that help editorial teams work faster and smarter. We believe the future of publishing is one where AI agents work alongside journalists — and we're building for that future now. When employees tell what they like most about working for Labrador CMS, they speak about how inspiring it is to see their work be used in production for thousands of users and read by millions of people. They also talk about our culture for collaboration. We work hard and we acheive results, and we help each other to reach our potential.

title: AV Scriptwriter
description:
At Superside, we're looking for an AV Scriptwriter who can take a video brief from the initial idea through to a production-ready script. Projects range from 15-second social and performance content to five-minute brand/explainer films, across motion graphics, live action, stock-led video, and UGC. You'll need to understand how words, visuals, pacing, and sound work together, and be confident writing dialogue, voiceover, and on-screen copy that reads naturally out loud.


What you’ll do

  • Concept and script AV content across formats, from short-form social cuts to longer branded films.

  • Given a brief, develop two or three distinct creative directions, each with a clear sense of how it would work as a video, supported by references and a potential title approach.

  • Take a chosen direction through to a strong, production-ready AV script, including dialogue, voiceover and on-screen copy.

  • Build a hook that works, structure a clear narrative, and shift naturally between different brands, audiences, tones and platforms.

  • Collaborate with Superside's creative teams to align scripts with visual direction and brand guidelines, and refine based on feedback.


What you’ll bring

  • Proven AV scriptwriting experience, ideally from an agency background, not primarily general copywriting.

  • A portfolio of AV concepts and scripts, rather than mainly websites, blogs or general marketing copy.

  • Excellent command of English and a strong sense of pacing, tone and structure in scriptwriting.

  • Strong collaboration skills and openness to iteration with creative directors, designers and producers.

  • Interest in or familiarity with AI tools for creative ideation or drafting is a plus.


Why Join us?

Superside's vision is to create equal opportunities globally by accelerating the world’s transition to online work. With that in mind, we're building a fully remote company that attracts people where they are.

Remote-first. Customer-led.

Remote isn’t just a perk; it’s how we deliver better for customers. We are fully committing to our customers by hiring top talent and collaborating seamlessly across time zones.

Global team, local impact.

Join a community of 60+ nationalities working across time zones, cultures, and disciplines, all aligned on doing great work for great brands.

High performance, low ego.

Work in a fast-paced, high-trust environment where feedback is direct, growth is constant, and kindness leads collaboration.

Impact meets opportunity.

We’re in the sweet spot — big enough to be stable, small enough for you to shape what’s next. Your ideas will matter here.

Grow fast. Lead well.

You’ll gain mentorship, take on real responsibility, and grow your career while helping us disrupt a global industry.


About Superside

Superside is the leading AI-powered creative company that quickly and cost-effectively enhances in-house functions. We help over 500 ambitious brands get great creative concepts done at scale. Built to be an extension 

of in-house teams, we unbottleneck marketing and creative teams so they can move faster and drive more reliable creative performance. 

Superside is a fully remote company with over 700 team members working across 60+ countries and 13 timezones.

Learn more at superside.com


Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

We’re an equal-opportunity company. All applicants will be considered regardless of ethnicity, appearance, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Superside revolutionizes the global design industry by building new tech and data science-driven processes that enable distributed teams to work together much more efficiently and robust. We deliver high-velocity on-demand design to enterprises, with a data-driven and meritocratic mindset unlike any other platform or service. Superside is pioneering the future of remote work with a tech-enabled platform that creates super efficiencies and advantages workers by way of fostering community and greater income predictability with flexible work and stable wages. Our mission is to shape the global labor market; by having a fair and transparent labor platform that is great for both remote workers and enterprise customers. We currently have more than 100 creatives spanning six continents, 58 countries, and 19 timezones, and we work mainly with major US-based brands, including Tiffany & Co, Amazon, Cisco, L’Oreal and others. We have hub offices in Oslo, Toronto and Cape Town but are essentially based nowhere. We are remote-first with team members spread across the world. Superside was founded in late 2015 and became the first Norwegian company to join the Y Combinator accelerator in Palo Alto, California. We have since received funding from reputable Silicon Valley investors Freestyle Venture, High Alpha, Slack Fund, Sam Altman, Alliance Venture, and others. We're always-on and chase the sun to deliver the moon!

title: Lead Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
About Six Robotics

At Six Robotics, we build intelligent software that gives Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) the ability to collaborate, adapt on the fly, and execute missions that were previously impossible.

From our base in Oslo, our team of 90+ engineers, researchers, and defence specialists develops our autonomy and swarm platform, used by both government and industry. Working closely with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI) and end users, we move quickly from ideas to field deployment, solving problems where software meets the real world.

The challenges we work on don’t come with existing playbooks. They demand deep technical thinking, close collaboration across disciplines, and the ability to learn quickly as both the technology and the company evolve.

At Six Robotics, every person executes with precision, adapts to changing conditions, and strengthens the team. If you’re excited about building systems that matter and growing alongside talented people that push boundaries every day, you’ll find no better place to deliver real-world impact.

About The Role

We're looking for a Lead Product Designer to design the interface operators use to control Valkyrie — the screens, workflows, and interactions that let them command autonomous assets in the field. You'll be designing for real-time control, situational awareness, and operational trust in environments where clarity, speed, and precision aren't "nice to have" — they're the entire point.

This is a hands-on role. You'll own the design process from concept to implementation, while also starting to build and lead a small (but growing) design team. We're looking for someone who's just as comfortable designing themselves as they are showing others the way.

You'll help shape a product domain from an early stage, with real influence over how operators in the field actually experience and trust the technology they use. We move fast and keep bureaucracy out of the way.

What You Will Do

- Lead design for key GCS (Ground Control Station) capabilities, from early concept through launch

- Own product feature design end to end — from problem framing to shipped, polished UI

- Work closely with engineers, autonomy teams, product, and operators to translate technical and operational requirements into intuitive workflows

- Drive research efforts and generate insight that shapes what we build — talking to operators, testing assumptions, and turning findings into design direction

- Drive the end-to-end design process — wireframes, prototypes, detailed UI specs, and implementation support

- Test and iterate with real users, building feedback into the process continuously

- Lead our design system components, and define and maintain a coherent visual and interaction language that supports real-time control and situational awareness

- Ensure high quality in the final product — sweating the details that make the difference between "usable" and "trusted in the field"

- Solve unsolved problems: tackle complex challenges where there's no existing playbook. Think pragmatically and creatively to design interfaces for remote hardware sensing, 3D spatial awareness, and AI-driven missions

- Start building a design team: setting direction, mentoring, and eventually taking on people leadership as the team grows

- Contribute to roadmap prioritization and product vision across the GCS domain

- Travel to test flights and field operations to drive operator research where it actually happens

What we are looking for

- Minimum 8+ years experience as a product designer (UX/UI), with a proven track record of leading complex product areas end to end

- Have a strong visual design sensibility - you care about craft and polish - paired with real UX depth: you think in flows, systems, and user problems, not just screens

- Have formal training or professional experience in complex systems, with a portfolio that shows deep, pragmatic thinking - not just polished visuals

- Have experience designing for complex, interactive systems - ideally involving spatial data, control interfaces, or high information density

- Have B2B experience and a pragmatic approach to product development

- Have experience leading or mentoring other designers, or are ready to take that step

- Communicate well across disciplines — you can explain design decisions and tradeoffs to people who aren't designers

- Are comfortable with ambiguity and have a bias for action in a fast-moving environment

- Want to build something from the ground up, not just polish what already exists

Nice to have

- Experience designing interfaces for real-time control systems (drones, robotics, vehicles, or aviation platforms)

- Familiarity with defence, intelligence, or mission-critical systems

- Experience with 2D/3D map visualization, telemetry, or command-and-control interfaces

- Background in early-stage product development or entrepreneurial environments

Why You Should Join

  • Build at the edge of what’s possible: You’ll work on problems the industry hasn’t solved yet, alongside people who are pushing the boundaries of autonomy, AI, and robotics.

  • Grow as fast as the company: We believe that chance favours those in motion. The role you’re hired into is just the starting point. As Six Robotics evolves, so will your scope, your responsibilities, and your opportunities.

  • Work with exceptional people: Surround yourself with people who raise your own standards. You’ll join a team of ambitious engineers and operators who care deeply about the quality of their work. Expectations are high, but so is the willingness to help each other improve.

  • Ship work that matters. The things you build don't stay in a demo environment. They get deployed, tested, and used where reliability and performance genuinely matter.

  • Supported by great benefits. Alongside meaningful work, we offer competitive compensation, equity potential, strong pension and insurance plans, gadget budgets, modern equipment, panoramic offices, and the flexibility you need to do your best work.

Our Recruitment Process

We want hiring to be transparent and respectful of your time. We aim to move with momentum while making thoughtful hiring decisions - because every new team member matters.

Our process typically includes:

  • Initial phone screening (30 min): A conversation about your background, motivation, and the role.

  • First interview (45 min): Meet the hiring team, learn more about Six Robotics, and discuss your experience.

  • Second interview (60–90 min): A technical discussion, typically including a live case presentation.

  • Final interview (45 min): Meet members of our leadership team to align expectations and answer any remaining questions.

Reference checks are conducted before an offer is finalized. We review applications continuously, so don't leave us hanging. Send us your application today!

Our Commitment to Inclusion

At Six Robotics, we are committed to creating a workplace built on respect, integrity, and collaboration. We value different perspectives and experiences, and we believe that diversity within our team strengthens both our work and our culture. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply and help us build technology that makes a real impact.

Security Clearance Requirement

All employees at Six Robotics must be eligible for security clearance. Some roles might require a high level of clearance, depending on the nature of the work. If you are hired, we’ll guide you through any required authorization or clearance process as part of your onboarding. title: Data Engineer
description:
About Us:

At SurplusMap, we are revolutionizing green infrastructure and sustainable mobility through data-driven, AI-powered technology. Our platform is at the forefront of EV charging infrastructure development, geospatial data analysis, and energy forecasting, with ongoing projects supported by leading European tech organizations such as ESA, EIT Urban Mobility, and backed by investors like Equinor-Techstars, Simula, and Bentley Systems.

Join us in accelerating the green transition across Europe as we scale our platform to optimize sustainable mobility and energy solutions.

The Role:

As a Data Engineer at SurplusMap, you will play a pivotal role in supporting our data pipelines and infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with our engineering and data science teams to help maintain efficient and scalable data architectures. Working alongside our Senior team, you will gain hands-on experience with large datasets within , ETL processes, and cutting-edge AI tools to power the green energy transition.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone eager to grow their technical skills and contribute to impactful projects aimed at electrifying the transportation industry and achieving cleaner cities.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Collaborate with our engineering and data science teams to design, develop, and maintain data pipelines, including ETL processes.
  • Implement and optimize data storage solutions using Google Cloud products like BigQuery.
  • Work with DBT and Dataform to build robust data transformation workflows.
  • Assist in managing cloud infrastructure with Terraform (nice to have).
  • Ensure data integrity and security across our platform by following best practices in data engineering.
  • Support AI-powered models for EV charger utilization, energy load forecasting, and geospatial analysis.
  • Participate in the design and development of scalable data architectures, contributing to projects aimed at optimizing sustainable mobility solutions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on projects that integrate machine learning models for energy and infrastructure predictions.
Desired Skills and Qualifications:
  • Can-do mindset, practical and hands-on with excellent communication skills and results-oriented.  
  • Strong proficiency in Google Cloud products (especially BigQuery).
  • Hands-on experience with SQL for querying large datasets.
  • Familiarity with DBT, Dataform, or similar tools for data transformations.
  • Basic knowledge of Python for scripting and automation.
  • Exposure to Terraform for infrastructure-as-code is a plus.
  • Understanding of data pipeline design, optimization, and ETL processes.
  • Interest in AI, geospatial data, and green energy technologies (experience with GIS tools or similar is a bonus).
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate with diverse teams.
  • Preferred 2+ years of experience in relevant positions
What We Offer:
  • Work on cutting-edge projects in the EV charging infrastructure and green energy space.
  • Opportunity to collaborate with world-class partners like the European Space Agency and EIT Urban Mobility.
  • A vibrant, innovative startup environment with flexible working hours at our office in StartupLab in Oslo.
  • Be part of a mission-driven team dedicated to bold innovation, sustainability, and creating positive environmental impact.
Preferred Location:

We prefer candidates based in Oslo, but we are open to remote positions for the right candidate.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Introduction to SurplusMap SurplusMap is on a mission to revolutionize the way we develop and optimize EV charging infrastructure. By leveraging advanced geospatial tools and machine learning models, we empower energy companies, local utilities, and charge point operators to make informed decisions about site selection and utilization prediction. This ensures the efficient and effective deployment of charging stations, addressing a critical need in the rapidly growing electric vehicle market. Our secret advantage is our ability to draw on Norway's leadership in EV infrastructure, combined with our collaborations with top-tier partners like Google and Bentley Systems, to deliver cutting-edge solutions. The challenge we face is significant: the current pace of infrastructure development is insufficient to meet the future demands of the booming EV market. The market is highly fragmented, causing inconvenience for EV users and difficulties for energy companies and local utilities trying to optimize their investments. For instance, the EU mandates the installation of 6,000 new charging points per week by 2030, a target that is far from being met with the current rate of deployment. This gap presents a substantial opportunity for innovative solutions like SurplusMap to make a real difference. At SurplusMap, we focus on ensuring our customers invest wisely. Our sophisticated, map-based software integrates geospatial data and machine learning algorithms to pinpoint optimal sites for new charging stations. This means our clients can invest in the right locations, install the ideal number of chargers, and maintain high utilization rates over time. By doing so, we help them maximize their investments and build a robust EV infrastructure network that meets the demands of the future. We are driven by a vision of cleaner, more sustainable cities. Electric vehicles are crucial in reducing air pollution and creating healthier urban environments. However, the key to this transition lies in the efficient deployment of charging infrastructure that provides greater flexibility to the energy grid, allowing for more renewable energy sources to be integrated. At SurplusMap, we are passionate about facilitating this energy transition. By optimizing EV charging infrastructure, we help accelerate the shift to cleaner energy, positively impacting both the environment and the communities we live in. Join us in our mission to create a greener, more sustainable future through innovative technology and strategic planning. Together, we can drive the change needed to make our cities cleaner and our energy systems more resilient.

title: Join our Account Executive teams!
description:
At Mercell, we're on a mission to revolutionize public procurement, making it accessible and effortless for everyone involved. Imagine a world where public buyers and visionary suppliers come together seamlessly to make a great deal easier and shape the future. That's what we're all about.

With a dynamic culture built on continuous growth, trust, and collaboration, Mercell offers an environment where your talents can thrive. You will be part of an international environment with ambitious and dedicated colleagues who are passionate about what they do and supported to be themselves.

Together, let's shape the future and create real value for society, one innovative solution at a time.

Join Us

We are growing our Buy-Side Sales teams and looking for ambitious Account Executives to join us in several markets. This is not a single open role, but a talent pool - an ongoing hiring pipeline which we will continuously review and match strong profiles with upcoming opportunities across our teams.

Your Mission

Our Account Executives are at the heart of Mercell’s mission. You’ll be a trusted advisor to public sector customers, guiding them through a value based buying journey and showing how Mercell’s solutions can help them achieve efficiency, compliance, and real impact for society.

You’ll manage the entire sales cycle from prospecting and qualifying leads (both inbound and outbound) to running demos, managing tender responses, negotiating terms, and closing deals.

With each success, you’ll help strengthen Mercell’s presence in your market and expand our growing community of public sector partners.

Core Responsibilities  

  • Proactively identify, engage, and build relationships with key decision-makers across your market.

  • Translate the business pains of the organization into a value based selling approach to drive large strategic engagements.

  • Own the entire sales journey from first contact and discovery to negotiation, closing, onboarding, and upselling.

  • Confidently demonstrate the value and impact of Mercell’s SaaS platform to organisations of all sizes.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM data in HubSpot, using insights to optimise pipeline and sales performance.

  • Stay ahead of developments in the local and European public procurement landscape to uncover new growth opportunities.

Required Qualifications  

  • Strong experience (ideally 3-5 years) managing a full B2B SaaS sales cycle, preferably to the public sector or highly regulated industries with a tender driven sales motion.

  • Strong experience in outbound sales and pipeline generation with demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

  • Ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders and decision-makers.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, agile, and collaborative environment where priorities evolve.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English.

  • Fluency in at least one of the following languages: Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, German or Dutch.

Preferred Qualifications  

  • Familiarity with public procurement, tendering, or compliance-driven buying processes.

  • Experience working in an international or multi-market sales environment.

  • Strong consultative selling mindset with a focus on long-term customer value. 

Workplace type: Hybrid, working onsite at the office and from home balancing flexibility with collaboration

Locations: Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Netherlands

 

What we offer 

As a fast growing technology company, we are committed to taking care of our employees through initiatives such as hybrid work to support work-life balance, health and insurance plans (may differ per country/office), pension plans, paid parental leave, social happenings and competitive salary packages. Please see https://career.mercell.com/posts/our-perks-benefits to get more insights on what to expect of perks, benefits and culture when joining Mercell.

Has this sparked your interest?

Apply now and join our team!

This is a talent pool, there is no fixed application deadline — we will review applications continuously.

By applying, your profile will be considered for upcoming opportunities that match your skills, experience, and interests. We will keep you updated accordingly throughout the process.

-Mercell is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

-Mercell handles all personal data in line with GDPR and our Privacy Policy.

-Mercell does not provide relocation support. We are seeking candidates who are already based in, or have existing work authorization for, the country where the role is located.

-Mercell may carry out background checks on applicants to verify information that appears on CVs and other documentation. This background check is carried out by an external party and is not carried out without the consent of the applicant. Current applicants will receive further information about this.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Mercell, we’re transforming how businesses manage procurement and public tendering processes. As a leading provider of digital solutions for procurement, we help organizations across Europe streamline, automate, and optimize their sourcing operations. Our cloud-based platform connects buyers and suppliers, driving transparency, efficiency, and compliance in public and private sector procurement. The Problem We Solve: Procurement is often plagued by inefficiencies, manual workflows, and a lack of transparency, making it time-consuming and prone to errors. This not only impacts operational performance but can also prevent businesses from making strategic, cost-effective decisions. At Mercell, we are solving these challenges by providing an integrated solution that simplifies the tendering process, ensures compliance with regulatory standards, and empowers businesses with data-driven insights. Why We Do It: We believe that efficient procurement is at the heart of sustainable business growth. By digitizing and optimizing the procurement process, we help organizations save time, reduce costs, and make smarter decisions, all while fostering a more competitive and transparent marketplace. Our goal is to empower organizations to focus on their core business, leaving procurement complexity to us. At Mercell, we’re driven by innovation and a passion to continuously improve the procurement landscape.

At ROEST, we design and produce some of the world’s most innovative coffee roasters, combining advanced technology with sleek design. Our products are renowned for precision, quality, and sustainability. With customers in over 80 countries, we’re proud to set new standards in the coffee industry.


What We Offer:
  • An exciting and varied workday with tasks including assembly, testing, service, and continuous improvement of our award-winning technology.
  • The opportunity to help launch our next-generation electric roaster .
  • A key role in producing a product that impacts the global coffee industry.
  • A collaborative work environment where we support each other to ensure top quality and efficient processes.

As a Production Technician/Assembler at ROEST, your tasks will include:

  • Assembling and inspecting advanced mechanical, electrical, and electronic components.
  • Performing quality control and testing of finished products.
  • Contributing to the optimization of production processes to enhance efficiency and quality.
  • Troubleshooting and repairing components when needed.

Who Are You?

You’re a great fit if you:

  • Has experience in technical assembly, mechanics, electronics, or a related field.
  • Enjoys precise, systematic work with strong attention to detail.
  • Is eager to contribute to continuous improvement in production processes
  • Thrive in a collaborative, team-driven environment.


If you’re passionate about technology, have a knack for hands-on work, and enjoy seeing tangible results from your efforts, this could be the job for you!

Your Benefits:
  • We offer a chance to work in a team-oriented working atmosphere in a fast-growing, profitable scale-up 
  • Competitive salary.
  • Employee stock program.
  • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays.
  • Company pension scheme.

Why Work For Us?

At ROEST, you’ll have the opportunity to make an impact and join us as we design solutions that revolutionize the coffee industry. We are on an incredible journey to create smart and efficient innovations for our customers and the coffee world.

What began as a master’s thesis has grown into a fast-paced, open-minded company with an international team passionate about improving coffee. Since 2018, we have sold over 2,000 coffee roasters to more than 80 countries worldwide. We’re now preparing for our next big leap – the launch of the P3000, a cutting-edge production roaster designed to redefine coffee roasting for professional roasteries.

Join us at ROEST and be part of shaping the future of the coffee industry!


Location: ROEST is centrally located at Bryn in Oslo, Norway.

description:
Monil is building world-leading technology for virtual fencing and livestock monitoring. In just three years, we’ve grown to thousands of customers and tens of thousands collars in active use across multiple markets. We are now entering a new phase of international growth — and the scalability and reliability of our backend platform will be critical to our success.

Our technology is trusted by forward-thinking farmers, research institutions, and agricultural organizations across several countries. Every day, thousands of animals rely on our systems running smoothly.

Our devices collect large amounts of real-time data from animals in the field. We process, analyze, and transform this data into actionable insights that improve animal welfare, farming efficiency, and sustainability. Behind this is a modern, cloud-based backend platform built for performance, resilience, and scale.

We're now looking for a Site Reliability Engineer who wants to help us build a reliable platform, scaling across the globe.

What we're looking for

  • Strong experience with AWS and Kubernetes

  • Experience with building and maintaining CD pipelines and deployment strategies

  • Experience running and maintaining PostgreSQL databases

  • Experience with networks

  • Experience with monitoring and alerting using tools such as Prometheus and OpenTelemetry

Bonus points for

  • Fluency in Norwegian (preferred, but we make exceptions for the exceptional)

  • Experience working in a startup or fast-paced environment

Our Tech Stack

  • Heavy use of Kubernetes (EKS)

  • Large PostgreSQL databases

  • Terraform, ArgoCD, LinkerD, Alloy, Tempo and more

What We Offer

Join a high-growth startup entering an exciting international scale-up phase. You won’t just write code, you’ll own features and initiatives, influence technical decisions, and help build the foundation of a growing company. Nevertheless your work will create meaningful impact by improving animal welfare, farming efficiency, and global sustainability. You’ll collaborate with a highly interdisciplinary team across hardware, embedded systems, backend, and frontend. We offer a competitive salary, including an option program.

Requirements

Candidates must have the right to work in Norway or within the EU/EEA, as we are unable to support relocation or visa sponsorship from outside this area.

If you're excited about building technology that makes a real-world difference, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Head of Software Engineering
description:
About Monil

Monil is building world-leading technology for virtual fencing and livestock monitoring. In just four years, we've grown to over 1,000 customers and more than 50,000 collars deployed across multiple markets, and we are now entering a new phase of international growth with rapid expansion into the US.

At the heart of our solution is a collar that combines animal interaction, sensors, positioning, and wireless communication, but the value our customers experience lives in the software: the cloud platform, the data pipelines that turn raw device telemetry into insight, and the apps farmers use every day to control and understand their herds in real time.

We're looking for a Head of Software Engineering to own and scale that software, and to build the team and technical foundations that will carry us through international expansion.

About the role

This is a senior leadership role reporting directly to the CEO, with full ownership of our software engineering function across frontend, backend, and data. You will set technical direction, build and grow the team, and be accountable for the quality, reliability, and velocity of everything we ship above the device layer. The role is part of Monil’s management team and will be crucial to guide the company in a rapid growth phase.

You will collaborate closely with our product and hardware teams. Your effectiveness will depend as much on strong, trust-based collaboration with those teams as on your technical leadership. Product owns the what and the why; Hardware owns the device. You own the how and the when for all software and data products, and you are the connective tissue that turns device capability and product intent into reliable, shipped systems.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the architecture, delivery, and operational health of Monil's software platform across frontend, backend, and data.

  • Lead and grow a high-performing engineering organisation: hiring, mentoring, structuring teams, and setting the technical and cultural bar.

  • Define and drive software engineering standards, and technical best practices across the platform, including CI/CD, testing, observability, and on-call/reliability practices.

  • Build the data foundation that turns high-volume telemetry into reliable, queryable, and actionable data. Ensure that all models are productionised, platform-integrated, and maintained to the same high standards as the rest of the systems.

  • Partner closely with Product to translate roadmaps into deliverable, well-sequenced engineering plans, and to make pragmatic trade-offs on scope, timing, and technical investment.

  • Partner closely with R&D on the device-to-cloud boundary, telemetry contracts, device management, and OTA: ensuring software and firmware evolve coherently.

  • Own delivery: balance feature velocity against the architectural and operational work needed to scale internationally and reliably.

  • Be accountable for software quality, security, and the production reliability of customer-facing systems.

We believe you have

  • Significant experience leading software engineering teams, with a track record of shipping and operating production systems at scale.

  • Strong technical depth across at least one of frontend, backend, or data engineering, and the breadth and credibility to lead all three.

  • Experience with modern backend and cloud architectures, distributed systems, and the data infrastructure behind high-volume telemetry or IoT-style workloads.

  • A solid grasp of modern engineering practices; CI/CD, automated testing, observability.

  • Experience working alongside product and hardware functions, and a genuine ability to drive outcomes through influence and collaboration rather than authority alone.

  • Strong people leadership: hiring, growing, and retaining engineers, and building team structures that scale.

Experience with any of the following is a plus: connected/IoT systems and device-to-cloud data flows; edge or on-device ML; low-power or connectivity-constrained system design; OTA and device management at scale.

We believe you are

  • Passionate about building reliable products that operate in challenging real-world environments.

  • Comfortable owning outcomes end to end and driving them from idea to production.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
📍 Remote, based in Poland

About Us

At No Isolation, we’re a profitable, 65-person Scandinavian EdTech scale-up operating across Europe. We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child.

Our AV1 robot is deployed in 19 countries, with 5,000+ units supporting schools to improve attendance, belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be physically present. The Opportunity

Your purpose in this role is simple: help us grow by proactively identifying and approaching talented people who aren't actively looking, but would be a great fit if approached the right way. Our ability to hire the best people, fast, directly determines how quickly we can scale.

This role is mainly focused on proactive sourcing and candidate screening, with the possibility to also handle a few roles full-cycle (360), from brief through to offer and close. The hires will mainly be across Commercial and Operational teams, with possibility of some Tech and Product roles as well. We're looking for someone who can map our markets, build lasting candidate relationships, and give hiring managers a steady stream of great people to talk to — not a slow trickle of applicants.

What You'll Do

Proactive sourcing

  • Map our markets and proactively reach out to passive candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, job boards, and your network

  • Build talent pools for recurring or future hard-to-fill roles, and screen candidates for fit before progressing them

  • Keep our pipeline data in shape, track TA KPIs, and flag risks early

Full-cycle recruitment

  • Own a smaller share of roles end-to-end — from brief, through interviews, to offer and close

Alongside this, you'll partner with hiring managers to understand what they need and advise on candidate market insight, keep candidates engaged throughout the process, and craft and post job ads on relevant job boards.

What You Bring

  • 2–3 years in talent acquisition, recruitment, or proactive sourcing, with a genuine track record of engaging passive candidates

  • Experience across more than one European market

  • Fluent with LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, and ATS tools, and curious about using AI to work smarter

  • Confident stakeholder management

  • Excellent written and spoken English is required; working proficiency in German is an advantage

If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

We're a Scandinavian company with a high-performance, caring culture. We set the bar high, and we back each other to get there.

  • Big impact, real ownership: This is a scale-up, not a corporate machine. We start from a place of trust, so you'll have real ownership of your work from day one, with support from a highly experienced team

  • A genuine growth story: We're one of the few full-stack EdTech companies growing at our rate of profitability, and we've still only scratched the surface of the market. There is plenty of opportunity to grow alongside us, not just fill a seat

How to Apply

Please click APPLY and upload your CV in English, and record a short video in English outlining your motivation and letting your personality shine through.

Location & Salary

📍 Remote, based in Poland.

We're unable to sponsor visas or work permits. Candidates must already have the legal right to work in Poland (e.g., EU/EEA citizenship, permanent residency, or an existing valid work permit).
