title: Fullstack-utvikler / AI-utvikler – arbeidstrening eller praksis i B2B/industri-startup
description:
Company: RoboConnect

Location: Molde, Norway

Work type: Full-time or part-time

Role type: Internship / student / junior developer / work training

Salary: Unpaid in the initial phase

Long-term possibility: Paid role may become possible if RoboConnect secures revenue, funding or a suitable commercial basis

Short description

RoboConnect is building an AI-supported B2B platform that helps industrial companies clarify automation needs before they invest in robotics, automation or system integration.

We are looking for a locally based fullstack developer who wants hands-on startup experience and can contribute to the development of RoboConnect’s platform, AI Advisor and internal tools. This is not a co-founder role and not an ordinary paid position at this stage, but it may become a paid role later if the collaboration works well and the company develops commercially.

About RoboConnect

Many industrial companies know they need to automate, but struggle to define what should be automated, what information is missing, whether the process is ready for investment, and which suppliers they should involve.

RoboConnect helps companies move from an unclear automation need to a structured and decision-relevant basis for internal decisions and supplier dialogue. The platform combines industrial automation insight, structured project data, AI-supported needs clarification, project preparation and matching with relevant automation partners.

The first focus area is welding automation and high-mix, low-volume manufacturing. We are currently preparing customer pilots and further development of the MVP.

Why we need a developer in-house

RoboConnect is moving from concept and market validation into product development, pilots and technical iteration. We need stronger internal technical capacity, especially around the AI Advisor, frontend, backend, API integrations, data structure and user flows.

The current platform and AI work involves several moving parts, including customer registration, project forms, dashboards, structured project data, AI-assisted needs clarification, report generation and matching logic.

We are therefore looking for a developer who can work closely with the founder and contribute practically to building, improving and testing the product.

A local candidate in Molde or nearby is strongly preferred, because close collaboration, product discussions and faster iteration will be important. Some remote work may be possible, but we would like in-person collaboration several days per week.

What you will work on

You will contribute to practical product development for RoboConnect, including:

  • frontend development and user interface improvements

  • backend development and API integrations

  • AI Advisor / chatbot functionality for needs clarification

  • structured data capture from customer conversations or forms

  • database structure and data handling

  • dashboards for customers, suppliers and admin users

  • GitHub workflow, documentation and testing

  • improving user flows from registration to project clarification

  • preparing technical demos for pilots and customer feedback

The first tasks will be scoped clearly. The goal is not to build everything at once, but to make focused improvements that can be tested with real users.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for someone with some practical development experience who wants to build real software in an early-stage startup.

You should have experience with, or strong interest in:

  • fullstack development

  • frontend and backend development

  • JavaScript / TypeScript

  • React / Next.js

  • APIs

  • databases

  • GitHub

  • AI tools, LLMs or chatbot development

  • structured problem solving

  • building usable products, not only experimenting with technology

Experience with Tailwind, Supabase, Convex, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Vercel, OpenAI, Anthropic or similar tools is an advantage, but not required if you learn quickly.

You do not need to be senior, but you should have built something before and be able to work independently on defined tasks.

You must be comfortable with

  • working in a very early-stage startup

  • incomplete systems and changing priorities

  • documenting your work clearly

  • committing code regularly to RoboConnect’s GitHub repository

  • working with agreed scope and delivery expectations

  • discussing technical choices openly

  • asking questions when something is unclear

  • receiving feedback and improving the solution iteratively

You must not commit API keys, passwords or secrets to GitHub. Production data and production credentials will not be shared during an initial trial period.

Language and location

Norwegian language skills are strongly preferred, because RoboConnect works with Norwegian industrial companies and customer needs must be understood clearly.

Candidates who speak English may also be considered if they are willing to learn Norwegian and can collaborate effectively in Norway.

The ideal candidate is located in Molde or within commuting distance. Candidates who can be physically present in Molde several days per week will be prioritized.

Practical setup

This is initially intended as an unpaid work-training, internship or experience-based role, depending on the candidate’s situation.

It may be especially relevant for someone who:

  • wants more practical experience in fullstack development

  • wants to build real startup/product experience

  • has completed studies, courses or self-learning but needs real project experience

  • is registered with NAV and may be eligible for work training or similar arrangements

  • wants to build a portfolio with meaningful product work

  • is interested in AI, automation, industrial technology or B2B platforms

RoboConnect will not present this as an ordinary paid employment relationship unless a separate paid agreement is made.

If the collaboration works well and RoboConnect secures revenue, funding or another commercial basis, a paid role may become possible later.

What you can gain

You will get hands-on experience with:

  • building a real B2B SaaS/AI platform

  • AI-supported product development

  • industrial automation use cases

  • customer needs clarification

  • startup product development

  • fullstack development in practice

  • GitHub, documentation, testing and deployment workflow

  • working close to the founder and team in an early-stage company

This is a good opportunity for someone who wants more than a theoretical project and wants to join in build something that may be used by real industrial companies.

About the founder

RoboConnect was founded by Elisabet Witsø. The company is based in Molde and connected to the industrial and automation ecosystem in Norway.

RoboConnect is still in an early phase, but has completed market validation, interviewed industrial companies and automation partners, completed MVP, and is preparing the next step toward pilots and commercial testing.

How to apply

Please apply through The Hub and answer the short application questions. Please also include your CV and GitHub profile.

The questions are intended to give us a better understanding of your motivation, availability, language skills, practical situation and how you work as a developer.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

1. Short description RoboConnect is developing an independent, AI-supported platform that helps industrial companies turn tacit and fragmented process knowledge into a clear, decision-relevant automation case — before supplier dialogue begins. 2. The problem Many industrial companies know they need to automate, but struggle to define what should be automated, what is causing the problem and whether the process is ready for investment. The people closest to production often understand the process well, but this knowledge may be spread across operators, engineers and management, poorly documented or mixed with assumptions and missing data. The customer may therefore approach the market with an unclear problem description and incomplete information. System integrators then have to reconstruct the customer’s process understanding and collect missing data before a meaningful solution dialogue can begin. This creates uncertainty, longer clarification phases, weak or difficult-to-compare proposals and projects that stall early. The core problem is not a lack of technology or suppliers. It is that the knowledge needed to make a good early automation decision is often tacit, fragmented and difficult to transfer. 3. The solution RoboConnect starts by understanding the customer’s process, challenges and actual needs. The RoboConnect AI Advisor conducts a guided professional conversation that helps the company describe how production works today, what it wants to improve, which constraints matter and what information is still missing. The AI Advisor brings together information from different parts of the organisation, separates facts from assumptions and uncertainty, identifies knowledge gaps and risks, and turns unclear issues into practical next actions. The result is a shared and structured automation basis that can be developed into a supplier-ready project brief. Relevant projects can then be connected with suitable system integrators, technology suppliers and R&D environments. This gives the customer greater decision confidence and solution providers a better starting point. RoboConnect is not building a generic chatbot. The platform combines a domain-specific workflow, structured project data and knowledge from industrial cases, expert interviews and feedback from customers and automation partners. Over time, this strengthens clarification, project maturation and matching. The first focused area is welding automation and high-mix, low-volume manufacturing. The longer-term ambition is to expand across other automation categories and build a Nordic platform for early-stage automation clarification and matching. 4. Business model and commercial opportunity RoboConnect creates value on both sides of the market. Industrial companies receive a clearer and safer starting point, while automation partners gain access to better-qualified customer opportunities. The current model is based mainly on supplier-side revenue through fees for qualified matches and successful projects. Future revenue streams may include paid AI-assisted readiness reports, supplier subscriptions, premium access and category-specific products. The model is now being validated through pilots and early customer projects. Norway is the validation market, with Sweden as the first intended scale-up market. 5. Why I started RoboConnect The motivation came from repeated conversations with industrial companies, automation experts and system integrators. I saw that many projects became uncertain long before technology was selected. Companies needed a more independent and structured way to understand their own situation before entering a supplier-led process. With a background in research, data analysis and complex problem structuring, combined with further training in programming, databases and AI, I founded RoboConnect to bridge the gap between industrial process knowledge and automation delivery.

description:
About Us

At No Isolation, we’re a profitable, 65-person Scandinavian EdTech scale-up operating across Europe. We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child.

Our AV1 robot is deployed in 19 countries, with 5,000+ units supporting schools to improve attendance, belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.

We’re established enough to have a proven solution and strong financial foundations, yet still small enough for every new colleague to have a visible impact on our next stage of growth.

The Opportunity — AI Integration Engineer

This is a new role at No Isolation, and you'd be the first person in it.

You'll sit inside Engineering but work mostly embedded inside selected internal business units, in contrast to the rest of Engineering. You’ll work with Sales, Customer Success, Finance and Operations. You’ll connect the tools they depend on and implement AI tools and automation flows to positively impact our revenue first and foremost, but also generally enhance internal effectiveness.

In practice: you set the bar for how much internal AI and Automation can change the company from the inside in 2026 and beyond, and you co-own the stack you put in place. You will have a lot of direct contact with the teams you're building for, and a lot of say in how the technical side gets structured to enable you, while having the support of experienced software engineers when needed.

What You'll Do — Scope & Responsibilities

  • Systems integration: Drive automation of key business areas and connect our business tools across Data, IAM, CRM, ERP (Odoo) and Finance through APIs, webhooks and events, so data stays in sync across systems.

  • Internal automation capability: Build and maintain workflows in Windmill and/or n8n; migrate us off legacy SaaS and iPaaS tools as you go. Aim to articulate as many problems as possible as deterministic automations that keep data and AI cost low.

  • Internal AI capability: Contribute to shared infrastructure for using AI internally alongside our cloud/platform engineers: assistants, retrieval over internal knowledge, summarisation, classification, routing, etc. Turn ad hoc AI experiments into tools people can actually rely on, with eval sets in place to catch regressions.

  • Data & internal foundations: Centralise data into sources the business can trust, reconcile figures across systems so numbers match wherever they appear, and provide internal tools and lightly-built apps.

  • Guardrails & cost control: Define the standards for how integrations and AI get built here. Keep the set of automation platforms small and deliberate (e.g. Windmill, n8n and some custom). Track AI spend and return on investment so we can monitor alignment between the two.

  • Partnership: Work directly with the teams you're building for: understand the actual problem, ship a working increment near-instantly, then iterate and negotiate toward durability. You're measured on time saved, additional revenue generated, budget synergies realised, not on the tools you ship. Share knowledge and lift others through e.g. workshops and townhalls.

What You Bring — Experience & Capabilities

  • Talent for working directly with non-technical stakeholders and turning a fuzzy request into a concrete system. This is a first-of-its-kind role here, so you're setting direction rather than following an existing playbook.

  • Experience connecting systems through APIs, webhooks and events: ERPs (Odoo v18 and beyond is a plus), CRMs, or Finance systems. At ease with various application protocols (REST), auth flows (OAuth/SSO) and the rough edges of third-party SaaS APIs.

  • Hands-on with a code-first orchestration platform: Windmill, Temporal, Airflow, n8n or similar.

  • A builder who finishes: Proficient in at least one general-purpose language (Python, TypeScript, Go), and comfortable taking something from rough prototype (built by you or non-technical people) to engineering standard.

  • Comfortable using and configuring self-hosted tooling (containers, secrets, backups, upgrades) to some extent, as opposed to fully leaning on managed SaaS

  • Practical experience with LLMs and agents: context engineering, RAG, evals, tool/function calling. You should have a good sense of where AI helps and where it adds fragility.

  • Data sense: savvy with SQL and common data stores; able to model, reconcile and centralize data; some exposure to classical machine learning can be an advantage.

  • Security-conscious by default: least-privilege access, careful handling of secrets, aware of GDPR, SOC and ISO requirements.

  • STEM degree (BSc/MSc) or equivalent practical experience in integration, AI & automation, or internal tooling.

  • Experience at product or scale-up companies is an advantage.

Why You'll Love It Here

  • First-of-its-kind role: you will tackle opportunities unexplored so far at the company

  • Purpose with scale: The systems you build free up time that goes straight back into helping educators support thousands of children connected, learning, and included every single day.

  • Work with exceptional leaders: You'll report to our Director of Engineering, Jerome, with plenty of room to shape a high-trust, learning-driven engineering culture.

  • Growth through ownership: A lean environment with the freedom to propose what you think is best for our very company.

  • Stability with a lean size: We are profitable and growing rapidly, while keeping at a size where the ideal candidate will have high impact.

  • Flexible working around core hours (10:00–15:00), with a hybrid work schedule.

  • 27 vacation days.

  • Travel and accident insurance for you and your immediate family.

  • Enhanced parental and sick leave.

  • Mobile phone and internet subscription reimbursement.

  • Regular company socials and an annual trip away together.

Our Tech Stack

Think internal tools, fleets of connected robots, and the systems that keep Sales, Finance and Customer Success running. You'll work with:

  • Orchestration & automation: Windmill, n8n

  • Languages: Go, Python, TypeScript

  • Systems: Odoo, HubSpot, and the wider CRM/finance/IAM stack

  • AI: LLMs and agents, RAG/retrieval, MCP, evaluation tooling

  • Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, containers

  • Data: SQL, MySQL, ClickHouse

  • Development: GitLab, Claude Code and handful of other solutions being evaluated

Location

This role is based in Oslo with hybrid flexibility at our headquarters (up to 2 days remote work per week).

We welcome all qualified applicants. Due to current visa/work-permit processes, we can progress candidates already in Norway or relocating with no need for additional work permit (such as the EU/EEA citizens). (This note is about work authorization only; no sensitive personal data is required).

How to Apply

If you like building things that make everyone else's work easier, are passionate about AI, and want that to matter for something bigger, we'd love to hear from you.

Please click Apply and upload your CV in English.

If you'd like, you can also include a short video as part of your application — this is optional, but it gives us a chance to see a bit more of who you are beyond your CV.

🎥 You may watch how AV1 transforms inclusion in education here: vimeo.com/1098745115

🌍 You may explore our mission and impact stories at noisolation.com

We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this position.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We help educators bring learning and belonging to every child. School absence is the biggest challenge facing education. Our AV1 robots connect absent students, ensure learning and belonging, and support reintegration back to the classroom. Today, there are over 3,500 active AV1 robots used across 18 European countries. Positioned in the EdTech sector, AV1 is a unique solution to the growing issue of persistent absence, supporting both the academic and social needs of students. No Isolation works across Europe, with 45 employees across Europe and in offices in Oslo, Munich and London. Join us in our growth journey!

title: Part-time Driver Larvik
description:
Join us as a driver on weekends in Larvik!

At Oda, we come to work every day to create affordable grocery services that make the logistics of living surprisingly easy for our customers in Norway and Sweden. That’s what gets us fired up. First, we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective retail system. With our wide selection and competitive prices, we deliver to the doorsteps of thousands of Scandinavian homes every week.

As a driver with us, you play an essential role in representing Oda to our customers. You will be part of our dedicated team of drivers and report to the Delivery Operating Manager and the Delivery Team Leaders on-site. You’ll deliver groceries and packages to our customers in the area. We believe you'll enjoy working as a driver at Oda if you can manage your time effectively, work independently and as part of a team, and approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset. It would also be best if you enjoy being active, as this job involves a lot of physical activity, not just driving.


What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

  • Delivering food and packages to our customers.

  • Maintain efficiency and quality by loading and unloading goods, handling customers, and following routines and processes.

  • Ensuring Customer service at the highest level.

  • Be responsible for simple maintenance of the car fleet, such as changing light bulbs, topping up liquids, and keeping the cars clean and presentable at all times.

  • Training new drivers on the road.

  • Contributing to the improvement of driver routines and processes.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • Driving license (Class B) with a minimum of 2 years' driving experience.

  • Speaking English is required, and familiarity with Norwegian or another Nordic language is a plus.


What would be nice to have 💡

  • Are active and like it, as this is a physically demanding job

  • Like working independently and with a team

  • Have a good work ethic

  • Are service-oriented and solution-oriented.

  • Have a genuine desire to succeed and make customers happy

  • Responsible and prioritizes safe behaviour in traffic


What we offer 🚀

This is your chance to make a real impact as a Driver in a fast-moving company with a product people love—while shaking up the grocery industry. You’ll experience:

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop—less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.


Practical informationℹ️

  • Application deadline: Apply before 30.09. We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process once we find the right candidates, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible.

  • Starting date: As soon as possible

  • Location: Rødbølveien 16, 3270 Larvik

  • Working hours: Part-time 20% position with work every other weekend, Saturday 05:30-13:30 and Sunday 13:30-21:30


At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.

As part of our work to ensure a fair and open-minded recruitment process, we have chosen to collaborate with Hubert.ai, a virtual recruitment assistant that helps with the selection process. As soon as you submit an application for this position, you will be invited via email to a chat-based interview. Therefore, be careful to enter your correct email address so that the invitation reaches the right person🤖

We can’t wait to hear from you🧡

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

title: Customer Support Specialist- Spain
description:
Sobre nosotros

Nofence ha creado la primera solución de cercado virtual del mundo para ganado. La tecnología consiste en un collar con energía solar que se comunica con una aplicación a través de la red celular. Mediante la aplicación, los ganaderos pueden configurar nuevas zonas de pastoreo en segundos. El ganado puede pastar durante más tiempo y en más zonas, siempre pudiendo controlar su ubicación. Esto se traduce en mayor rentabilidad, más tiempo libre para los ganaderos y un mejor bienestar animal.

Con más de 3000 clientes en Noruega, Suecia, Reino Unido, España, Irlanda y Estados Unidos, estamos ampliando nuestro equipo para crecer en España.

Nuestro equipo de soporte busca un candidato bilingüe (español/inglés) para reforzar nuestro equipo. ¡Únete a nosotros en este viaje para revolucionar la ganadería y crear una vida mejor para ganaderos y animales!

Sobre el puesto

El puesto implica el seguimiento diario de clientes y la gestión de casos de soporte. Formarás parte integral de un equipo comprometido con un enfoque centrado en el cliente. Buscamos a una persona organizada y entusiasta para unirse a nuestro equipo y brindar un excelente servicio al cliente.

Para establecer buenas relaciones con los clientes, necesitamos comprender sus necesidades y guiarlos para que aprovechen al máximo nuestro producto. Se valorará positivamente la experiencia previa trabajando con agricultores y ganaderos.

Buscamos a una persona organizada con una actitud flexible en todos los aspectos del puesto. El candidato ideal es proactivo, enérgico y trabajador, preferiblemente con experiencia en el sector agrícola/ganadero.

Como parte de nuestro equipo, tendrás la oportunidad de crecer junto con la empresa, ya que las oportunidades de desarrollo son ilimitadas tanto para nuestro producto como para nuestros empleados.

Título: Asesor/a de Soporte al Cliente

Estado: Jornada completa. 40 horas semanales

Supervisor: Responsable de España

Ubicación: España (preferiblemente cerca de Vitoria-Gasteiz)

Responsabilidades principales

Las principales responsabilidades de este puesto serán:

  • Responder a las consultas de nuestros clientes por teléfono, correo electrónico y creación de tickets.

  • Mantener un contacto estrecho con los clientes y garantizar un alto nivel de satisfacción.

  • Colaborar con otros departamentos y equipos dentro de Nofence.

  • Documentar y actualizar los registros y casos de los clientes en nuestro sistema CRM.

  • Remitir los problemas complejos a nuestro departamento de Producto e Ingeniería.

  • Contribuir a la recopilación de estadísticas sobre el rendimiento de nuestros productos.

  • Garantizar el intercambio de conocimientos e información entre los equipos de soporte central y local.

En la fase actual de crecimiento de nuestro equipo, necesitamos a alguien adaptable y dispuesto a contribuir con tareas no relacionadas con el soporte, como:

  • Contribuir con proyectos de toda la organización.

  • Mejorar la experiencia del cliente mediante soporte proactivo: ayudar al cliente a adquirir conocimientos y encontrar soluciones a través de nuestras herramientas y canales de información.

  • Contribuir al desarrollo del equipo de soporte y a la configuración de nuestra estructura.

Sobre ti

Buscamos a alguien con lo siguiente:

  • Título universitario o similar en un campo relevante para el puesto (agricultura/ganadería) o experiencia práctica en una explotación.

  • Experiencia como consultor de soporte o en un puesto similar en una empresa o sector tecnológico.

  • Capacidad para solucionar problemas de hardware y software utilizando diversas herramientas y métodos.

  • Gran interés en nuestro producto y capacidad para adquirir conocimientos sobre nuestra tecnología.

  • Buenas habilidades informáticas y experiencia con soluciones informáticas.

  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita.

  • Dominio del español (oral y escrito) y conocimientos básicos de inglés.

  • Se valorará la pasión por resolver problemas técnicos complejos, pero no es un requisito indispensable.

Buscamos a alguien que:

  • Tenga iniciativa, trabaje de forma independiente y priorice las tareas más importantes.

  • Apasionado/a por el servicio al cliente en general, con gran capacidad para identificar desafíos y ofrecer soluciones.

  • Independiente y proactivo/a.

  • Eficiente y con facilidad para trabajar en equipo.

  • Un/a jugador/a de equipo con vocación de servicio.

  • Gran atención al detalle y un sólido compromiso con la calidad.

  • Un/a jugador/a de equipo que colabora eficazmente, comparte conocimientos, experiencia e información, y apoya a sus compañeros en la consecución de los objetivos del equipo.

¿Qué podemos ofrecer?

Como empresa en sus inicios, nuestra forma de trabajar está en constante evolución, y tendrás la oportunidad de influir en cómo hacemos las cosas. Nos apasiona el desarrollo de productos, el bienestar animal, el bienestar de los ganaderos y la agricultura sostenible. Como parte de nuestro equipo, formarás parte de una empresa dinámica con grandes ambiciones de crecimiento internacional.

¡Creemos firmemente que nuestra tecnología de pastoreo puede ser el mayor avance tecnológico en la agricultura desde el tractor!

Acerca de Nofence

La gestión del ganado siempre ha sido un desafío. La humanidad ha intentado de todo, desde el pastoreo con perros hasta el cercado con alambre, cercas eléctricas y de madera, pero estas soluciones son costosas y requieren mucho tiempo, además de entrar en conflicto con la fauna local.

Hasta ahora.

Lo que comenzó como un pequeño grupo de agricultores e ingenieros con una gran idea se ha convertido en Nofence: la primera solución de vallado virtual para ganado del mundo. ¿Tienes curiosidad por saber cómo funciona? Descubre más aquí.

Acerca del equipo

En Nofence, no somos un trabajo de oficina convencional. Somos una empresa dinámica en crecimiento, donde la dedicación y la innovación son la norma, ofreciendo grandes oportunidades para tu desarrollo personal y profesional.

¡Creemos firmemente que nuestra tecnología de pastoreo es el mayor avance tecnológico en la ganadería desde el tractor!

Forma parte de un equipo que siempre mira hacia el futuro, donde tus ideas y creatividad no solo son bienvenidas, sino esenciales para nuestro éxito mutuo.

Acerca de la solicitud

¿Estás listo?

Evaluaremos a los candidatos de forma continua. Si tienes alguna pregunta sobre Nofence o sobre la solicitud, no dudes en contactarnos.






About us

Nofence has built the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. The technology consists of a solar-powered collar that communicates with an app over the cellular network. Through the app, farmers can set up a new grazing area in seconds, and the long days of installing and moving fences are officially over! Livestock can graze longer and in more areas, and the farmer will always have visibility of their location. This means better profitability and more free time for farmers as well as improved animal welfare.

With a strong foundation of 3,000+ customers in Norway, Sweden, the UK, Spain, Ireland and the US we are now expanding our team to grow in Spain.

Our support team is now looking for an Spanish/English speaking candidate to strengthen our team. Join us on the journey to revolutionize agriculture and create a better everyday life for farmers and animals!

About the role

The position will involve daily follow-up with customers and support cases. You will become an integral part of a dedicated team with a customer centric approach. We are looking for a structured and enthusiastic team member who is eager to provide excellent customer service.

To create good customer relations we need to be able to understand the customers needs and guide them through how to best utilize our product. Previous experience of working with farmers would be a great advantage.

We are looking for a structured candidate with a flexible approach to all aspects of the role. The right candidate is self-motivated, energetic, and hardworking, preferably with a background from agriculture. As a part of our team you will have the opportunity to grow together with the company, as the opportunities for development are endless both for our product and our employees!

Title: Customer Support Advisor

Status: Full-time position. 40-hrs a week

Supervisor: Head of Spain

Location: Spain (preferably closer to Vitoria-Gasteiz)


Main Responsibilities

The main responsibilities for this role will be:

  • Responding to inquiries from our customers via phone, email and ticketing system,

  • Maintaining close customer contact and securing a high level of customer satisfaction.

  • Collaborating across departments and other teams within Nofence.

  • Documenting and updating customer records and cases in our CRM system.

  • Escalating complex or unresolved issues to our Product and Engineering department.

  • Contributing in collecting statistics on the performance of our products.

  • Ensuring knowledge and information sharing between the central and local support teams.

In the current phase of growing our team we will need someone who is adaptable and willing to contribute to non-support related tasks like;

  • Contributing to projects across the organization.

  • Improving the customer journey through proactive support - helping the customer gain competence and finding solutions through our tools and information channels.

  • Contributing to developing the Support team and shaping our structure.


About you

We are looking for someone who has the following:

  • A degree or equivalent in a field relevant to the position (agriculture/livestock) or practical on-farm experience.

  • Experience as a support consultant or similar role in a tech company or industry.

  • Ability to troubleshoot hardware and software issues using various tools and methods.

  • Keen interest in our product and ability to gain competence in our technology.

  • Good IT skills and experience with ICT solutions.

  • Strong communication skills both orally and in writing.

  • Fluent written and verbal communication skills in Spanish and basic English.

  • Passion for resolving complex technical issues is preferred, but not a requirement.

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Eager to show initiative, works independently and prioritises the most important tasks first.

  • Passionate for customer service in general, and has an eye for discovering challenges and providing solutions.

  • Independent and self-driven.

  • Efficient and enjoys structure.

  • A team player with a heart for the greater good.

  • High attention to detail and a solid commitment to quality.

  • A team player that cooperate well with others, share knowledge, experience and information, and support other team members in the pursuit of team goals.


What can we offer?

As a company still in our early stages, our way of working is continuously evolving, and you will have the opportunity to make an impact on how we do things. We are passionate about product development, animal welfare, farmer welfare and sustainable agriculture. As our colleague you will be part of an exciting company with enormous ambitions for international growth. We genuinely believe our grazing technology can be the biggest technological change in agriculture since the tractor!


About Nofence

Managing livestock has always been a challenge. Humanity has tried everything from herding with dogs to walling the animals in with barbed wire, electric, and wooden fences, but these are costly and time-consuming solutions and often in conflict with the local wildlife. It has also left vast areas of potential pasture overgrown and underutilized.

Until now.

Enter virtual fences. What started as a small group of farmers and engineers with a big idea has become Nofence – the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. Curious about how it works? Find out more here.


About the team

At Nofence, we are not your typical 9-to-5 gig. We are a dynamic scale-up, where dedication and innovation are the norm, offering great opportunities for your personal and professional growth. We are passionate about product development, animal welfare, farmer welfare and sustainable agriculture. We genuinely believe our grazing technology is the biggest technological change in agriculture since the tractor!

Be part of a team that’s always looking forward, where your ideas and creativity are not only welcomed but also essential to our mutual success!

About the Application

Are you ready to change pasture?

We will evaluate candidates continuously. If you have any questions about Nofence or regarding the application, please reach out.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vår beiteteknologi skal bidra til at mer av verdens arealressurser kan utnyttes til bærekraftig matproduksjon.En stor andel beitedyr lever mesteparten av livet innendørs og spiser mye kraftfor. Målsettingen til Nofence er å få beitedyra ut på beite, på en trygg og god måte, slik at de kan ha det godt og selv finne den maten de er skapt for å spise.Vi vil at beitedyr skal få muligheten til å ta i bruk sitt naturlige miljø. Det er god dyrevelferd og det vil frigjøre store arealer som kan brukes til å dyrke menneskemat i stedet for soya i kraftforproduksjon.Vår teknologi gir dyra denne muligheten.

title: Content Specialist Intern | France
description:
Mets ta plume au service d'une scale-up scandinave en pleine croissance

Tu es étudiant en dernière année de master en communication ou journalisme et tu es à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études où tes textes auront un impact ? Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement international, au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance, tout en développant tes compétences en rédaction web et SEO ?

Nettbureau recherche un stagiaire pour soutenir le marché francophone de contenu et de texte, de janvier à juin 2027 à Oslo.

À propos de Nettbureau

Nettbureau aide chaque année des millions d’utilisateurs à faire des choix éclairés grâce à nos services de comparaison qui les mettent en relation avec des prestataires fiables. Aujourd’hui, nous gérons plus de 100 services dans 16 différents pays européens.

Notre équipe est composée de plus de 90 collègues basés principalement à Oslo. L’équipe francophone est composée de 5 personnes qui travaillent pour nos marques en France, en Belgique et en Suisse.

📖 Pour en savoir plus sur nous, rendez-vous sur Nettbureau.com.

À propos du rôle

Nettbureau est présente en France depuis 2022, principalement dans le secteur des énergies renouvelables, et développe depuis peu des sites en Belgique et en Suisse. En tant que stagiaire en rédaction de contenu, tu contribueras directement au développement de nos services sur ces marchés.

Tes missions principales :

  • Rédiger et publier des contenus de qualité (articles, landing pages, formulaires) pensés pour répondre aux besoins de nos utilisateurs et générer des conversions.

  • Mener des recherches de mots-clés pour identifier de nouvelles opportunités de contenu et repérer ce que nos utilisateurs cherchent vraiment.

  • Optimiser la visibilité de nos contenus aujourd’hui et demain : le SEO reste essentiel, mais nos contenus doivent aussi être compris et cités par les IA génératives (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Gemini, Perplexity…).

  • Collaborer avec les équipes marketing, produit et commerciale pour ajuster la structure et les messages de nos contenus en fonction de ce qui engage et convertit réellement.

Ce que nous offrons :

  • Une expérience internationale dans une entreprise technologique en pleine croissance.

  • Un accompagnement par une équipe expérimentée qui te donnera rapidement de l’autonomie.

  • L’opportunité de développer tes compétences en rédaction de contenu web, SEO et GEO, recherche de mots clés, utilisation des IA génératives…

  • Une gratification de stage, à hauteur de 200 NOK/heure.

  • Un stage au centre d’Oslo, dans des bureaux modernes, et avec une cantine proposant de délicieux repas en partie pris en charge par l'entreprise.

  • Une ambiance de travail conviviale : kick off à l’étranger en janvier, tournois de ping-pong, afterworks réguliers…

  • Le choix entre un Mac ou un PC pour travailler.

Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Tu es en dernière année de master en communication, journalisme, marketing ou domaine connexe.

  • Le français est ta langue maternelle, et tu écris avec précision, clarté et une vraie sensibilité pour le lecteur. Tu sais expliquer simplement des sujets parfois techniques.

  • Tu es rigoureux, curieux et tu sais distinguer une source fiable d’une source douteuse.

  • Tu es à l’aise en anglais pour échanger avec le reste des collègues à Oslo.

Intéressé par le stage ?

N’hésite pas à postuler, nous avons hâte de découvrir ta candidature !

Merci de nous faire parvenir ton CV, une lettre de motivation et un exemple d’écrit dont tu es fier (article, mémoire, projet universitaire…).

  • Période de stage : janvier à juin 2027

  • Lieu : Oslo, Norvège

  • Type de contrat : stage conventionné

  • Volume horaire : 35 heures par semaine

  • Date limite de candidature : 20 septembre 2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nettbureau builds online platforms that help people and businesses. For over a decade, we’ve connected users with great deals and suppliers with new customers in over 10 countries through lead generation. Our goal is to give users great deals to compare so they can make informed choices, while helping our suppliers to attract new customers. With recognition by the Financial Times in their list of “Europe’s Long-term Growth Champions” for 2025 and 2026, we’re focusing on sustainability and constantly improving every aspect of our services for our users, businesses and our team. Every year, we connect millions of users with our partners through bespoke technology designed to benefit both parties. Almost everything we do is built in-house, and we invest heavily in technology. We're a technology company, after all.

title: Part-time Driver
description:
We’re looking for Part-Time Drivers to join Oda!

At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium.

title: CEO
description:
CEO, Seidr Technologies

Seidr builds software that turns months of manual site selection for energy-intensive industrial projects into hours of automated analysis. This is solving a significant bottleneck in a rapidly growing market. We have a signed, paying pilot customer and a growing pipeline across Power-to-X and data center developers in the Nordics and Germany. Read more about what we do on our company profile.


The role

We're looking for a CEO to lead Seidr forward and be the face of the company to investors, customers and partners. You'll own recruiting and team-building together with our venture studio REspire and our CTO Aman, and take on the full range of responsibilities that come with leading an early-stage startup.

Aman leads product and engineering, and we'll be growing the tech team further over time. Your main day-to-day focus will be commercial: direct, outbound sales to developers of energy-intensive projects, alongside shaping the business model and pricing as we move from pilot to scale.


What we're looking for

Above all, someone who wants to build a startup and understands what that actually takes: grit, resourcefulness, and the ability to move fast with limited resources. Previous startup experience is a strong signal of this, but not the only way to show it.

You should have solid experience in business development and B2B sales. Experience from data center development, or development of other power-intensive industry (Power-to-X, renewables, heavy industry), is a strong plus.


Location & setup

We'd prefer someone based in Norway who can work from our office in Asker, but we're open to strong candidates based elsewhere. We're also open to starting part-time and ramping up as the company grows.


A note on stage and risk

This is a pre-seed startup, not a conventional job. Until we close funding, which you'll be directly involved in raising, there is no fixed salary. We're open to pragmatic solutions along the way, such as a part-time period, but you should go into this with your eyes open and a genuine appetite for that kind of risk.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Seidr builds software that turns months of manual site selection and early-phase engineering work into hours of automated analysis, for developers of energy-intensive industrial projects: Power-to-X, data centers, and other power-hungry industries across Europe. Today, finding and qualifying a site for one of these projects takes 6-18 months and can cost millions, because the work is done manually, spreadsheet by spreadsheet, consultant by consultant, one candidate site at a time. Critical blockers, such as insufficient grid capacity or zoning conflicts, often surface only after months of work, when changing course is expensive. Seidr automates this. Our platform screens candidate sites in parallel against dozens of criteria, including grid capacity, current and future zoning, and environmental risk, and returns a ranked, decision-ready shortlist in hours instead of months. The underlying logic is built on real industrial project experience, not generic AI. We already have a signed, paying pilot customer and a growing pipeline of Power-to-X and data center developers across the Nordics and Germany. Backed by a venture studio, we are now looking for a CEO to take Seidr from pilot to scale, and to grow the platform from site selection into the full early-phase planning stack for energy-intensive projects.

title: Full-Stack Software Developer
description:
Full-Stack Software Developer

Oslo preferred | Remote possible for exceptional candidates | Full-time | Start as soon as possible

Perlo is building project intelligence for property developers.

Real estate development teams still run some of their most important processes across Excel, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, meetings and disconnected systems. Perlo brings that work into one place and helps project teams understand where they are, what requires attention and what they should do next.

We're a small, fast-moving team and are looking for a Full-Stack Software Developer who can take real ownership of the product.

This is not a role where you'll receive perfectly specified Jira tickets and implement them one by one.

You'll often get a problem, user need or desired outcome and be expected to understand it, propose a solution and ship it.

What you'll work on

You'll work across the Perlo product, including:

  • Building new product functionality from idea to production

  • Improving existing workflows and user experience

  • Working with project data, dashboards, reporting and AI-powered functionality

  • Designing database changes and backend logic

  • Building responsive interfaces in React / Next.js

  • Deploying and monitoring what you build

  • Fixing bugs and making pragmatic technical decisions

  • Using AI development tools extensively to move fast

Our current stack includes:

Next.js, React, TypeScript / JavaScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, TanStack, Tailwind CSS, Git, Git worktrees, Vercel and Claude Code.

You don't need to have worked professionally with every technology in the stack. We care much more about whether you can understand an existing codebase, solve problems and ship.

Who we're looking for

The most important thing is that you're autonomous.

You should be comfortable receiving direction like:

“Customers need a better way to understand what's changing across their projects.”

…and then working out what needs to happen technically to solve it.

You'll work closely with our CEO and the rest of the team, so you need to be able to translate non-technical product and business requirements into good technical solutions.

You are probably a good fit if you:

  • Can independently take a feature from problem → solution → production

  • Are comfortable making decisions when requirements aren't perfect

  • Ask good questions instead of waiting for detailed specifications

  • Are proactive and communicate clearly

  • Have solid JavaScript / TypeScript and web development fundamentals

  • Understand databases and relational data

  • Are comfortable working in an existing codebase

  • Use AI coding tools effectively rather than treating them as autocomplete

  • Care about shipping useful software, not engineering for engineering's sake

Experience with our exact stack is a bonus, not a requirement.

Location

We are based in Oslo, and we'd ideally like someone who can work with us in person at least some of the time.

That said, we are open to remote candidates if you're exceptionally strong, highly autonomous and a great fit for the way we work.

Why Perlo

We're still a small company, which means your work will have a very visible impact.

You'll get:

  • Significant ownership over a real production product

  • Direct access to customers and the problems we're solving

  • The ability to influence product and technical decisions

  • Very little bureaucracy

  • An AI-native development workflow

  • The opportunity to help shape the technical foundation of a growing B2B SaaS company

If you're the kind of developer who likes being given responsibility rather than tickets, we'd like to hear from you.

How to apply

Send us:

  1. A short introduction

  2. Your CV or LinkedIn

  3. Your GitHub, portfolio or something you've built, if you have one

  4. A few sentences about a product or feature you've built where you had significant ownership

We care much more about what you can do than writing a perfect application.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Perlo is building project intelligence for property developers. We help real estate development teams replace fragmented workflows across Excel, Outlook, Teams and SharePoint with one platform for project delivery, reporting and proactive decision-making. Perlo gives teams a clearer view of where projects stand, what requires attention, and what they should do next.

title: Prosjektleder
description:
Vil du lede spennende vedlikeholdsprosjekter som skaper varige verdier for innbyggere og ansatte?
 
Som prosjektleder får du ansvar for hele prosjektløpet, fra idé og planlegging til ferdigstilt bygg. Du blir en viktig pådriver som samler brukere, rådgivere, entreprenører og myndigheter rundt felles mål. Med ansvar for økonomi, kvalitet, framdrift og SHA får du en nøkkelrolle i å realisere framtidens bygg og eiendommer gjennom profesjonell prosjektledelse og godt samarbeid.
Arbeidsoppgaver

Som prosjektleder får du en sentral rolle i utviklingen og gjennomføringen av ulike typer prosjekter fra idé til ferdigstillelse. Du leder prosjektene på vegne av oppdragsgiver og har ansvar for å sikre god framdrift, kvalitet, økonomi og SHA gjennom hele prosjektforløpet.
Dine hovedoppgaver vil være å:

  • Lede og koordinere byggeprosjekter fra oppstart til overtakelse.
  • Etablere og lede prosjektorganisasjoner for planlegging og gjennomføring.
  • Sikre at prosjektene gjennomføres i tråd med byggherreforskriften og gjeldende myndighetskrav.
  • Samarbeide tett med brukere, oppdragsgivere, rådgivere, entreprenører og offentlige myndigheter.
  • Utarbeide konkurransegrunnlag, gjennomføre anskaffelser og inngå kontrakter.
  • Følge opp prosjektøkonomi, framdrift, kvalitet og SHA.
  • Lede og koordinere byggeledere og øvrige ressurser i prosjektene.
  • Håndtere avvik, endringer og kontraktsmessige forhold underveis i prosjektet.
  • Rapportere status og resultater til oppdragsgiver og ledelse.
  • Sikre en god overlevering og avslutning av prosjektene.
Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ser etter deg som har relevant kompetanse innen byggfag og erfaring med å lede prosjekter fra planlegging til ferdigstillelse.
Du har:

  • Relevant utdanning innen byggfag, eksempelvis byggingeniørutdanning, teknisk fagskole, mesterbrev eller fagbrev.
  • Dokumentert erfaring med prosjektledelse.
  • Erfaring med økonomistyring og god forståelse for kontraktsoppfølging etter Norsk Standard (NS).
  • Erfaring med anskaffelses- og anbudsprosesser, gjerne fra offentlig sektor.
  • Evne til å arbeide strukturert, planlegge godt og følge opp oppgaver på en systematisk måte.
  • Førerkort klasse B.

Lang og relevant erfaring kan kompensere for manglende formell utdanning.

Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som trives med å samarbeide og skape gode relasjoner. Du er positiv, imøtekommende og kommuniserer godt med ulike interessenter, også når situasjoner er krevende.

Du:

  • Har gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsevner og evner å skape tillit og gode relasjoner.
  • Arbeider strukturert og systematisk, samtidig som du håndterer endringer og uforutsette hendelser på en god måte.
  • Trives med å ha mange oppgaver og prosesser i gang samtidig, uten å miste oversikten.
  • Er fleksibel og tilpasningsdyktig, og tar gjerne på deg nye oppgaver og utfordringer.
  • Bidrar aktivt til et godt arbeidsmiljø og et positivt faglig og sosialt fellesskap.

 

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

Vi tilbyr

Hos oss får du muligheten til å lede varierte og samfunnsviktige byggeprosjekter i en av regionens mest spennende eiendomsporteføljer. Du blir en del av et kompetent fagmiljø der vi deler kunnskap, utfordrer hverandre og jobber sammen for å skape gode resultater.

Vi tilbyr:

  • Allsidige og utfordrende prosjekter med stor betydning for innbyggere og ansatte i Stavanger kommune.
  • En sentral rolle i et sterkt fagmiljø med dyktige kolleger og stor grad av selvstendighet.
  • Ansvarsfulle og meningsfulle arbeidsoppgaver med gode muligheter for faglig utvikling.
  • Et positivt arbeidsmiljø preget av samarbeid, engasjement og høy kompetanse.
  • Fleksibel arbeidstid og gode muligheter for å tilrettelegge arbeidshverdagen.
  • Konkurransedyktige lønnsbetingelser basert på kvalifikasjoner og erfaring.
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger gjennom KLP.
  • Støtte og utviklingsmuligheter som legger til rette for at du skal lykkes og utvikle deg videre i karrieren.

 

Sammen bygger vi framtidens kommunale eiendommer for Stavanger.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Stavanger kommune er, med sine 11 000 ansatte, en av regionens største arbeidsgivere.

Vi mener inkludering og mangfold er en styrke. Vi er opptatt av at arbeidsstyrken i størst mulig grad skal gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte til å søke, uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. 

Vi jobber for heltidskultur med mål  om å ansette i hele stillinger.

Som ansatt i Stavanger kommune får du utgjøre en forskjell for kommunen og innbyggerne og blir en del av en spennende storbyregion. 

Vi bygger fellesskap ved å være nære, åpne og nyskapende

Stavanger kommune praktiserer prinsippet om meroffentlighet. Offentlig søkerliste vil normalt inneholde navn på samtlige søkere. Det må foreligge tungtveiende grunner for å få innvilget unntak, jamfør Offentleglova §25.

Politiattest:
Gyldig politiattest må fremlegges før tiltredelse for stillinger der det er påkrevd iht. lovverk.

Vedlegg:
Attester, vitnemål og vedlegg må legges ved søknaden. Vi oppfordrer til å bruke Vitnemålsportalen. Utdanning utført utenfor Norge må være godkjent av Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse (eller NOKUT), og godkjenningen må dokumenteres.

title: Full-Stack Machine Learning  Engineer
description:
Location: Oslo (NO) / Hybrid
Department: Development
Reports to: Development Manager

Why Join Us?

Welcome to Aptic, where innovative technology meets sustainable software development.

We develop advanced fintech solutions used by banks, finance companies, and e-commerce businesses across Europe. We are now looking for a Full-Stack Machine Learning Engineer to take ownership of one of our machine learning solutions and help shape the next generation of AI-powered capabilities within Aptic. You will be part of a small team giving you large impact on solution design and work processes.

Initially, you will revive, enhance, and transition to live production an ML platform, working across machine learning, LLMs, backend development, integrations, and frontend technology. Over time, you will also contribute to broader AI initiatives and product development within Aptic. This gives you the opportunity to build deep expertise in one solution while maintaining flexibility to grow into new technical challenges and products.

What you'll do

As a Full-Stack ML Engineer, you will transition to live production and take end-to-end ownership of an ML solution and ensure it continues to evolve, perform, and create value.

  • Improve existing machine learning models with measurable gains in accuracy, performance, and cost efficiency.

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy new features across backend, AI/ML, and frontend layers.

  • Design and implement APIs and integrations with internal and external systems.

  • Collaborate with internal experts to rebuild knowledge, processes, and infrastructure.

  • Write automated tests and verification scripts for the solution.

  • Create, run, maintain on the build and deploy pipelines

  • Produce high-quality technical documentation and knowledge-sharing material

  • Support AI initiatives across the company when needed.

  • Contribute to Aptic products and development teams as business needs to evolve.


What you'll bring

  • Experience in designing, developing, and optimizing predictive models using machine learning and deep learning techniques.

  • Experience in training, evaluating, deploying, and monitoring neural network models in production environments.

  • Solid understanding of software architecture and engineering best practices.

  • Understanding of integration patterns and data pipelines.

  • Experience with SQL Server or similar relational databases.

  • Experience with development in Python, C# and frontend Javascript based frameworks like React.

  • Fluent in English, written and spoken.

  • Working knowledge of Norwegian is an advantage

  • Knowledge about financial papers valuation an advantage

What’s In It For You?

  • Competitive salary based on experience and background.

  • 25 paid vacation days per year.

  • Hybrid working model and great office locations.

  • Wellness budget and pension program.

  • A culture built on innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • Plenty of opportunities to influence direction and drive meaningful change.

  • A stable workplace that values work/life balance.

Ready to Apply?

Sounds like you? Apply in minutes—no cover letter required. We can’t wait to meet you!

About us

Aptic AB is a fast growing fintech company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. We deliver advanced solutions across BNPL, ledger services, factoring, lending, leasing, and debt collection. Our CLVR platform is trusted by major players such as Profina, Kredinor, and Lowell.

Our culture is rooted in technical excellence, innovation, and deep customer focus.

title: PhD Research Fellow in fairness in artificial intelligence
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in fairness in artificial intelligence, available at the Department of Informatics, in the Scientific Computing and Machine Learning (SCML) research group.

Starting date as soon as possible/by agreement. The fellowship period is three (3) years.

Depending on the candidate and the teaching needs of the department, the fellowship period can be extended with a fourth year for compulsory work consisting of e.g., teaching and supervision duties and research assistance.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is the Department of Informatics at Blindern, Oslo. 


Project description

The PhD fellow will be affiliated with the Scientific Computing and Machine Learning (SCML) research group at the Department of Informatics and supervised by associate professor Anne-Marie George.

We are looking for a motivated and academically strong candidate to work on a project within fairness in artificial intelligence and machine learning. The candidate will investigate how to formally define, measure and reconcile different, at times conflicting, notions of fairness in AI systems, as well as the theoretical relationships between them.

Possible directions for the project include (the final scope will be developed together with the candidate, and it is not necessary to cover all topics):

  • Group fairness: developing and analysing algorithms and metrics for ensuring fair treatment of groups defined by protected attributes (e.g. gender, age, ethnicity, …).
  • Theoretical relations between fairness notions: studying the mathematical relationships, trade-offs, and impossibility results connecting different fairness definitions.
  • Intersectional fairness: exploring fairness guarantees for combinations of multiple protected attributes, and addressing the challenges of subgroup fairness, such as computational complexity, statistical reliability and data sparsity for fine-grained subgroups.

What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in informatics/computer science, mathematics, statistics, or a closely related field. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Documented competence in machine learning at Master level
  • Documented programming skills
  • Minimum three documented mathematics or statistics courses with passing grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English

Candidates without a master’s degree have until 30.11.2026 to complete the final exam.

Desired qualifications:

  • Programming experience, e.g. in Python, particularly for machine learning
  • Experience with machine learning theory, evaluation metrics, algorithmic fairness, statistics, or optimization is an advantage

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

title: Researcher in Fish Immunology / Microscopy
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Researcher position at the Department of Biosciences

The position is for a period of 3 years.

Starting date no later than 01.04.2027 with a preferred starting date around the 21st of January.

Place of work is the Department of Biosciences at the Life Science Building, Forskningsparken, Oslo.


Project description

Applicants are invited to apply for a 3-years position as Researcher in Fish Immunology / Microscopy to be based at the Department of Biosciences of the University of Oslo. This role contributes to the ERC-funded starting grant project “Fish-S.H.I.E.L.D.” starting on April 1st 2025, which aims to investigate the fish branchial cavity immune surveillance system and its importance for the fish defense against infectious diseases in aquaculture.


More about the position

The successful applicant will join Julien Resseguier’s “Spatial Immunology & Nanomedicines” group and become a key member of the Comparative Immunology team at the Department of Biosciences.

The project “Fish-S.H.I.E.L.D.” builds on the recent discovery of a complex lymphoid organization in the fish branchial cavity, which includes the “Amphibranchial Lymphoid Tissues (ALT)” and the “Interbranchial Lymphoid Tissues (ILT)” in the gills, and the Nemausean Lymphoid organ (NELO), revealing the branchial cavity as an important region of the fish immune system.

https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/sciadv.adj0101 https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/immunology/articles/10.3389/fimmu.2021.769901/full 

The sustainability of aquaculture, important for our food security, is severely challenged by infectious diseases. Whereas the branchial cavity is particularly relevant for fish health and welfare in aquaculture, much remains to be done to understand its defense mechanisms. The main goal of the project is to characterize the newly discovered branchial cavity immune surveillance system to harness its potential against infectious diseases in aquaculture. The project objective will use the zebrafish model to 1) Characterize the gill lymphoid tissues and tonsil-like organ. 2) Decipher the rules of antigen sampling, 3) Characterize the developmental framework. 4) Study the involvements in immune responses to infection and vaccines. This will then serve as a guide for investigations in Atlantic salmon and other fish species relevant for aquaculture.

The project will involve characterizations of immune functions using infection models and nanotechnologies, immunohistology, transcriptomics, antibody assays, and advanced 3D microscopy. For this, a lightsheet microscope dedicated to the imaging of cleared samples is being acquired, as well as a workstation for VR-assisted image analysis. This represents an unique opportunity in Norway.

We seek a highly motivated Researcher that will be primarily involved in the  transcriptomic aspects of the project and microscopy. Tasks will mainly focus on using ScRNAseq and 3D high-resolution imaging to investigate the branchial cavity immune system with an emphasis on characterizing immune cell population and the gene expression of markers of relevant immune functions. The project will involve experiment with both zebrafish and Atlantic salmon. 


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe's leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in Fish Immunology, Cell Biology, Molecular Biology, or a related discipline. Doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and completed defence are eligible for appointment.  
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.
  • Relevant experience working with zebrafish and fish immunology.
  • Documented solid expertise in transcriptomic analysis, specifically Single-cell RNA sequencing.
  • Proficiency in confocal microscopy, lightsheet microscopy, and image analysis.

Desired qualifications:

  • The following qualifications will also count in the assessment of the applicants: 
    • Fish Biology, Fish Anatomy, Molecular Biology, Bioinformatics, Histology methods, and Statistics.
  • Prior experience with Immunofluorescence, Cryosections, Whole-mount labeling, Sample clearing, Flow cytometry, Atlantic salmon.
  • A certification to perform animal experiments (e.g. Felasa), good communication/representation skills, and grant writing skills are also desirable but not required.
