title: Develop your radiology career in Sweden
description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Radiologists career opportunities across Sweden

Sweden currently has a strong need for specialist radiologists within both general diagnostic radiology and several subspecialties. Through Dignus Medical, a Scandinavian medical recruitment company with more than 20 years of experience, radiologists from across Europe can explore long-term career opportunities within the Swedish healthcare system.

We collaborate with hospitals and imaging departments across Sweden, ranging from regional hospitals to large university hospitals.

Our goal is to match your professional background, experience and preferences with the right workplace.

Radiologists in Sweden play a central role in clinical decision-making and work in close collaboration with physicians from many specialties. The work is primarily clinically focused and supported by modern imaging technology, digital reporting systems and well-structured workflows. Departments typically operate advanced diagnostic equipment including MRI, CT, ultrasound and conventional radiography, supported by modern PACS systems.

Professional Development

The current need in Sweden is primarily for radiologists who wish to focus on clinical diagnostic work. Radiologists often work broadly within diagnostic radiology while gradually developing subspecialist expertise depending on their interests and the needs of the department. Multidisciplinary collaboration with clinicians is an important part of everyday work.

For those interested, opportunities for teaching, research collaboration and academic involvement may also be available, particularly within larger hospitals. Some radiologists later choose to combine clinical work with teleradiology as part of their career development.

Relocation and Support

Relocating to another country is a significant step. Dignus Medical supports you throughout the entire process, from identifying suitable positions to becoming established in Sweden.

You will have an advisor guiding you through each step, including assistance with medical licensing, relocation planning and practical matters related to moving. Our services are completely free of charge for physicians.

Your advisor will remain your main point of contact throughout the entire process, from the initial discussions until you are fully established in your new role and life in Sweden.

Support for your family

Many physicians relocate with their families, and we provide guidance to help make the transition as smooth as possible. This may include information about schools, childcare and everyday life in Sweden, as well as guidance for partners seeking employment. If your partner works within healthcare, there may also be opportunities within our network.

Language training

To work independently as a physician in Sweden, Swedish language proficiency at C1 level is required. Dignus Medical provides intensive Swedish language training with professional instructors, online and adapted to your schedule.

Language training can also be offered to accompanying partners and older children up to B2 level to support their integration into Swedish society.

Living in Sweden

Sweden offers a high quality of life, safe communities and well-developed public services. Physicians often appreciate the balance between professional responsibility and personal life, with structured working hours and good opportunities for leisure activities.

Families benefit from high-quality childcare, subsidized preschool and free school meals for children. The country’s forests, lakes and coastline also provide excellent opportunities for outdoor activities throughout the year.

Requirements

We are seeking radiologists who hold EU-recognized specialist certification in radiology, have good communication skills in English and are motivated to learn Swedish.

Interested?

Radiologists working in general diagnostic radiology as well as those with subspecialist expertise are welcome to explore opportunities with us.

Send your CV and specialist certificate, and we will discuss suitable opportunities within our network of hospitals across Sweden. Dignus Medical will help match your profile with the right position and guide you throughout the entire process.

We look forward to receiving your application!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

This is a consulting assignment. The location is Stockholm, Sweden.

The assignment is full-time.

Remote work is accepted. However, the consultant should preferably be based in Sweden and near Stockholm due to potential travel and occasional office visits.

The assignment involves close collaboration with the client and an international team, requiring strong communication, flexibility, and collaboration skills.

The Assignment

The assignment focuses on developing, maintaining, and standardizing integrations using SAP Business Technology Platform Integration Suite (SAP BTP IS).

An important part of the assignment is migrating existing integrations from Microsoft BizTalk to SAP BTP IS. The consultant will work with cloud-based solutions and integrations between SAP and non-SAP systems.

Tasks

Develop and maintain integrations using SAP Business Technology Platform Integration Suite (SAP BTP IS).

Review and document integration patterns in SAP BTP IS to standardize them for future use.

Migrate integrations from Microsoft BizTalk to SAP BTP IS.

Analyze and resolve integration issues to ensure smooth operation of the integration suite.

Work with cloud-based solutions and integrations between SAP and non-SAP systems.

Work with monitoring tools, CI/CD pipelines, self-service tools, and automation.

Requirements (Mandatory)

You should have senior/specialist-level proficiency in SAP Integration Suite (SAP IS).

You should have experience with cloud-based solutions and integration of SAP and non-SAP systems.

You should have experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or similar.

You should have experience with Git and YAML CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps.

You should be familiar with self-service tools and automation.

You should be able to analyze and resolve integration issues to ensure smooth operation of the integration suite.

You should have strong communication and collaboration skills and be comfortable working in an international team.

You should have good proficiency in English. Swedish is optional and is not a requirement.

No specific field of study is required. Relevant previous work experience and expertise are considered most important.

Desirable Qualifications

Previous work experience in the energy sector is considered an advantage.

About Us

Centio's overall goal is to be a consulting company that provides smart and sustainable solutions that contribute positively to the development of society.

Our employees are offered terms and conditions tailored to the individual. This means that working hours, workload, workplace, and professional development are adapted as far as possible to the needs of each employee.

Our team consists of committed individuals who are passionate about societal development. We work in small groups where you can contribute your experience while also benefiting from the knowledge and experience of others.

We believe that well-being and a healthy work-life balance are important. Therefore, we have a zero-vision for stress and prioritize well-being and health.

Please feel free to read more about us at centio.se.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Project Manager – Digital Transformation & Cloud Migration
description:
Project Manager – Digital Transformation & Cloud Migration

Location: Sundsvall, Sweden

Working method: Partial Remote

Job type: Consultant

Reference: UH-2026-421

Scope: 50%

Start date: 12 October 2026

End date: 30 June 2027

About the Assignment

We are looking for an experienced IT Project Manager to lead a large-scale digital transformation and cloud migration initiative within a complex organization.

The assignment involves coordinating the transition of user mailboxes from an on-premises Microsoft Exchange environment to Exchange Online. A pilot implementation has already been completed successfully, and the technical migration process is validated and ready for broader implementation.

A key part of the assignment is ensuring that Microsoft Purview is appropriately configured to support information security, classification and governance. The project manager will work with internal stakeholders to establish and implement information classification labels and ensure that the classification model is understood and adopted across the organization.

The technical migration will be delivered by specialized infrastructure and identity teams. The Project Manager will act as the central coordination function, ensuring that business areas, users and technical teams are aligned and prepared for the migration.

The role requires excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, a structured approach and the ability to drive change across a complex organization with multiple stakeholders and varying levels of technical maturity.

Key Responsibilities

    Establish and continuously maintain the project plan, timeline, milestones and delivery structure.
    Coordinate migration priorities based on organizational readiness, size and business criticality.
    Manage and maintain the project backlog and coordinate upcoming deliveries with relevant teams.
    Identify, assess and manage project risks, particularly those involving integrations, sensitive operations and limited service windows.
    Provide regular status reporting to relevant stakeholders.
    Develop and maintain a communication plan, FAQ documentation and supporting materials.
    Plan and coordinate training and educational activities for different target groups.
    Support the establishment of information classification labels and ensure that the classification model is effectively communicated and adopted.
    Coordinate business readiness activities ahead of migration.
    Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical teams.
    Coordinate multiple workstreams and stakeholders throughout the migration.
    Ensure that the migration is executed according to an agreed and well-communicated plan.

Required Qualifications

    Very good Swedish, both spoken and written.
    Minimum 5 years of experience in IT/digitalization project management.
    Minimum 3 years of experience in change management and user training related to IT implementations.
    Experience working on similar assignments within the public sector.
    Experience working at the interface between business operations and technical IT organizations.
    Experience developing training and communication materials for non-technical users.
    Project management certification such as PPS, PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent.

Preferred Qualifications

    10+ years of experience in IT/digitalization project management.
    5+ years of experience in change management and user training related to IT implementations.
    Experience managing several business units or organizations with different levels of digital maturity.
    Ability to adapt project methods, communication and priorities to different stakeholder needs.
    PPS certification and practical experience working according to the PPS project model.
    Experience with Microsoft Purview and/or information classification.
    Experience with email migration from on-premises Exchange to Exchange Online in larger organizations.
    Experience with Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory environments is advantageous.
    Experience coordinating technical migration teams and business stakeholders.

Personal Profile

We are looking for a Project Manager who is:

    Structured and highly organized.
    Proactive and comfortable working independently.
    Strong in stakeholder management and communication.
    Comfortable translating technical concepts into clear business language.
    Experienced in managing change in complex organizations.
    Able to coordinate multiple teams, workstreams and priorities.
    Focused on delivering according to agreed timelines and milestones.

Key Skills

IT Project Management | Digital Transformation | Change Management | Cloud Migration | Exchange Online | Microsoft Purview | Information Classification | Stakeholder Management | User Training | Public Sector | Technical Coordination | Microsoft Entra ID

Scope: 50%

Location: Sundsvall, Sweden – partial remote

Start: 12 October 2026

End: 30 June 2027

Interested candidates are invited to submit an updated CV, availability, current location and expected rate.

title: Business Coordinator/Events Coordinator
description:
Join Compass Group and help deliver exceptional client experiences

Compass Group is seeking a highly organised and customer-focused Customer Engagement Coordinator to join a dynamic and fast-paced team supporting a world-class client environment.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives on building relationships, coordinating complex activities and delivering outstanding experiences for customers and stakeholders. You will play a central role in planning and managing executive-level customer engagements, events and facility usage, working with a wide range of internal teams and external partners to ensure every experience runs seamlessly from start to finish.

If you are passionate about customer service, enjoy managing multiple priorities, and take pride in delivering exceptional experiences, we'd love to hear from you.

What you'll be doing

As a Customer Engagement Coordinator, you will own engagements from initial request through to completion, ensuring a professional, high-quality and consistent experience throughout.

Key responsibilities include:

    Managing customer engagements and events from enquiry to close-out.
    Coordinating schedules, meetings and stakeholder communications.
    Working closely with technical, operational and customer-facing teams to deliver seamless experiences.
    Managing event logistics including catering, hospitality, transport, facilities and audiovisual requirements.
    Ensuring customer requirements and preferences are accurately captured and executed.
    Maintaining engagement records, reporting dashboards and operational documentation.
    Supporting executive-level visitors and customer groups throughout their engagement journey.
    Producing communications, updates and stakeholder materials.
    Monitoring engagement metrics and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.
    Managing engagement-related billing, invoices and administrative processes.
    Ensuring compliance with company standards, policies and procedures.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone who combines exceptional organisation skills with a passion for customer service.

You'll ideally have:

    Experience coordinating events, programmes, customer experiences or executive engagements.
    Outstanding organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
    Strong written and verbal communication skills.
    Experience working with senior stakeholders and professional client environments.
    High attention to detail and excellent follow-through.
    Confidence working independently while collaborating effectively across diverse teams.
    Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt in a fast-moving environment.
    Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Outlook, Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
    Experience working with reporting tools, CRM systems or operational platforms would be advantageous.

What will make you successful?

Successful candidates typically demonstrate:

    Exceptional customer focus.
    Strong relationship-building skills.
    Proactive planning and ownership.
    Sound judgement and decision making.
    Flexibility and adaptability.
    Professionalism, discretion and attention to detail.

The position is a fixed-term appointment from October 1, 2026, to June 30, 2027, with the possibility of permanent employment. The position may be filled before the application deadline.

About Compass Group

We are part of the Compass Group, which is a world-leading supplier in food, beverage, and support services. Worldwide, we have over 600,000 colleagues. In Sweden, we have approximately 450 businesses around the country, which means that there are fantastic development opportunities with us. We have benefits through collective agreements such as annual salary increases, insurances and occupational pensions.

Compass Group in Sweden has a turnover of approximately SEK 3 billion and is operated under brands such as Food & Co, Marketplace, Medirest, Amica, Chartwells, Levy Restaurants, UNISON, Eurest and more. Compass Group Sweden is part of the Compass Group PLC group and acquired Fazer Food Service on January 31, 2020. The group's global turnover amounts to £25 billion (2019). Our customers are companies, arenas, universities, schools, health care and more. We provide services such as food and drink, conference, reception, housekeeping, janitorial and more. If you want to read more about Compass Group, please visit our website.

Why should you choose us?

    We believe that diversity, different experiences, and skills make the best starry sky.
    We love service, and we want to deliver world-class service by always going the extra mile.
    We believe in sustainability - both in terms of our planet and our colleagues.
    We deliver high quality in everything we do!

title: Service & Commissioning Engineer
description:
Företagsbeskrivning:

AVL is one of the world’s leading mobility technology companies for development, simulation and testing in the automotive industry, and beyond. The company provides concepts, solutions and methodologies in fields like vehicle development and integration, e-mobility, automated and connected mobility (ADAS/AD), and software for a greener, safer, better world of mobility.

Arbetsbeskrivning:

Vill du arbeta nära den senaste tekniken, lösa komplexa utmaningar och vara den person som kunder litar på när avancerade testsystem ska fungera på topp? Då kan du vara den Service Engineer vi söker.

Hos AVL List Nordiska arbetar vi i framkant inom Instrumentation & Test Systems på den nordiska marknaden. Vi är ett team på 30 personer i Göteborg och Stockholm – och nu behöver vi en Service Engineer till vårt team i Göteborg.

Hos oss får du en roll där du kombinerar teknik, problemlösning och kundkontakt, samtidigt som du får stora möjligheter att utvecklas i en internationell miljö.

Som Service Engineer ansvarar du för att säkerställa att våra kunders emissionsmätsystem och instrument fungerar med högsta möjliga tillförlitlighet och prestanda. Du arbetar nära våra kunder och blir en viktig teknisk partner som bidrar med både service, support och specialistkunskap. Rollen innebär stor variation där du växlar mellan planerade serviceinsatser, felsökning, teknisk rådgivning och utvecklande kunduppdrag.

I det dagliga arbetet utför du service, underhåll, kalibrering och driftsättning av emissionsmätningsinstrument samt säkerställer att utrustningen uppfyller gällande kvalitets- och säkerhetskrav. Du stödjer även kunderna inom mätning och analys av avgasreningssystem och hjälper dem att optimera sina processer och tekniska lösningar. Genom att analysera problem, identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och föreslå lösningar bidrar du till att skapa långsiktigt värde för kunden.

Du arbetar både självständigt och tillsammans med kollegor i teambaserade uppdrag där samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och ett lösningsorienterat arbetssätt är avgörande för framgång. Dokumentation, rapportering och uppföljning är en naturlig del av rollen, liksom ett kontinuerligt arbete med att utveckla och förbättra våra arbetssätt, processer och tjänster.

Tjänsten innebär resor till kunder i Sverige och, i vissa fall, internationellt. Det ger dig möjlighet att arbeta i varierande miljöer, lära känna olika verksamheter och utvecklas inom avancerad mätteknik och ny teknologi.

Profilbeskrivning:

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har:


    Minst 2 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom service, underhåll, mätteknik, teknisk support eller liknande område.
    God teknisk förståelse och erfarenhet av felsökning och problemlösning.
    Erfarenhet av att arbeta med teknisk utrustning, instrument eller mätsystem.
    God datorvana och erfarenhet av att arbeta i olika IT- och affärssystem.
    Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
    B-körkort.

Meriterande:


    Erfarenhet av installation, driftsättning (commissioning), service och underhåll av mätutrustning, testsystem, precisionsutrustning eller liknande tekniska produkter.
    Erfarenhet av lagkrav, regelverk och certifieringsprocesser kopplade till avgasreningssystem (Exhaust Aftertreatment Systems).
    Erfarenhet av fältservice och arbete i kundnära tekniska miljöer.
    Kunskap om och erfarenhet av emissionsmätningssystem och relaterad utrustning.
    Erfarenhet av arbete inom fordonsindustrin, motorutveckling eller närliggande tekniska områden.
    Erfarenhet av att arbeta i internationella projekt eller kundmiljöer.

Som person:

Du är en serviceinriktad och engagerad person som trivs i en roll med stort eget ansvar och många kontaktytor. Du arbetar strukturerat och självständigt, samtidigt som du är flexibel och har lätt för att anpassa dig till förändrade förutsättningar och prioriteringar. Med ett lösningsorienterat och analytiskt förhållningssätt tar du dig an tekniska utmaningar på ett metodiskt sätt och drivs av att hitta effektiva lösningar för både kunder och verksamhet. Samtidigt är du en prestigelös lagspelare som uppskattar samarbete, kunskapsutbyte och att bidra till teamets gemensamma framgång.

Vi erbjuder:

På AVL blir du en del av ett globalt teknikföretag som ligger i framkant av utveckling, simulering och testning inom mobilitetens framtid. Som världens största oberoende aktör inom området, med över 12 000 medarbetare internationellt, driver vi innovation för en grönare, säkrare och bättre värld av mobilitet.

Vårt fokus sträcker sig över hela värdekedjan – från tidiga idé- och konceptfaser till industrialisering och serieproduktion. Vi arbetar med avancerad teknik inom elektrifiering, mjukvara, autonom körning, digitalisering och energieffektiva drivlinor, och hjälper våra kunder att forma framtidens mobilitetslösningar.

Hos oss får du en arbetsplats där du kan växa, påverka och vara med och driva teknikutvecklingen framåt – som gör verklig skillnad för framtidens mobilitet!

Intresserad?

I denna rekryteringsprocess tillämpar vi löpande urval. Det innebär att rekryteringsprocessen kan gå snabbt och att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Vi ser fram emot att ta emot din ansökan!

title: Global Trade Compliance Lead | Volvo Cars
description:
Company description:

Who are we?Volvo Cars is a company on a mission; to bring traditional car manufacturing into a connected, sustainable and smart future.Join us and be part of Volvo Cars’ journey into the future.

Job description:   Let's introduce ourselves  

The Trade Compliance, Anti-Corruption & Human Rights team is part of Compliance & Ethics within Group Legal and Corporate Affairs. The team defines Volvo Cars’ corporate compliance requirements within key risk areas, including Trade Sanctions and Export Controls, as part of the broader Compliance & Ethics framework.



We operate in a fast-changing regulatory environment and translate complex trade compliance requirements into clear, practical and risk-based guidance for the business.







About the role



This is a global corporate risk lead role within Compliance & Ethics, responsible for defining and maintaining Volvo Cars’ corporate Trade Compliance requirements, with a primary focus on trade sanctions and export controls. The role is based at Volvo Cars headquarters in Gothenburg.



In this role, you will act as a subject matter expert for Trade Compliance. You will set the substantive direction for the risk area, promote consistent application of corporate requirements across regions and functions, and support the business in navigating complex regulatory requirements and important business decisions.



You will play a central role in shaping how Volvo Cars identifies, governs and manages Trade Compliance risks globally, ensuring that regulatory developments, enforcement trends and business priorities are translated into practical requirements, risk-area methodology, guidance, controls, training and management reporting.





     What you'll do  

You will work closely with business and functional stakeholders, regional Compliance & Ethics colleagues and other colleagues working with Trade Compliance globally to drive alignment and ensure that requirements are understood, embedded and applied consistently across regions. The role also requires close coordination with adjacent compliance areas such as anti-corruption, human rights, competition law and broader third-party risk management where risk topics overlap.



Your responsibilities will include:




    Act as the Global Corporate Risk Lead for Trade Compliance and a key Compliance & Ethics contact for trade sanctions and export controls, in close collaboration with other Trade Compliance colleagues globally.
    Define, maintain and continuously improve Volvo Cars’ corporate Trade Compliance framework, requirements, methodology, guidance and tools.
    Monitor regulatory developments, enforcement trends and industry practice, and translate them into practical business requirements and guidance.
    Set risk-area priorities and substantive direction, and provide input to Compliance & Ethics planning, reporting and continuous improvement.
    Provide expert advice and specialist compliance input to business functions and leadership.
    Lead or support risk assessments, controls, mitigation plans, incidents, investigations and complex compliance matters with Trade Compliance expertise.
    Lead coordination and alignment across global Trade Compliance colleagues, regional Compliance & Ethics teams and relevant business functions.
    Provide subject-matter input to authority interactions, industry forums, regulatory consultations and external engagements in coordination with relevant stakeholders.

    



   Profile description: What you'll bring  

Required qualifications




    University degree in Law, Business, International Trade, Engineering, or a related field.
    At least 10 years of relevant experience in trade compliance, export controls and sanctions, preferably in a global corporate, legal, regulatory or advisory environment.
    Strong working knowledge of EU and U.S. export control and sanctions laws and regulations.
    Demonstrated experience handling complex, cross-border trade compliance matters involving multiple jurisdictions.
    Proven ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical, business-oriented guidance.
    Experience defining or applying compliance requirements, risk methodology, governance, and controls in a corporate environment.
    Full professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.



Preferred qualifications




    Experience in a multinational organization with complex products, technologies, supply chains and market-access considerations.
    Experience using digital tools, analytics or AI-enabled solutions to support compliance risk management or process improvement.
    Professional certification, such as Swedish Certified Export Control Manager or equivalent.



Who you are




    You demonstrate strong integrity, independence and sound professional judgment, combined with a pragmatic and solution-oriented approach to compliance.
    You bring an analytical, risk-based mindset and are comfortable navigating complex and evolving regulatory environments.
    You are a strong communicator and trusted partner, able to influence senior stakeholders and build trust across business, regional and functional teams.
    You are comfortable taking ownership, setting direction and managing competing priorities in a global, fast-paced environment.

  



We offer:

Why join us?



This role offers high visibility and the opportunity to shape Volvo Cars´global Trade Compliance agenda, influencing how export controls and trade sanctions are integrated into our products, technologies, supply chains and global operations.



You will join a collaborative, international environment where compliance is seen as an enabler of responsible, sustainable and resilient business.

title: AI Platform Engineer
employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
description:
Job ID: 3525

We are looking for an AI Platform Engineer to drive the development and adoption of AI-powered solutions that strengthen our ability to detect and investigate financial crime. The role is permanent and can be based in Helsinki, Tallinn, Poland or Stockholm.

About our team

Meet the Data and Platform Team. Our role is to improve how we detect and investigate financial crime with the help of AI and machine learning to keep our customers, Nordea and society safe. Our team is about 25 people working out of Stockholm, Helsinki and Copenhagen as a part of the Group Financial Crime Prevention (GFCP) unit that provides financial crime prevention services to all of the bank.

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

Main responsibilities in this role:

    Design and implement proof-of-concept solutions for the AI Platform spanning predictive, generative and agentic workflows.
    Secure that applications are compliant in accordance with rules and regulations.
    Define production readiness and operational governance.
    Lead technical working groups and cross-team synchronization.
    Translate strategic direction into tactical technical guidance for the teams.
    Application risk management – manage risks and QRAs.
    Application access management – access rules and requirements.
    Application cost management – ensure cost efficient applications.
    Application incident management – secure proper communication and reporting.

Who you are

This is the right role for you if you are:

    Ambitious and enjoy bringing ideas, exploring their potential, and presenting the results. You're passionate about ensuring production excellence in machine learning operations, ensuring both the bank’s and society's safety.
    Collaborative and thrive in cross-functional environments, comfortable working at the intersection of business and technology. You communicate clearly and confidently with both technical and non-technical audiences, and you’re comfortable driving work forward independently.

Your background and skills include:

    BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a relevant technical field or equivalent practical experience.
    5+ years of experience as a Cloud native expert in designing and building production grade applications and services on AWS and other cloud providers (Azure or GCP).

title: Global Distribution Coordinator
description:
Company Description

Statistics show that women and underrepresented groups tend to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Sobi encourages you to change that statistic and apply. Rarely do candidates meet 100% of the qualifications. We look forward to your application!

At Sobi, the work we do every day redefines the standards of care and transform the lives of people living with rare diseases.

As a diverse team of entrepreneurial people, we are passionate about our growth journey towards becoming a global leader, making a difference for rare disease patients, moving quickly and always challenging the status quo.

We are committed to an inclusive, sustainable and flexible workplace that fosters growth and development.

Job Description

In the role as Global Distribution Coordinator, you will work closely with Sobi affiliates, logistics service providers, and internal stakeholders to deliver seamless service and operational excellence.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys problem-solving, and is passionate about delivering outstanding results in a highly regulated, patient-focused industry.

This position will be based in Stockholm, reporting directly to the Global Distribution Manager.



Key Responsibilities

    Customer Order administration incl. inter alia order taking, batch reservation, pick and pack ordering, shipment booking and monitoring, invoicing, crediting, returns and customer qualification.
    Month-end financial reporting in terms of Stock and Sales reconciliation of Sobi Consignment stock points and provide support to Sobi affiliates to complete the process with their stock points.
    Master Data management including pricing in operational ERP systems.
    Distribution network development and management including geographical expansions and new product/partner introductions. Mainly Finished Goods, but Drug Substance and Drug Product when applicable.
    Management of Sobi Logistic Service Providers (LSPs), through Business Review Meetings (BRMs) and performance monitoring (if applicable).
    Responsible for all interface transactions between Sobi HQ and Sobi affiliates LSP in IFS.
    Serial Number management in accordance with EU FMD; including Serial Number Alerts management, leading roles in Serialization Core Team activities and projects (incl. new product and/ or partner introduction)
    Process Continues Improvement

Qualifications

About you

You are a structured and analytical professional who enjoys working both independently and collaboratively. You take ownership of your work, show initiative when challenges arise, and have a strong sense of accountability. Your attention to detail, communication skills, and customer-centric mindset make you a trusted partner across functions and regions.



    You are a team player, structured, thorough, and professional and have a genuine customer service mindset.
    You appreciate and value working towards several different contact interfaces internal as well as external.
    You are independent and do not hesitate to take initiative when processes are not working efficiently.
    You have good cooperation and communication skills, ability to prioritize and have a burning interest in solving problems and delivering results.
    You have strong time management skills; able to plan short/ repetitive, mid-, and long-term due dates.
    You have a technology-driven mindset and are curious about how automation, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions can improve ways of working.
    You are system-oriented, comfortable working with operational platforms, and motivated by finding smarter, more efficient solutions to recurring tasks and process challenges.



Here at Sobi we live by our core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership!

Additional Information

How to apply

We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume in English.

Why Join Us?

We are differentiating ourselves through the passion of our people, the innovative products we bring to life, and the responsible business we operate.

To ensure that more patients benefit from our therapies now and in the future, and to align with the company’s ambitions for growth, we have five core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership.  

Our mission and purpose get us excited to come to work every day, but there are a few more reasons to join our team:

    Opportunities for professional growth
    Competitive compensation for your work
    Diversity and Inclusion
    A flexible workplace that supports work-life balance



About Sobi

Sobi is a global biopharma company unlocking the potential of breakthrough innovations, transforming everyday life for people living with rare diseases.

We are dedicated to capturing the scientific opportunities of our time. With our early roots in Sweden, we started as pioneers in Haemophilia. Today we are an innovate leader within rare diseases with a global reach.



    We are bringing brilliant ideas to life in rare disease areas with high unmet patient needs.
    We are experts on identifying breakthrough innovations, unlocking new therapies and levelling up global access to new treatments.
    Our global operational network and passionate team serve as the foundation for our success.

Sobi has approximately 2,000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, Asia and Australia. In 2025, revenue amounted to SEK 28 billion. Sobi’s share (STO:SOBI) is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn.

title: QA and Test Lead
description:

The partner is delivering a complex platform change across several systems and suppliers. You will lead test planning, coordinate evidence and make sure critical user journeys are verified from component level through business acceptance.

The team works across disciplines and expects quality to be shaped throughout discovery and delivery. You will have space to challenge assumptions, make evidence visible and improve how decisions are made.

How you will work

You will join multidisciplinary delivery rather than operate as a final approval step. The partner expects early questions, rapid feedback and clear evidence about what users and systems need. You will help teams decide what to test, measure or prototype before committing to an expensive direction.

As a senior colleague, you will own substantial outcomes and help others make stronger decisions. You are expected to recognise risk early, communicate it without drama and move work forward with practical alternatives. The role still includes hands on delivery; seniority here means broader judgement, not distance from the work.

What you will do

    

Define the overall test strategy and risk based scope.

    

Connect requirements and use cases with verifiable test coverage.

    

Coordinate environments, data, teams and external dependencies.

    

Lead defect triage and readiness reporting.

    

Guide automation priorities and non functional testing.

    

Communicate quality risk clearly to project and business leadership.

Extensive test leadership in complex technology programmes.

    

Strong requirements, integration and acceptance testing experience.

    

Ability to plan across several teams and release stages.

    

Evidence based reporting and defect management.

    

Understanding of test automation and modern delivery methods.

    

Professional English; Swedish may be required for public partners.

Experience in healthcare, government or another regulated domain.

This role gives you a central position in a consequential change programme. You will shape how quality is demonstrated and help the organisation make release decisions based on evidence rather than optimism.

description:

We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and highly collaborative Creative Director to lead the creative vision and execution of campaigns, content, and brand experiences for clients across the outdoor, lifestyle, wellness, fitness, sport, travel, and active industries.

This agency-based role will work across multiple client accounts, translating business objectives, audience insights, and brand positioning into compelling creative strategies and culturally relevant content. The Creative Director will lead projects from initial concept through production, delivery, and rollout, ensuring that every asset is strategically grounded, visually distinctive, operationally sound, and aligned with each client’s brand standards.

The ideal candidate is both a visionary creative leader and a strong operator—someone who can inspire teams, present and defend ideas, build trusted client relationships, and confidently manage the details required to deliver high-quality work across multiple channels and timelines.

Lead the conceptual, strategic, and visual direction of seasonal campaigns, evergreen content programs, product launches, brand initiatives, and ongoing client communications.

Establish and maintain a distinctive, consistent, and relevant visual identity for each client.

Influence the look, feel, tone, and overall creative expression of brand assets across regional, national, and global markets.

Translate strategic insights, marketing objectives, audience needs, and business goals into clear creative strategies and engaging content platforms.

Develop creative approaches that inspire, move, and connect with end users while authentically expressing each brand’s purpose, values, and point of view.

Set creative standards and provide direction across photography, video, graphic design, digital artwork, motion design, typography, copy integration, and branded experiences.

Stay current on emerging trends in culture, design, digital marketing, social media, technology, production, and the outdoor, lifestyle, and active industries.

Identify opportunities to evolve and strengthen client brands while maintaining consistency with established brand guidelines.

Generate original ideas in response to creative briefs, strategic assignments, campaign objectives, and client needs.

Lead the development of creative concepts, campaign platforms, content series, product stories, and integrated brand experiences.

Create and oversee concept boards, mood boards, visual references, style guides, treatments, sketches, mockups, storyboards, and presentation materials.

Clearly communicate creative concepts, strategic rationale, intended audience impact, and production approach to clients and internal stakeholders.

Present, sell, and defend creative ideas with confidence, clarity, and sound strategic reasoning.

Ensure creative ideas are scalable and adaptable across formats, markets, platforms, and stages of the customer journey.

Lead creative projects from concept development through pre-production, production, post-production, final delivery, and rollout.

Review and approve work at all stages to ensure quality, consistency, accuracy, and alignment with the approved creative direction.

Experience leading both in-house and external creative, production, and freelance teams.

Lead and manage in-house, freelance, outsourced, and partner creative teams across multiple client accounts.

Direct photographers, videographers, production teams, stylists, designers, developers, editors, agencies, and other external specialists.

Build and facilitate a highly motivated, collaborative, inclusive, and accountable creative environment.

Establish clear expectations, responsibilities, workflows, feedback processes, and quality standards for project teams.

Mentor and develop creative talent, supporting professional growth and encouraging new perspectives.

Assemble the right creative and production resources for each project based on scope, budget, timeline, and required expertise.

Manage contract and freelance production staff, including sourcing, briefing, scheduling, negotiating, onboarding, and evaluating external partners.

Foster strong relationships across creative, strategy, account management, production, marketing, digital, sales, merchandising, retail, and leadership teams.

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure creative work is strategically aligned and operationally effective.

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Akutspital 80-100% für die Region Wetzikon gesucht
description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Wetzikon suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Akutspital.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Wetzikon: das Wichtigste in Kürze

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Akutspital

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Wetzikon

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Wetzikon liegt im Zürcher Oberland und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung via Bahn und Autobahn. Die dynamische Stadt bietet Ihnen ein breites Spektrum an Arbeitsplätzen in Industrie, Handel und Dienstleistungen. Die attraktive Lage zwischen Zürich und dem Appenzellland, kombiniert mit guter Infrastruktur und hoher Lebensqualität, macht Wetzikon zu einem wertvollen Arbeitsort für Pendler und Ortsansässige.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Akutspital

Sie arbeiten im Akutbereich eines Spitals: Patientinnen und Patienten kommen, genesen und gehen – der Rhythmus ist dynamisch. Dabei erleben Sie die ganze Bandbreite der Medizin, arbeiten interdisziplinär und entwickeln Ihre Fachkompetenz laufend weiter.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen in der Region Wetzikon zeigt eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage, insbesondere in Akutspitälern mit flexiblen Pensenmodellen zwischen 80 und 100 Prozent. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen, attraktiven Löhnen und modernen Arbeitsbedingungen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit persönlicher Beratung, gezielter Jobvermittlung und kontinuierlicher Betreuung, um Ihnen den Einstieg in eine passende Stelle unkompliziert zu gestalten.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Wetzikon

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Übrigens: Laufend weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie rund um die Uhr auf med-ipersonal.ch.

title: Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment
description:
Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen, Switzerland is part of the Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine (J\&J IM) Supply Chain organization and is currently recruiting for a  
Senior Project Manager Construction Pharma  
The Senior Project Manager serves as a senior technical leader on capital projects, ensuring alignment to J\&J standards and regulatory requirements. This role leads large capital projects, partnering with Quality, EHS, Operations, and external A\&E/CM firms.  
Key Responsibilities  
Strategic Project Leadership \& Delivery  
Lead large capital projects across all project phases (planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning).  
Coordinate multi\-functional engineering strategies to meet schedule, budget, quality, and regulatory requirements.  
Technical Authority \& Governance  
Act as the senior technical authority, review and approve engineering design changes, and technical submittals.  
Ensure engineering solutions align with J\&J standards, industry codes, and regulatory expectations.  
Budget \& Cost Management  
Lead multi‑million‑dollar capital budgets for assigned projects, monitor costs, and support procurement and contractor selection and evaluation.  
Participate in contractor bid reviews and support value\-engineering decisions.  
Scheduling, Risk \& Performance Management  
Lead schedule development and integration with program timelines; identify critical path items and drive mitigation.  
Maintain a proactive risk register, recommend mitigations, and track performance metrics.  
Construction Management \& Field Leadership  
Provide senior owner\-side engineering oversight during construction and commissioning; ensure contractor performance aligns with design intent and J\&J EHS standards.  
Promote a strong safety culture and ensure EHS compliance on site.  
Documentation \& Reporting  
Maintain detailed engineering records, design documentation, and as\-built information.  
Prepare and present executive\-level status updates, technical summaries, and risk briefings.  
Education \& Experience  
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management required; Master’s degree preferred.  
10\+ years of experience leading capital projects, preferably in regulated industries (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or similar).  
Demonstrated owner\-side engineering leadership and experience working with A\&E and Construction Management firms.  
Experience leading multi\-discipline teams and collaborating with quality, EHS, operations, and external consultants.  
Skills \& Competencies  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving skills.  
Excellent communication and leadership skills for multi\-functional and executive interactions.  
Proven track record to lead budgets, schedules, and complex contractor relationships.  
Familiarity with regulatory expectations for facilities in regulated industries.  
Proficiency with project management and engineering documentation tools.  
Additional Requirements  
Location of Role: Primary Location: Schaffhausen, Switzerland  
Language Requirements: Proficiency: English \& German

Cilag AG in Schaffhausen belongs to the group of Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine and manufactures high quality pharmaceutical products, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and medical devices. Today Cilag AG is one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in Switzerland supplying all the major global markets. The Schaffhausen facility is a strategic launch and growth site for parenteral products, and we have an impressive pipeline of new and innovative products.  
The Senior Supervisor, Complaint Quality Approver Team is accountable for leading a team of Complaint Quality Approvers responsible for independent, objective review and approval of complaint records. The role provides people leadership, operational oversight, and quality decision support to ensure complaint investigations are complete, scientifically justified, risk\-based, and compliant with applicable procedures and regulations. The Senior Supervisor ensures consistent approval practices, timely record progression, appropriate escalation of quality risks, and continuous capability development across the team.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
The Senior Supervisor leads the Complaint Quality Approver team and is responsible for assigning, prioritizing, and monitoring work to ensure compliant and timely approval of complaint records. The role provides guidance to approvers on investigation strategy, risk assessment, escalation, evidence requirements, Root Cause Analysis, NC considerations, and alignment of investigation conclusions across products or affiliates when applicable. The Senior Supervisor ensures that approval decisions are made consistently and are supported by objective evidence, applicable procedures, and current regulatory expectations. In addition, the role reviews complex or high\-risk complaint records, supports escalation to Quality leadership, and drives alignment with cross\-functional partners when investigation direction, closure readiness, or quality risk requires leadership input.  
The Senior Supervisor is accountable for developing team capability through coaching, feedback, training, and performance management. The role establishes clear expectations for documentation quality, approval rationale, system usage, and stakeholder communication, and ensures the team applies best practices consistently. The Senior Supervisor monitors workload, cycle time, quality metrics, backlog, and recurring investigation trends to identify improvement opportunities, remove barriers, and support sustainable business continuity. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, inspection readiness, audit support, and the implementation of global or site quality system changes impacting complaint record approval.  
KEY INTERFACES  
Complaint Quality Approvers to provide leadership, coaching, work prioritization, and performance feedback.  
Complaint investigation owners and cross\-functional contributors, including Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging, MSAT, Regulatory, and Medical Safety as applicable.  
Quality leadership for escalation, risk communication, resource planning, operational performance, and decision alignment.  
Other sites and affiliates to align investigation strategy, closure expectations, evidence requirements, and consistent complaint outcomes for site\-manufactured products.  
Audit, inspection readiness, quality systems, and process improvement stakeholders to support compliant execution and continuous improvement.  
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS  
Strong knowledge of quality investigations, complaint handling, CAPA and nonconformance concepts in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical product environment.  
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team in a quality organization, including setting priorities and managing performance.  
Strong understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity expectations, and applicable U.S. and international regulatory requirements.  
Proven ability to assess complex technical data, investigation conclusions, risk assessments, and escalation needs.  
Ability to make sound quality decisions, communicate clear rationale, and ensure consistency in approval standards.  
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and global environment.  
Ability to drive sustainable process improvements.  
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback and represent the team in leadership discussions.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and decision\-making skills to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations.  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS  
Master’s degree or PhD in Life Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.  
Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in quality investigations, complaint handling, quality systems, or a related regulated quality environment is required.  
Prior people leadership, team lead, supervisory, or demonstrated coaching experience is strongly preferred.  
Experience performing, reviewing, approving, or providing oversight for complex quality investigations, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, or similar quality events.  
Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders and quality leadership to manage risk, escalation, and decision alignment.  
Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement, inspection readiness, and consistent execution of quality system requirements.  
Proven critical thinking, problem\-solving, communication, and people leadership skills.

title: Power System Physicist/Engineer for the CMS HGCAL
description:
What you'll do
As Power System Physicist/Engineer for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL), you will play a key role in the development, integration, testing and commissioning of the power systems for one of the most innovative particle detectors ever conceived.

Working within a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will contribute to the procurement and testing of power supplies for HGCAL detector modules, including low-voltage, high-current supplies for the readout electronics and medium-voltage supplies of up to 800 V for sensor biasing.

You will also contribute to the integration of power systems with the detector's safety, control and monitoring systems, as well as the testing and implementation of power components such as DC-DC converters, voltage regulation and cabling.

A key aspect of the role will be to assess the impact of the power system on HGCAL performance and to develop and implement strategies to minimise noise effects such as interference, coupling and ripple.

This role offers the opportunity to combine strong electrical engineering and detector-physics skills with hands-on involvement in the construction, testing and commissioning of a large-scale, state-of-the-art particle detector.

Your responsibilities
Follow the procurement of the power supplies (Low Voltage and Bias Voltage, totalling several MCHF), including carrying out acceptance and stress tests on the delivered units.
Support the commissioning of these power systems during the mass assembly and testing phases of HGCAL.
Work with physicists and engineers to evaluate the performance of HGCAL in relation to its power systems and to develop and implement mitigation strategies where possible and necessary, first on the surface and subsequently when HGCAL is installed in CMS, 100 metres underground.
Work with the HGCAL and central CMS Technical Coordination teams to oversee the installation and testing of the power systems underground in the "Service" and "Experimental" caverns. This will include overseeing cable installation, in-situ connectorisation where needed, testing and commissioning, and the integration of the power system into the HGCAL and CMS safety and monitoring systems.

Your profile
Strong track record in testing, operating and debugging power systems for complex devices, such as particle detectors used in high-energy physics experiments.
Experience with silicon- and/or scintillator-based particle detectors would be an advantage.
Experience with large-scale procurement of electronic systems, such as power supplies.
Ability to work successfully and efficiently within multinational, multicultural teams of engineers, scientists and technicians would be an advantage.
Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills
Construction, test and installation of power electronic components and systems.
Specification and follow-up of technical aspects of a contract.
Testing and validation of detector components.
Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
Assimilates large quantities of information, identifies key issues and formulates conclusions clearly and concisely.
Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
Has a structured and organised approach towards work; is able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.
Ensures that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

description:

About us  
We are a Private Recovery Clinic, experts in addiction and affective disorders, providing exceptional treatment and care to an international clientele. Situated on the spectacular shores of Lake Lucerne, we are an English\-speaking boutique clinic treating those suffering from addiction and affective disorders such as depression and anxiety. Our team is dedicated to helping people achieve long\-term recovery through compassionate care.  
The role  
We are currently recruiting dedicated and experienced Recovery Counsellors (100%) to join our multidisciplinary team. The ideal candidate combines personal recovery experience, professional competence, and a strong commitment to supporting others on their recovery journey. In this role, you will work closely with medical and mental health professionals to provide comprehensive care, guidance, and encouragement to our clients.  
Start date: immediately or by agreement.  
Skills and qualifications  
A minimum of 10 years of continuous abstinence from all psychoactive substances  
Excellent written and spoken English (C2 professional proficiency); other languages are an advantage  
Active and ongoing participation in personal recovery work or mutual aid groups, such as Narcotics Anonymous, Alcoholics Anonymous, Gamblers Anonymous, etc.  
A clear understanding of your recovery process and the ability to express it in a differentiated manner  
Good IT skills and the ability to write reports and clinical notes  
A high degree of professional \& personal competence as an "expert from experience"  
The ability to work as part of a multi\-disciplinary team with medical leadership  
A relevant form of training or work experience  
The ability to work with a culturally diverse clientele  
A current driver’s license and willingness to drive  
Ability to commute or relocate close to Lucerne, Switzerland  
Ability to work in shifts (combination of day, overnight, weekends, holidays)

title: Commercial Excellence Lead (m/f/d)
description:
Within the Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EEMEA). Commercial Operations & Strategy Organization, the Commercial Excellence Lead will elevate commercial excellence across the region, enable strong alignment across multiple functions and divisions, and lead commercial-capability readiness for our emerging launch pipeline in EEMEA. Strong, trusted partnership with cluster commercial operations teams is essential to the success of this role. Key stakeholders will be the EEMEA Leadership Team (LT), HHI Commercial Operations, regional Chief Marketing Officers (CMO) & Regional Commercial Leads (RCL), and market Commercial Operations Directors (CODs.)
This is a Band 400 individual-contributor role. The primary location is Switzerland, with secondary locations in the Europe or Middle East time zones may be considered upon further discussion with the hiring manager. The role includes approximately 25% travel within Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa.
Responsibilities:
Commercial Capabilities:  Drive customer engagement evolution in partnership with Digital Engagement teams, ensuring commercial capabilities, segmentation, omnichannel execution and customer insights are translated into improved customer experience and business outcomes.
Relevant focus areas include:
•    Sales Force Effectiveness: Ensure proper Sales Incentive Plan (SIP), target setting, CRM operations and upgrades, and Sales Force of the Future (SFOF) deployment in select markets.  Ensure an ongoing focus on segmentation and targeting and Multichannel Cycle Plans (MCCP) efforts in the region.  Leverage data, analytics and business insights to improve sales force effectiveness in the region.
•    Key Account Management:  Ensure the roll out of Key Account Management and Top Customer programs in the region. Ensure successful capability roll-out and work with Market Access and Franchises to increase access at account level.
•    Commercial Trade Channels: Align with HHI on new capability roll-out and support markets in uncovering Commercial Trade Channel (CTC) opportunities.
Operational Governance & Execution:  Work with all relevant stakeholders to secure the EEMEA Commercial Operations & Strategy (CO&S) vision and business strategies and proactively identify and execute projects and programs of strategic importance to the region and our customers in a timely, effective, and efficient fashion. Be the communicator / connector / catalyst for cross-functional projects managed by extended regional stakeholders. Relevant focus areas include:
•    CO&S Governance: Manage all governance activities for the CO&S department, including setting the agenda for virtual and face-to-face meetings and periodic forum calls with market leads and other relevant stakeholders.
•    Business Impact Measurement: Establish measurement frameworks to evaluate the impact of commercial capability investments, ensuring visibility to adoption, effectiveness, customer outcomes and business value realization.
•    Continuous Improvement: Continue to identify opportunities to drive simplification and harmonization across the region in collaboration with CO&S stakeholders including Digital Human Health (DHH). Support markets and the region in Objective & Key Result (OKR) transformation projects where requested.  Bring external industry best practices and innovative approaches into the region to continuously elevate commercial excellence.
•    Marketing Capabilities: Partner with regional Learning & Development (L&D), CMOs, and RCLs to build and scale marketing capabilities with a focus on L3 next deployment and sustainment.
•    Regional Projects: Ensure the successful deployment of projects associated with regional initiatives, priorities, and experimentations.
Launch Excellence:  Lead commercial-capability readiness that carries our emerging pipeline to flawless launch execution across markets. Relevant focus areas include:
•    Launch Capability Readiness: Partner with RCLs and market teams to ensure markets have the appropriate Go to Market (G2M) planning, segmentation, targeting, field-force sizing, training, forecasting support, and launch playbooks are in place well ahead of launch.
•    Launch Framework & Tracking: Establish a repeatable EEMEA launch-excellence framework and toolkit, with launch tracking that gives leadership visibility to timelines, milestones and risks.
AI-Enabled Commercial Excellence:  Champion the responsible adoption of GenAI across commercial workflows — helping teams work faster and smarter while safeguarding compliance and quality — and explore opportunities to embed AI into sales, marketing, field-force and launch ways of working, in partnership with key stakeholders.
Talent Development:  Build & support commercial-operations talent and capability development across the region.
We are looking for a commercially minded leader with 10+ years across sales, marketing, commercial operations and launch readiness who has successfully deployed commercial excellence capabilities in a complex, multinational environment. Combines strategic thinking with execution discipline, excels at influencing without authority, and has a strong track record of leading change, building capabilities, and translating data and technology into measurable business outcomes.

title: Natural Hazards Mission Lead
description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. The Natural Hazards Mission focuses initially on mass movements, including landslides and rockfalls, with the aim of improving early detection, monitoring, preparedness and decision support for Swiss practitioners, authorities and infrastructure stakeholders. It builds on stakeholder engagement, solution scoping and community-building activities already underway within GeoLab, including contributions from senior domain experts and partners in the Swiss natural hazards community.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, natural hazard organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Natural Hazards Mission Lead, you will lead the research and development portfolio, integration and delivery of GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Mission. Initially focused on landslides and rockfalls, and later expanding to other natural hazards, you will help define the mission vision, translate user needs into research and product requirements, and ensure that GeoLab activities create measurable value for Swiss practice and public decision-making. You will build on ongoing interchange with key stakeholders and solution-scoping activities already underway within GeoLab, and work closely with senior domain-relevant partners, technical teams and experts.

You will report to the Managing Director of ETH Swiss GeoLab and work closely with GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Community & Solutions Lead, other GeoLab mission teams, the Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team and external partners. You will define priorities, milestones and decision points, lead mission delivery and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within your research and development portfolio, the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent research and development portfolio for the Natural Hazards Mission, initially centred on landslides and rockfalls
Translate identified critical operational gaps into measurable outcomes that create value for practitioners, authorities and decision-makers
Engage with local, cantonal and federal authorities, infrastructure operators, practitioners, industry and expert communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Translate operational challenges into research, data, product and technical requirements
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss natural hazard needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones, decision points and success criteria and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with the Geo-Lab’s Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and Earth  observation foundational models - and external performers to drive pilots, field validation, operational testing and integration into user workflows
Assess evidence and performance, and recommend continuation, redirection, scaling, pausing or termination of activities
Identify and mobilise strong ETH groups, research institutions, engineering and geology offices, remote-sensing companies, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab in Swiss natural hazard, scientific, policy and industry communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned to internal and external stakeholders
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support the transfer of resulting capabilities into operational practice
In summary, you understand the needs of practitioners and decision-makers in the field of natural hazards and their relation to Earth observations from space and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research and technology into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in natural hazards, geosciences, engineering, risk management or related fields
Several years of experience in natural hazard practice, applied research, public administration, consulting, engineering or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding of natural hazards with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of transparent reporting, dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organisation. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, operational relevance and measurable value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

A rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong societal relevance
The opportunity to develop solutions for pressing natural hazard challenges in Switzerland, and with broad international impact through transferable methods and lessons learned
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Natural Hazards Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

We look forward to receiving your application!
